live.jasher|84:21: And when Sihon had conquered Moab, he placed guards in the cities which he had taken from Moab, and a considerable number of the children of Moab fell in battle into the hand of Sihon, and he made a great capture of them, sons and daughters, and he slew their king; so Sihon turned back to his own land.
live.jasher|84:22: And Sihon gave numerous presents of silver and gold to Beor and Balaam his son, and he dismissed them, and they went to Mesopotamia to their home and country.
live.jasher|84:23: At that time all the children of Israel passed from the road of the wilderness of Moab, and returned and surrounded the wilderness of Edom.
live.jasher|84:24: So the whole congregation came to the wilderness of Sin in the first month of the fortieth year from their departure from Egypt, and the children of Israel dwelt there in Kadesh, of the wilderness of Sin, and Miriam died there and she was buried there.
live.jasher|84:25: At that time Moses sent messengers to Hadad king of Edom, saying, Thus says your brother Israel, Let me pass I pray you through your land, we will not pass through field or vineyard, we will not drink the water of the well; we will walk in the king’s road.
live.jasher|84:26: And Edom said to him, You shall not pass through my country, and Edom went forth to meet the children of Israel with a mighty people.
live.jasher|84:27: And the children of Esau refused to let the children of Israel pass through their land, so the Israelites removed from them and fought not against them.
live.jasher|84:28: For before this Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded the children of Israel, saying, You shall not fight against the children of Esau, therefore the Israelites removed from them and did not fight against them.
live.jasher|84:29: So the children of Israel departed from Kadesh, and all the people came to Mount Hor.
live.jasher|84:30: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Tell your brother Aaron that he shall die there, for he shall not come to the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
live.jasher|84:31: And Aaron went up, at the command of Yahuah (the Lord), to Mount Hor, in the fortieth year, in the fifth month, in the first day of the month.
live.jasher|84:32: And Aaron was one hundred and twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor
live.jasher|85:1: And king Arad the Canaanite, who dwelt in the south, heard that the Israelites had come by the way of the spies, and he arranged his forces to fight against the Israelites.
live.jasher|85:2: And the children of Israel were greatly afraid of him, for he had a great and heavy army, so the children of Israel resolved to return to Egypt.
live.jasher|85:3: And the children of Israel turned back about the distance of three days’ journey to Maserath Beni Jaakon, for they were greatly afraid on account of the king Arad.
live.jasher|85:4: And the children of Israel would not get back to their places, so they remained in Beni Jaakon for thirty days.
live.jasher|85:5: And when the children of Levi saw that the children of Israel would not turn back, they were jealous for the sake of Yahuah (the Lord), and they rose up and fought against the Israelites their brethren, and slew of them a great body, and forced them to turn back to their place, Mount Hor.
live.jasher|85:6: And when they returned, king Arad was still arranging his host for battle against the Israelites.
live.jasher|85:7: And Israel vowed a vow, saying, If you will deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
live.jasher|85:8: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Israel, and he delivered the Canaanites into their hand, and he utterly destroyed them and their cities, and he called the name of the place Hormah.
live.jasher|85:9: And the children of Israel journeyed from Mount Hor and pitched in Oboth, and they journeyed from Oboth and they pitched at Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
live.jasher|85:10: And the children of Israel sent to Moab, saying, Let us pass now through your land into our place, but the children of Moab would not suffer the children of Israel to pass through their land, for the children of Moab were greatly afraid lest the children of Israel should do to them as Sihon king of the Amorites had done to them, who had taken their land and had slain many of them.
live.jasher|85:11: Therefore Moab would not suffer the Israelites to pass through his land, and Yahuah (the Lord) commanded the children of Israel, saying, That they should not fight against Moab, so the Israelites removed from Moab.
live.jasher|85:12: And the children of Israel journeyed from the border of Moab, and they came to the other side of Arnon, the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites, and they pitched in the border of Sihon, king of the Amorites, in the wilderness of Kedemoth.
live.jasher|85:13: And the children of Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, saying,
live.jasher|85:14: Let us pass through your land, we will not turn into the fields or into the vineyards, we will go along by the king’s highway until we shall have passed your border, but Sihon would not suffer the Israelites to pass.
live.jasher|85:15: So Sihon collected all the people of the Amorites and went forth into the wilderness to meet the children of Israel, and he fought against Israel in Jahaz.
live.jasher|85:16: And Yahuah (the Lord) delivered Sihon king of the Amorites into the hand of the children of Israel, and Israel smote all the people of Sihon with the edge of the sword and avenged the cause of Moab.
live.jasher|85:17: And the children of Israel took possession of the land of Sihon from Aram to Jabuk, to the children of Ammon, and they took all the spoil of the cities.
live.jasher|85:18: And Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites.
live.jasher|85:19: And all the children of Israel resolved to fight against the children of Ammon, to take their land also.
live.jasher|85:20: So Yahuah (the Lord) said to the children of Israel, Do not besiege the children of Ammon, neither stir up battle against them, for I will give nothing to you of their land, and the children of Israel hearkened to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and did not fight against the children of Ammon.
live.jasher|85:21: And the children of Israel turned and went up by the way of Bashan to the land of Og, king of Bashan, and Og the king of Bashan went out to meet the Israelites in battle, and he had with him many valiant men, and a very strong force from the people of the Amorites.
live.jasher|85:22: And Og king of Bashan was a very powerful man, but Naaron his son was exceedingly powerful, even stronger than he was.
live.jasher|85:23: And Og said in his heart, Behold now the whole camp of Israel takes up a space of three parsa, now will I smite them at once without sword or spear.
live.jasher|85:24: And Og went up Mount Jahaz, and took therefrom one large stone, the length of which was three parsa, and he placed it on his head, and resolved to throw it upon the camp of the children of Israel, to smite all the Israelites with that stone.
live.jasher|85:25: And the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) came and pierced the stone upon the head of Og, and the stone fell upon the neck of Og that Og fell to the earth on account of the weight of the stone upon his neck.
live.jasher|85:26: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) said to the children of Israel, Be not afraid of him, for I have given him and all his people and all his land into your hand, and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon.
live.jasher|85:27: And Moses went down to him with a small number of the children of Israel, and Moses smote Og with a stick at the ankles of his feet and slew him.
live.jasher|85:28: The children of Israel afterward pursued the children of Og and all his people, and they beat and destroyed them till there was no remnant left of them.
live.jasher|85:29: Moses afterward sent some of the children of Israel to spy out Jaazer, for Jaazer was a very famous city.
live.jasher|85:30: And the spies went to Jaazer and explored it, and the spies trusted in Yahuah (the Lord), and they fought against the men of Jaazer.
live.jasher|85:31: And these men took Jaazer and its villages, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered them into their hand, and they drove out the Amorites who had been there.
live.jasher|85:32: And the children of Israel took the land of the two kings of the Amorites, sixty cities which were on the other side of Jordan, from the brook of Arnon to Mount Herman.
live.jasher|85:33: And the children of Israel journeyed and came into the plain of Moab which is on this side of Jordan, by Jericho.
live.jasher|85:34: And the children of Moab heard all the evil which the children of Israel had done to the two kings of the Amorites, to Sihon and Og, so all the men of Moab were greatly afraid of the Israelites.
live.jasher|85:35: And the elders of Moab said, Behold the two kings of the Amorites, Sihon and Og, who were more powerful than all the kings of the earth, could not stand against the children of Israel, how then can we stand before them?
live.jasher|85:36: Surely they sent us a message before now to pass through our land on their way, and we would not suffer them, now they will turn upon us with their heavy swords and destroy us; and Moab was distressed on account of the children of Israel, and they were greatly afraid of them, and they counselled together what was to be done to the children of Israel.
live.jasher|85:37: And the elders of Moab resolved and took one of their men, Balak the son of Zippor the Moabite, and made him king over them at that time, and Balak was a very wise man.
live.jasher|85:38: And the elders of Moab rose up and sent to the children of Midian to make peace with them, for a great battle and enmity had been in those days between Moab and Midian, from the days of Hadad the son of Bedad king of Edom, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, to these days.
live.jasher|85:39: And the children of Moab sent to the children of Midian, and they made peace with them, and the elders of Midian came to the land of Moab to make peace in behalf of the children of Midian.
live.jasher|85:40: And the elders of Moab counselled with the elders of Midian what to do in order to save their lives from Israel.
live.jasher|85:41: And all the children of Moab said to the elders of Midian, Now therefore the children of Israel lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field, for thus did they do to the two kings of the Amorites who are stronger than we are.
live.jasher|85:42: And the elders of Midian said to Moab, We have heard that at the time when Sihon king of the Amorites fought against you, when he prevailed over you and took your land, he had sent to Beor the son of Janeas and to Balaam his son from Mesopotamia, and they came and cursed you; therefore did the hand of Sihon prevail over you, that he took your land.
live.jasher|85:43: Now therefore send you also to Balaam his son, for he still remains in his land, and give him his hire, that he may come and curse all the people of whom you are afraid; so the elders of Moab heard this thing, and it pleased them to send to Balaam the son of Beor.
live.jasher|85:44: So Balak the son of Zippor king of Moab sent messengers to Balaam, saying,
live.jasher|85:45: Behold there is a people come out from Egypt, behold they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me.
live.jasher|85:46: Now therefore come and curse this people for me, for they are too mighty for me, peradventure I shall prevail to fight against them, and drive them out, for I heard that he whom you bless is blessed, and whom you curse is cursed.
live.jasher|85:47: So the messengers of Balak went to Balaam and brought Balaam to curse the people to fight against Moab.
live.jasher|85:48: And Balaam came to Balak to curse Israel, and Yahuah (the Lord) said to Balaam, Curse not this people for it is blessed.
live.jasher|85:49: And Balak urged Balaam day by day to curse Israel, but Balaam hearkened not to Balak on account of the word of Yahuah (the Lord) which he had spoken to Balaam.
live.jasher|85:50: And when Balak saw that Balaam would not accede to his wish, he rose up and went home, and Balaam also returned to his land and he went from there to Midian.
live.jasher|85:51: And the children of Israel journeyed from the plain of Moab, and pitched by Jordan from Beth-jesimoth even to Abel-shittim, at the end of the plains of Moab.
live.jasher|85:52: And when the children of Israel abode in the plain of Shittim, they began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
live.jasher|85:53: And the children of Israel approached Moab, and the children of Moab pitched their tents opposite to the camp of the children of Israel.
live.jasher|85:54: And the children of Moab were afraid of the children of Israel, and the children of Moab took all their daughters and their wives of beautiful aspect and comely appearance, and dressed them in gold and silver and costly garments.
live.jasher|85:55: And the children of Moab seated those women at the door of their tents, in order that the children of Israel might see them and turn to them, and not fight against Moab.
live.jasher|85:56: And all the children of Moab did this thing to the children of Israel, and every man placed his wife and daughter at the door of his tent, and all the children of Israel saw the act of the children of Moab, and the children of Israel turned to the daughters of Moab and coveted them, and they went to them.
live.jasher|85:57: And it came to pass that when a Hebrew came to the door of the tent of Moab, and saw a daughter of Moab and desired her in his heart, and spoke with her at the door of the tent that which he desired, whilst they were speaking together the men of the tent would come out and speak to the Hebrew like to these words:
live.jasher|85:58: Surely you know that we are brethren, we are all the descendants of Lot and the descendants of Abraham his brother, therefore then will you not remain with us, and therefore will you not eat our bread and our sacrifice?
live.jasher|85:59: And when the children of Moab had thus overwhelmed him with their speeches, and enticed him by their flattering words, they seated him in the tent and cooked and sacrificed for him, and he ate of their sacrifice and of their bread.
live.jasher|85:60: They then gave him wine and he drank and became intoxicated, and they placed before him a beautiful damsel, and he did with her as he liked, for he knew not what he was doing, as he had drunk plentifully of wine.
live.jasher|85:61: Thus did the children of Moab to Israel in that place, in the plain of Shittim, and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled against Israel on account of this matter, and he sent a pestilence amongst them, and there died of the Israelites twenty-four thousand men.
live.jasher|85:62: Now there was a man of the children of Simeon whose name was Zimri, the son of Salu, who connected himself with the Midianite Cosbi, the daughter of Zur, king of Midian, in the sight of all the children of Israel.
live.jasher|85:63: And Phineas the son of Elazer, the son of Aaron the priest, saw this wicked thing which Zimri had done, and he took a spear and rose up and went after them, and pierced them both and slew them, and the pestilence ceased from the children of Israel.
live.jasher|86:1: At that time after the pestilence, Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, and to Elazer the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
live.jasher|86:2: Number the heads of the whole community of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth in the army.
live.jasher|86:3: And Moses and Elazer numbered the children of Israel after their families, and the number of all Israel was seven hundred thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
live.jasher|86:4: And the number of the children of Levi, from one month old and upward, was twenty-three thousand, and amongst these there was not a man of those numbered by Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sinai.
live.jasher|86:5: For Yahuah (the Lord) had told them that they would die in the wilderness, so they all died, and not one had been left of them excepting Caleb the son of Jephuneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
live.jasher|86:6: And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel to avenge upon Midian the cause of their brethren the children of Israel.
live.jasher|86:7: And Moses did so, and the children of Israel chose from amongst them twelve thousand men, being one thousand to a tribe, and they went to Midian.
live.jasher|86:8: And the children of Israel warred against Midian, and they slew every male, also the five princes of Midian, and Balaam the son of Beor did they slay with the sword.
live.jasher|86:9: And the children of Israel took the wives of Midian captive, with their little ones and their cattle, and all belonging to them.
live.jasher|86:10: And they took all the spoil and all the prey, and they brought it to Moses and to Elazer to the plains of Moab.
live.jasher|86:11: And Moses and Elazer and all the princes of the congregation went forth to meet them with joy.
live.jasher|86:12: And they divided all the spoil of Midian, and the children of Israel had been revenged upon Midian for the cause of their brethren the children of Israel.
live.jasher|87:1: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Behold your days are approaching to an end, take now Joshua the son of Nun your servant and place him in the tabernacle, and I will command him, and Moses did so.
live.jasher|87:2: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood at the entrance of the tabernacle.
live.jasher|87:3: And Yahuah (the Lord) commanded Joshua the son of Nun and said to him, Be strong and courageous, for you shall bring the children of Israel to the land which I swore to give them, and I will be with you.
live.jasher|87:4: And Moses said to Joshua, Be strong and courageous, for you will make the children of Israel inherit the land, and Yahuah (the Lord) will be with you, he will not leave you nor forsake you, be not afraid nor disheartened.
live.jasher|87:5: And Moses called to all the children of Israel and said to them, You have seen all the good which Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God) has done for you in the wilderness.
live.jasher|87:6: Now therefore observe all the words of this law, and walk in the way of Yahuah your Elohim, turn not from the way which Yahuah (the Lord) has commanded you, either to the right or to the left.
live.jasher|87:7: And Moses taught the children of Israel statutes and judgments and laws to do in the land as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.
live.jasher|87:8: And he taught them the way of Yahuah (the Lord) and his laws; behold they are written upon the book of the law of Elohim (God) which he gave to the children of Israel by the hand of Moses.
live.jasher|87:9: And Moses finished commanding the children of Israel, and Yahuah (the Lord) said to him, saying, Go up to the Mount Abarim and die there, and be gathered to your people as Aaron your brother was gathered.
live.jasher|87:10: And Moses went up as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him, and he died there in the land of Moab by the order of Yahuah (the Lord), in the fortieth year from the Israelites going forth from the land of Egypt.
live.jasher|87:11: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab for thirty days, and the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were completed.
live.jasher|88:1: And it was after the death of Moses that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua the son of Nun, saying,
live.jasher|88:2: Rise up and pass the Jordan to the land which I have given to the children of Israel, and you shall make the children of Israel inherit the land.
live.jasher|88:3: Every place upon which the sole of your feet shall tread shall belong to you, from the wilderness of Lebanon to the great river the river of Perath shall be your boundary.
live.jasher|88:4: No man shall stand up against you all the days of your life; as I was with Moses, so will I be with you, only be strong and of good courage to observe all the law which Moses commanded you, turn not from the way either to the right or to the left, in order that you may prosper in all that you do.
live.jasher|88:5: And Joshua commanded the officers of Israel, saying, Pass through the camp and command the people, saying, Prepare for yourselves provisions, for in three days more you will pass the Jordan to possess the land.
live.jasher|88:6: And the officers of the children of Israel did so, and they commanded the people and they did all that Joshua had commanded.
live.jasher|88:7: And Joshua sent two men to spy out the land of Jericho, and the men went and spied out Jericho.
live.jasher|88:8: And at the end of seven days they came to Joshua in the camp and said to him, Yahuah (the Lord) has delivered the whole land into our hand, and the inhabitants of it are melted with fear because of us.
live.jasher|88:9: And it came to pass after that, that Joshua rose up in the morning and all Israel with him, and they journeyed from Shittim, and Joshua and all Israel with him passed the Jordan; and Joshua was eighty-two years old when he passed the Jordan with Israel.
live.jasher|88:10: And the people went up from Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and they encamped in Gilgal at the eastern corner of Jericho.
live.jasher|88:11: And the children of Israel kept the Passover in Gilgal, in the plains of Jericho, on the fourteenth day at the month, as it is written in the law of Moses.
live.jasher|88:12: And the manna ceased at that time on the morrow of the Passover, and there was no more manna for the children of Israel, and they ate of the produce of the land of Canaan.
live.jasher|88:13: And Jericho was entirely closed against the children of Israel, no one came out or went in.
live.jasher|88:14: And it was in the second month, on the first day of the month, that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Rise up, behold I have given Jericho into your hand with all the people of it; and all your fighting men shall go round the city, once each day, thus shall you do for six days.
live.jasher|88:15: And the priests shall blow upon trumpets, and when you shall hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall give a great shouting, that the walls of the city shall fall down; all the people shall go up every man against his opponent.
live.jasher|88:16: And Joshua did so according to all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.
live.jasher|88:17: And on the seventh day they went round the city seven times, and the priests blew upon trumpets.
live.jasher|88:18: And at the seventh round, Joshua said to the people, Shout, for Yahuah (the Lord) has delivered the whole city into our hands.
live.jasher|88:19: Only the city and all that it contains shall be accursed to Yahuah (the Lord), and keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest you make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.
live.jasher|88:20: But all the silver and gold and brass and iron shall be consecrated to Yahuah (the Lord), they shall come into the treasury of Yahuah (the Lord).
live.jasher|88:21: And the people blew upon trumpets and made a great shouting, and the walls of Jericho fell down, and all the people went up, every man straight before him, and they took the city and utterly destroyed all that was in it, both man and woman, young and old, ox and sheep and ass, with the edge of the sword.
live.jasher|88:22: And they burned the whole city with fire; only the vessels of silver and gold, and brass and iron, they put into the treasury of Yahuah (the Lord).
live.jasher|88:23: And Joshua swore at that time, saying, Cursed be the man who builds Jericho; he shall lay the foundation of it in his first-born, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.
live.jasher|88:24: And Achan the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, son of Judah, dealt treacherously in the accursed thing, and he took of the accursed thing and hid it in the tent, and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled against Israel.
live.jasher|88:25: And it was after this when the children of Israel had returned from burning Jericho, Joshua sent men to spy out also Ai, and to fight against it.
live.jasher|88:26: And the men went up and spied out Ai, and they returned and said, Let not all the people go up with you to Ai, only let about three thousand men go up and smite the city, for the men of it are but few.
live.jasher|88:27: And Joshua did so, and there went up with him of the children of Israel about three thousand men, and they fought against the men of Ai.
live.jasher|88:28: And the battle was severe against Israel, and the men of Ai smote thirty-six men of Israel, and the children of Israel fled from before the men of Ai.
live.jasher|88:29: And when Joshua saw this thing, he tore his garments and fell upon his face to the ground before Yahuah (the Lord), he, with the elders of Israel, and they put dust upon their heads.
live.jasher|88:30: And Joshua said, Why O Yahuah (O Lord) did you bring this people over the Jordan? what shall I say after the Israelites have turned their backs against their enemies?
live.jasher|88:31: Now therefore all the Canaanites, inhabitants of the land, will hear this thing, and surround us and cut off our name.
live.jasher|88:32: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Why dost you fall upon your face? rise, get you off, for the Israelites have sinned, and taken of the accursed thing; I will no more be with them unless they destroy the accursed thing from amongst them.
live.jasher|88:33: And Joshua rose up and assembled the people, and brought the Urim by the order of Yahuah (the Lord), and the tribe of Judah was taken, and Achan the son of Carmi was taken.
live.jasher|88:34: And Joshua said to Achan, Tell me my son, what have you done, and Achan said, I saw amongst the spoil a goodly garment of Shinar and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight; I coveted them and took them, and behold they are all hid in the earth in the midst of the tent.
live.jasher|88:35: And Joshua sent men who went and took them from the tent of Achan, and they brought them to Joshua.
live.jasher|88:36: And Joshua took Achan and these utensils, and his sons and daughters and all belonging to him, and they brought them into the valley of Achor.
live.jasher|88:37: And Joshua burned them there with fire, and all the Israelites stoned Achan with stones, and they raised over him a heap of stones, therefore did he call that place the valley of Achor, so Yahuah’s anger was appeased, and Joshua afterward came to the city and fought against it.
live.jasher|88:38: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Fear not, neither be you dismayed, behold I have given into your hand Ai, her king and her people, and you shall do to them as you did to Jericho and her king, only the spoil of it and the cattle of it shall you take for a prey for yourselves; lay an ambush for the city behind it.
live.jasher|88:39: So Joshua did according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and he chose from amongst the sons of war thirty thousand valiant men, and he sent them, and they lay in ambush for the city.
live.jasher|88:40: And he commanded them, saying, When you shall see us we will flee before them with cunning, and they will pursue us, you shall then rise out of the ambush and take the city, and they did so.
live.jasher|88:41: And Joshua fought, and the men of the city went out toward Israel, not knowing that they were lying in ambush for them behind the city.
live.jasher|88:42: And Joshua and all the Israelites feigned themselves wearied out before them, and they fled by the way of the wilderness with cunning.
live.jasher|88:43: And the men of Ai gathered all the people who were in the city to pursue the Israelites, and they went out and were drawn away from the city, not one remained, and they left the city open and pursued the Israelites.
live.jasher|88:44: And those who were lying in ambush rose up out of their places, and hastened to come to the city and took it and set it on fire, and the men of Ai turned back, and behold the smoke of the city ascended to the skies, and they had no means of retreating either one way or the other.
live.jasher|88:45: And all the men of Ai were in the midst of Israel, some on this side and some on that side, and they smote them so that not one of them remained.
live.jasher|88:46: And the children of Israel took Melosh king of Ai alive, and they brought him to Joshua, and Joshua hanged him on a tree and he died.
live.jasher|88:47: And the children of Israel returned to the city after having burned it, and they smote all those that were in it with the edge of the sword.
live.jasher|88:48: And the number of those that had fallen of the men of Ai, both man and woman, was twelve thousand; only the cattle and the spoil of the city they took to themselves, according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) to Joshua.
live.jasher|88:49: And all the kings on this side Jordan, all the kings of Canaan, heard of the evil which the children of Israel had done to Jericho and to Ai, and they gathered themselves together to fight against Israel.
live.jasher|88:50: Only the inhabitants of Gibeon were greatly afraid of fighting against the Israelites lest they should perish, so they acted cunningly, and they came to Joshua and to all Israel, and said to them, We have come from a distant land, now therefore make a covenant with us.
live.jasher|88:51: And the inhabitants of Gibeon over-reached the children of Israel, and the children of Israel made a covenant with them, and they made peace with them, and the princes of the congregation swore to them, but afterward the children of Israel knew that they were neighbors to them and were dwelling amongst them.
live.jasher|88:52: But the children of Israel slew them not; for they had sworn to them by Yahuah (the Lord), and they became hewers of wood and drawers of water.
live.jasher|88:53: And Joshua said to them, Why did you deceive me, to do this thing to us? and they answered him, saying, Because it was told to your servants all that you had done to all the kings of the Amorites, and we were greatly afraid of our lives, and we did this thing.
live.jasher|88:54: And Joshua appointed them on that day to hew wood and to draw water, and he divided them for slaves to all the tribes of Israel.
live.jasher|88:55: And when Adonizedek king of Jerusalem heard all that the children of Israel had done to Jericho and to Ai, he sent to Hoham king of Hebron and to Piram king at Jarmuth, and to Japhia king of Lachish and to Deber king of Eglon, saying,
live.jasher|88:56: Come up to me and help me, that we may smite the children of Israel and the inhabitants of Gibeon who have made peace with the children of Israel.
live.jasher|88:57: And they gathered themselves together and the five kings of the Amorites went up with all their camps, a mighty people numerous as the sand of the sea shore.
live.jasher|88:58: And all these kings came and encamped before Gibeon, and they began to fight against the inhabitants of Gibeon, and all the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua, saying, Come up quickly to us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites have gathered together to fight against us.
live.jasher|88:59: And Joshua and all the fighting people went up from Gilgal, and Joshua came suddenly to them, and smote these five kings with a great slaughter.
live.jasher|88:60: And Yahuah (the Lord) confounded them before the children at Israel, who smote them with a terrible slaughter in Gibeon, and pursued them along the way that goes up to Beth Horon to Makkedah, and they fled from before the children of Israel.
live.jasher|88:61: And whilst they were fleeing, Yahuah (the Lord) sent upon them hailstones from heaven, and more of them died by the hailstones, than by the slaughter of the children of Israel.
live.jasher|88:62: And the children of Israel pursued them, and they still smote them in the road, going on and smiting them.
live.jasher|88:63: And when they were smiting, the day was declining toward evening, and Joshua said in the sight of all the people, Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon, and you moon in the valley of Ajalon, until the nation shall have revenged itself upon its enemies.
live.jasher|88:64: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Joshua, and the sun stood still in the midst of the heavens, and it stood still six and thirty moments, and the moon also stood still and hastened not to go down a whole day.
live.jasher|88:65: And there was no day like that, before it or after it, that Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of a man, for Yahuah (the Lord) fought for Israel.
live.jasher|89:1: Then spoke Joshua this song, on the day that Yahuah (the Lord) had given the Amorites into the hand of Joshua and the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of all Israel,
live.jasher|89:2: You have done mighty things, O Yahuah (O Lord), you have performed great deeds; who is like to you? my lips shall sing to your name.
live.jasher|89:3: My goodness and my fortress, my high tower, I will sing a new song to you, with thanksgiving will I sing to you, you are the strength of my salvation.
live.jasher|89:4: All the kings of the earth shall praise you, the princes of the world shall sing to you, the children of Israel shall rejoice in your salvation, they shall sing and praise your power.
live.jasher|89:5: To you, O Yahuah (O Lord), did we confide; we said you are our Elohim (God), for you were our shelter and strong tower against our enemies.
live.jasher|89:6: To you we cried and were not ashamed, in you we trusted and were delivered; when we cried to you, you did hear our voice, you did deliver our souls from the sword, you did show to us your grace, you did give to us your salvation, you did rejoice our hearts with your strength.
live.jasher|89:7: You did go forth for our salvation, with your arm you did redeem your people; you did answer us from the heavens of your holiness, you did save us from ten thousands of people.
live.jasher|89:8: The sun and moon stood still in heaven, and you did stand in your wrath against our oppressors and did command your judgments over them.
live.jasher|89:9: All the princes of the earth stood up, the kings of the nations had gathered themselves together, they were not moved at your presence, they desired your battles.
live.jasher|89:10: You did rise against them in your anger, and did bring down your wrath upon them; you did destroy them in your anger, and cut them off in your heart.
live.jasher|89:11: Nations have been consumed with your fury, kingdoms have declined because of your wrath, you did wound kings in the day of your anger.
live.jasher|89:12: You did pour out your fury upon them, your wrathful anger took hold of them; you did turn their iniquity upon them, and did cut them off in their wickedness.
live.jasher|89:13: They did spread a trap, they fell in it, in the net they hid, their foot was caught.
live.jasher|89:14: Your hand was ready for all your enemies who said, Through their sword they possessed the land, through their arm they dwelt in the city; you did fill their faces with shame, you did bring their horns down to the ground, you did terrify them in your wrath, and did destroy them in your anger.
live.jasher|89:15: The earth trembled and shook at the sound of your storm over them, you did not withhold their souls from death, and did bring down their lives to the grave.
live.jasher|89:16: You did pursue them in your storm, you did consume them in your whirlwind, you did turn their rain into hail, they fell in deep pits so that they could not rise.
live.jasher|89:17: Their carcasses were like rubbish cast out in the middle of the streets.
live.jasher|89:18: They were consumed and destroyed in your anger, you did save your people with your might.
live.jasher|89:19: Therefore our hearts rejoice in you, our souls exalt in your salvation.
live.jasher|89:20: Our tongues shall relate your might, we will sing and praise your wondrous works.
live.jasher|89:21: For you did save us from our enemies, you did deliver us from those who rose up against us, you did destroy them from before us and depress them beneath our feet.
live.jasher|89:22: Thus shall all your enemies perish O Yahuah (O Lord), and the wicked shall be like chaff driven by the wind, and your beloved shall be like trees planted by the waters.
live.jasher|89:23: So Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp in Gilgal, after having smitten all the kings, so that not a remnant was left of them.
live.jasher|89:24: And the five kings fled alone on foot from battle, and hid themselves in a cave, and Joshua sought for them in the field of battle, and did not find them.
live.jasher|89:25: And it was afterward told to Joshua, saying, The kings are found and behold they are hidden in a cave.
live.jasher|89:26: And Joshua said, Appoint men to be at the mouth of the cave, to guard them, lest they take themselves away; and the children of Israel did so.
live.jasher|89:27: And Joshua called to all Israel and said to the officers of battle, Place your feet upon the necks of these kings, and Joshua said, So shall Yahuah (the Lord) do to all your enemies.
live.jasher|89:28: And Joshua commanded afterward that they should slay the kings and cast them into the cave, and to put great stones at the mouth of the cave.
live.jasher|89:29: And Joshua went afterward with all the people that were with him on that day to Makkedah, and he smote it with the edge of the sword.
live.jasher|89:30: And he utterly destroyed the souls and all belonging to the city, and he did to the king and people of it as he had done to Jericho.
live.jasher|89:31: And he passed from there to Libnah and he fought against it, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered it into his hand, and Joshua smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls of it, and he did to it and to the king of it as he had done to Jericho.
live.jasher|89:32: And from there he passed on to Lachish to fight against it, and Horam king of Gaza went up to assist the men of Lachish, and Joshua smote him and his people until there was none left to him.
live.jasher|89:33: And Joshua took Lachish and all the people of it, and he did to it as he had done to Libnah.
live.jasher|89:34: And Joshua passed from there to Eglon, and he took that also, and he smote it and all the people of it with the edge of the sword.
live.jasher|89:35: And from there he passed to Hebron and fought against it and took it and utterly destroyed it, and he returned from there with all Israel to Debir and fought against it and smote it with the edge of the sword.
live.jasher|89:36: And he destroyed every soul in it, he left none remaining, and he did to it and the king of it as he had done to Jericho.
live.jasher|89:37: And Joshua smote all the kings of the Amorites from Kadesh-barnea to Azah, and he took their country at once, for Yahuah (the Lord) had fought for Israel.
live.jasher|89:38: And Joshua with all Israel came to the camp to Gilgal.
live.jasher|89:39: When at that time Jabin king of Chazor heard all that Joshua had done to the kings of the Amorites, Jabin sent to Jobat king of Midian, and to Laban king of Shimron, to Jephal king of Achshaph, and to all the kings of the Amorites, saying,
live.jasher|89:40: Come quickly to us and help us, that we may smite the children of Israel, before they come upon us and do to us as they have done to the other kings of the Amorites.
live.jasher|89:41: And all these kings hearkened to the words of Jabin, king of Chazor, and they went forth with all their camps, seventeen kings, and their people were as numerous as the sand on the sea shore, together with horses and chariots innumerable, and they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, and they were met together to fight against Israel.
live.jasher|89:42: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Fear them not, for tomorrow about this time I will deliver them up all slain before you, you shall hough their horses and burn their chariots with fire.
live.jasher|89:43: And Joshua with all the men of war came suddenly upon them and smote them, and they fell into their hands, for Yahuah (the Lord) had delivered them into the hands of the children of Israel.
live.jasher|89:44: So the children of Israel pursued all these kings with their camps, and smote them until there was none left of them, and Joshua did to them as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to him.
live.jasher|89:45: And Joshua returned at that time to Chazor and smote it with the sword and destroyed every soul in it and burned it with fire, and from Chazor, Joshua passed to Shimron and smote it and utterly destroyed it.
live.jasher|89:46: From there he passed to Achshaph and he did to it as he had done to Shimron.
live.jasher|89:47: From there he passed to Adulam and he smote all the people in it, and he did to Adulam as he had done to Achshaph and to Shimron.
live.jasher|89:48: And he passed from them to all the cities of the kings which he had smitten, and he smote all the people that were left of them and he utterly destroyed them.
live.jasher|89:49: Only their booty and cattle the Israelites took to themselves as a prey, but every human being they smote, they suffered not a soul to live.
live.jasher|89:50: As Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses so did Joshua and all Israel, they failed not in anything.
live.jasher|89:51: So Joshua and all the children of Israel smote the whole land of Canaan as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded them, and smote all their kings, being thirty and one kings, and the children of Israel took their whole country.
live.jasher|89:52: Besides the kingdoms of Sihon and Og which are on the other side Jordan, of which Moses had smitten many cities, and Moses gave them to the Reubenites and the Gadites and to half the tribe of Manasseh.
live.jasher|89:53: And Joshua smote all the kings that were on this side Jordan to the west, and gave them for an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half tribe of Israel.
live.jasher|89:54: For five years did Joshua carry on the war with these kings, and he gave their cities to the Israelites, and the land became tranquil from battle throughout the cities of the Amorites and the Canaanites.
live.jasher|90:1: At that time in the fifth year after the children of Israel had passed over Jordan, after the children of Israel had rested from their war with the Canaanites, at that time great and severe battles arose between Edom and the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim fought against Edom.
live.jasher|90:2: And Abianus king of Chittim went forth in that year, that is in the thirty-first year of his reign, and a great force with him of the mighty men of the children of Chittim, and he went to Seir to fight against the children of Esau.
live.jasher|90:3: And Hadad the king of Edom heard of his report, and he went forth to meet him with a heavy people and strong force, and engaged in battle with him in the field of Edom.
live.jasher|90:4: And the hand of Chittim prevailed over the children of Esau, and the children of Chittim slew of the children of Esau, two and twenty thousand men, and all the children of Esau fled from before them.
live.jasher|90:5: And the children of Chittim pursued them and they reached Hadad king of Edom, who was running before them and they caught him alive, and brought him to Abianus king of Chittim.
live.jasher|90:6: And Abianus ordered him to be slain, and Hadad king of Edom died in the forty-eighth year of his reign.
live.jasher|90:7: And the children of Chittim continued their pursuit of Edom, and they smote them with a great slaughter and Edom became subject to the children of Chittim.
live.jasher|90:8: And the children of Chittim ruled over Edom, and Edom became under the hand of the children of Chittim and became one kingdom from that day.
live.jasher|90:9: And from that time they could no more lift up their heads, and their kingdom became one with the children of Chittim.
live.jasher|90:10: And Abianus placed officers in Edom and all the children of Edom became subject and tributary to Abianus, and Abianus turned back to his own land, Chittim.
live.jasher|90:11: And when he returned he renewed his government and built for himself a spacious and fortified palace for a royal residence, and reigned securely over the children of Chittim and over Edom.
live.jasher|90:12: In those days, after the children of Israel had driven away all the Canaanites and the Amorites, Joshua was old and advanced in years.
live.jasher|90:13: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, You are old, advanced in life, and a great part of the land remains to be possessed.
live.jasher|90:14: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half tribe of Manasseh, and Joshua rose up and did as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to him.
live.jasher|90:15: And he divided the whole land to the tribes of Israel as an inheritance according to their divisions.
live.jasher|90:16: But to the tribe at Levi he gave no inheritance, the offerings of Yahuah (the Lord) are their inheritance as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken of them by the hand of Moses.
live.jasher|90:17: And Joshua gave Mount Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephuneh, one portion above his brethren, as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken through Moses.
live.jasher|90:18: Therefore Hebron became an inheritance to Caleb and his children to this day.
live.jasher|90:19: And Joshua divided the whole land by lots to all Israel for an inheritance, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.
live.jasher|90:20: And the children of Israel gave cities to the Levites from their own inheritance, and suburbs for their cattle, and property, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses so did the children of Israel, and they divided the land by lot whether great or small.
live.jasher|90:21: And they went to inherit the land according to their boundaries, and the children of Israel gave to Joshua the son of Nun an inheritance amongst them.
live.jasher|90:22: By the word of Yahuah (the Lord) did they give to him the city which he required, Timnath-serach in Mount Ephraim, and he built the city and dwelt in it.
live.jasher|90:23: These are the inheritances which Elazer the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes portioned out to the children of Israel by lot in Shiloh, before Yahuah (the Lord), at the door of the tabernacle, and they left off dividing the land.
live.jasher|90:24: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave the land to the Israelites, and they possessed it as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to them, and as Yahuah (the Lord) had sworn to their ancestors.
live.jasher|90:25: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave to the Israelites rest from all their enemies around them, and no man stood up against them, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered all their enemies into their hands, and not one thing failed of all the good which Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to the children of Israel, yea Yahuah (the Lord) performed every thing.
live.jasher|90:26: And Joshua called to all the children of Israel and he blessed them, and commanded them to serve Yahuah (the Lord), and he afterward sent them away, and they went each man to his city, and each man to his inheritance.
live.jasher|90:27: And the children of Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Joshua, and Yahuah (the Lord) gave them rest from all around them, and they dwelt securely in their cities.
live.jasher|90:28: And it came to pass in those days, that Abianus king of Chittim died, in the thirty-eighth year of his reign, that is the seventh year of his reign over Edom, and they buried him in his place which he had built for himself, and Latinus reigned in his stead fifty years.
live.jasher|90:29: And during his reign he brought forth an army, and he went and fought against the inhabitants of Britannia and Kernania, the children of Elisha son of Javan, and he prevailed over them and made them tributary.
live.jasher|90:30: He then heard that Edom had revolted from under the hand of Chittim, and Latinus went to them and smote them and subdued them, and placed them under the hand of the children of Chittim, and Edom became one kingdom with the children of Chittim all the days.
live.jasher|90:31: And for many years there was no king in Edom, and their government was with the children of Chittim and their king.
live.jasher|90:32: And it was in the twenty-sixth year after the children of Israel had passed the Jordan, that is the sixty-sixth year after the children of Israel had departed from Egypt, that Joshua was old, advanced in years, being one hundred and eight years old in those days.
live.jasher|90:33: And Joshua called to all Israel, to their elders, their judges and officers, after Yahuah (the Lord) had given to all the Israelites rest from all their enemies round about, and Joshua said to the elders of Israel, and to their judges, Behold I am old, advanced in years, and you have seen what Yahuah (the Lord) has done to all the nations whom he has driven away from before you, for it is Yahuah (the Lord) who has fought for you.
live.jasher|90:34: Now therefore strengthen yourselves to keep and to do all the words of the law of Moses, not to deviate from it to the right or to the left, and not to come amongst those nations who are left in the land; neither shall you make mention of the name of their gods, but you shall cleave to Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God), as you have done to this day.
live.jasher|90:35: And Joshua greatly exhorted the children of Israel to serve Yahuah (the Lord) all their days.
live.jasher|90:36: And all the Israelites said, We will serve Yahuah our Elohim (the Lord our God) all our days, we and our children, and our children’s children, and our seed for ever.
live.jasher|90:37: And Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day, and he sent away the children of Israel, and they went each man to his inheritance and to his city.
live.jasher|90:38: And it was in those days, when the children of Israel were dwelling securely in their cities, that they buried the coffins of the tribes of their ancestors, which they had brought up from Egypt, each man in the inheritance of his children, the twelve sons of Jacob did the children of Israel bury, each man in the possession of his children.
live.jasher|90:39: And these are the names of the cities wherein they buried the twelve sons of Jacob, whom the children of Israel had brought up from Egypt.
live.jasher|90:40: And they buried Reuben and Gad on this side Jordan, in Romia, which Moses had given to their children.
live.jasher|90:41: And Simeon and Levi they buried in the city Mauda, which he had given to the children of Simeon, and the suburb of the city was for the children of Levi.
live.jasher|90:42: And Judah they buried in the city of Benjamin opposite Bethlehem.
live.jasher|90:43: And the bones of Issachar and Zebulun they buried in Zidon, in the portion which fell to their children.
live.jasher|90:44: And Dan was buried in the city of his children in Eshtael, and Naphtali and Asher they buried in Kadesh-naphtali, each man in his place which he had given to his children.
live.jasher|90:45: And the bones of Joseph they buried in Shechem, in the part of the field which Jacob had purchased from Hamor, and which became to Joseph for an inheritance.
live.jasher|90:46: And they buried Benjamin in Jerusalem opposite the Jebusite, which was given to the children of Benjamin; the children of Israel buried their fathers each man in the city of his children.
live.jasher|90:47: And at the end of two years, Joshua the son of Nun died, one hundred and ten years old, and the time which Joshua judged Israel was twenty-eight years, and Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of his life.
live.jasher|90:48: And the other affairs of Joshua and his battles and his reproofs with which he reproved Israel, and all which he had commanded them, and the names of the cities which the children of Israel possessed in his days, behold they are written in the book of the words of Joshua to the children of Israel, and in the book of the wars of Yahuah (the Lord), which Moses and Joshua and the children of Israel had written.
live.jasher|90:49: And the children of Israel buried Joshua in the border of his inheritance, in Timnath-serach, which was given to him in Mount Ephraim.
live.jasher|90:50: And Elazer the son of Aaron died in those days, and they buried him in a hill belonging to Phineas his son, which was given him in Mount Ephraim.
live.jasher|91:1: At that time, after the death of Joshua, the children of the Canaanites were still in the land, and the Israelites resolved to drive them out.
live.jasher|91:2: And the children of Israel asked of Yahuah (the Lord), saying, Who shall first go up for us to the Canaanites to fight against them? and Yahuah (the Lord) said, Judah shall go up.
live.jasher|91:3: And the children of Judah said to Simeon, Go up with us into our lot, and we will fight against the Canaanites and we likewise will go up with you, in your lot, so the children of Simeon went with the children of Judah.
live.jasher|91:4: And the children of Judah went up and fought against the Canaanites, so Yahuah (the Lord) delivered the Canaanites into the hands of the children of Judah, and they smote them in Bezek, ten thousand men.
live.jasher|91:5: And they fought with Adonibezek in Bezek, and he fled from before them, and they pursued him and caught him, and they took hold of him and cut off his thumbs and great toes.
live.jasher|91:6: And Adonibezek said, Three score and ten kings having their thumbs and great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table, as I have done, so Elohim (God) has requited me, and they brought him to Jerusalem and he died there.
live.jasher|91:7: And the children of Simeon went with the children of Judah, and they smote the Canaanites with the edge of the sword.
live.jasher|91:8: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with the children of Judah, and they possessed the mountain, and the children of Joseph went up to Bethel, the same is Luz, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with them.
live.jasher|91:9: And the children of Joseph spied out Bethel, and the watchmen saw a man going forth from the city, and they caught him and said to him, Show us now the entrance of the city and we will show kindness to you.
live.jasher|91:10: And that man showed them the entrance of the city, and the children of Joseph came and smote the City with the edge of the sword.
live.jasher|91:11: And the man with his family they sent away, and he went to the Hittites and he built a city, and he called the name of it Luz, so all the Israelites dwelt in their cities, and the children at Israel dwelt in their cities, and the children of Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders, who had lengthened their days after Joshua, and saw the great work of Yahuah (the Lord), which he had performed for Israel.
live.jasher|91:12: And the elders judged Israel after the death of Joshua for seventeen years.
live.jasher|91:13: And all the elders also fought the battles of Israel against the Canaanites and Yahuah (the Lord) drove the Canaanites from before the children of Israel, in order to place the Israelites in their land.
live.jasher|91:14: And he accomplished all the words which he had spoken to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the oath which he had sworn, to give to them and to their children, the land of the Canaanites.
live.jasher|91:15: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave to the children of Israel the whole land of Canaan, as he had sworn to their ancestors, and Yahuah (the Lord) gave them rest from those around them, and the children of Israel dwelt securely in their cities.
live.jasher|91:16: Blessed be Yahuah (the Lord) for ever, amen, and amen.
live.jasher|91:17: Strengthen yourselves, and let the hearts of all you that trust in Yahuah (the Lord) be of good courage.

cards.note: *He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock* — the gathering hand named in Jer 31:10 is the *Yah* in Yahusha's name.
cards.s_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.t_text: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O you nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.

cards.note: *I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for mine holy name's sake* — the Yah who saves in Matt 1:21 saves for his own name's sake; the gospel is name-grace, not merit-grace.
cards.s_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.t_text: Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for my holy name’s sake, which you have profaned among the heathen, whither you went.

cards.note: *I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land* — the early-ministry geographic-scope summary as the beginning of the Ezek 37 gathering.
cards.s_text: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: The second-gathering prophecy; *shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.*
cards.s_text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

cards.note: *I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone* — the Ezekiel 37 gathering-prophecy companion.
cards.s_text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: The eschatological-gathering-with-sifting the present-age mission-to-Yashar'el (Israel) is moving toward.
cards.s_text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee you into another: for verily I say unto you, You shall not have gone over the cities of Yashar'el (Israel), till the Son of Adam be come.
cards.t_text: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

cards.note: *I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land* — the good-seed-of-the-children-of-the-kingdom is the same gathered-remnant the Tanakh-prophets name.
cards.s_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: *His people* in 1:21 is locked by 15:24's *the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — same mission scope at the front door of the gospel as at the Canaanite-woman pericope.
cards.s_text: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins.
cards.t_text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Rachab dwelt in Yashar'el (Israel) *even unto this day* — the grafting is settled, not perpetually open.
cards.s_text: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
cards.t_text: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwells in Yashar'el (Israel) even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

cards.note: *Thy people shall be my people, and thy Elohim (God) my Elohim (God)* — Ruth's specific Yah-ordained transfer from the Moavite peripheral-Avrahamic branch into the Yashar'eli (Israelite) covenant body.
cards.s_text: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
cards.t_text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave you, or to return from following after you: for whither you go, I will go; and where you lodgest, I will lodge: your people shall be my people, and your Elohim (God) my Elohim (God):

cards.note: *He shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth* — both houses, named, gathered.
cards.s_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

cards.note: *Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head* — the one head Hosea names is the Messiah Matthew is genealogizing.
cards.s_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.
cards.t_text: Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.

cards.note: *They saw the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) ... they saw Elohim (God), and did eat and drink* — the seventy elders see the Formed. The Formless is not what is seen; the Formed is.
cards.s_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.
cards.t_text: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel):

cards.note: *There shall come a Star out of Ya'aqov (Jacob), and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the Balaam prophecy of the Star-and-Sceptre that the Magi recognized.
cards.s_text: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Yahudim (Jews)? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: The pillar of cloud and fire that led Yashar'el (Israel) in the wilderness — the Tanakh-pattern for the shekinah-leading-by-visible-sign that the Matthew-2 star manifests.
cards.s_text: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

cards.note: Edom refusing passage to Yashar'el (Israel) at the wilderness border — the earliest beat of the Edom-against-Yashar'el pattern.
cards.s_text: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
cards.t_text: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus says your brother Yashar'el (Israel), You know all the travail that has befallen us:

cards.note: *When Yashar'el (Israel) was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt* — Yashar'el (Israel) as Yahuah's (God's) firstborn son brought out of Egypt at the Exodus; Matthew applies the verse to Yahusha (Jesus) as the embodiment of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of Yahuah (Lord) by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
cards.t_text: When Yashar'el (Israel) was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

cards.note: The patriarch Yoseph (Joseph) bringing Ya'aqov (Jacob) and his sons down to Egypt — the Tanakh-Yoseph initiating the Egypt-sojourn that the Matthew-Yoseph (Joseph) re-walks with the Messianic-Yashar'el (Israel) in his arms.
cards.s_text: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
cards.t_text: And Yashar'el (Israel) took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the Elohim (God) of his father Isaac.

cards.note: *I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Yashar'el (Israel), and Ephraim is my firstborn* — the gathering of the northern house, which Rachel's children (Yoseph (Joseph) and Binyamin (Benjamin)) are most associated with.
cards.s_text: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
cards.t_text: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Yashar'el (Israel), and Ephraim is my firstborn.

cards.note: The betrothal-restoration of divorced-Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
cards.t_text: And I will betroth you unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth you unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

cards.note: *I am married unto you* — addressed to *backsliding children;* the bridegroom-substance over scattered-Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
cards.t_text: Turn, O backsliding children, says Yahuah (LORD); for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:

cards.note: *Ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the eschatological-promise that locks the twelve-apostle / twelve-tribe correspondence.
cards.s_text: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *Twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the same architecture from the twelve-tribe-side.
cards.s_text: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
cards.t_text: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):

cards.note: The centurion-pericope as parallel test-case — individual-nations-figure with God-fearer-Yashar'el (Israel)-attachment receives-mercy.
cards.s_text: Then Yahusha (Jesus) went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
cards.t_text: And when Yahusha (Jesus) was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,

cards.note: *I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el (Israel)* — the centurion-pericope's-faith-honoring substance parallel.
cards.s_text: Then Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto her, O woman, great is your faith: be it unto you even as you will. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
cards.t_text: When Yahusha (Jesus) heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: The substantial-substance-of-the-Yashar'el-and-the-nations-gathered against-the-Father's-anointed.
cards.s_text: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
cards.t_text: Who by the mouth of your servant David have said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

cards.note: *Go ... rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — `lost-sheep-mission-scope`.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
cards.t_text: These twelve Yahusha (Jesus) sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter you not:

cards.note: *I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)*.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
cards.t_text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
cards.t_text: And what one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Yashar'el (Israel), whom Elohim (God) went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for your land, before your people, which you redeemedst to you from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

cards.note: The Old Testament prophetic source — Beth-lehem Ephratah as the birth-locale of the *ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.*
cards.s_text: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
cards.t_text: But you, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though you be little among the thousands of Yahudah (Judah), yet out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

cards.note: *Yashar'el (Israel) is my son, even my firstborn ... Let my son go, that he may serve me* — the Old Testament identification of Yashar'el (Israel) as Yahuah's (God's) firstborn son; Matthew's recapitulation reading hears this verse standing behind Hosea 11:1.
cards.s_text: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of Yahuah (Lord) by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

cards.s_text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

cards.s_text: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon.
cards.t_text: Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah (LORD):

cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel), and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon Yahuah (LORD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), in truth.

cards.note: *I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of Yahuah (the LORD). The remnant of Yashar'el (Israel) shall not do iniquity* — the remnant defined by Torah-walking.
cards.s_text: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
cards.t_text: I will also leave in the midst of you an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.s_text: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
cards.t_text: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

cards.s_text: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear you him.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

cards.t_text: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: The Lukan-parallel — *I appoint unto you a kingdom ... ye shall sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).*
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: You are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

cards.s_text: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

cards.t_text: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Yashar'el (Israel); be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

cards.s_text: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
cards.t_text: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved has a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

cards.t_text: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
