cards.s_text: And at that time Cain went out from the presence of Yahuah (the Lord), from the place where he was, and he went moving and wandering in the land toward the east of Eden, he and all belonging to him.
cards.t_text: And Cain went out from the presence of Yahuah (LORD), and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:4 — *And Yahuah (God) reproved Cain because of Abel, because he had slain him, and he made him a fugitive on the earth because of the blood of his brother, and he cursed him upon the earth...* Jubilees gives the same curse and fugitive-sentence Jasher 1:31 records — the now-live witness, adding the heavenly-tables verdict on treacherous murder.
cards.s_text: But you did this thing and did slay your brother for naught and because he spoke rightly to you, and now, therefore, cursed be you from the ground which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand, and wherein you did bury him.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) reproved Cain because of Abel, because he had slain him, and he made him a fugitive on the earth because of the blood of his brother, and he cursed him upon the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 4:17 — *And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.* Jasher 1:34-35's birth of Enoch and the city named for him is Genesis 4:17 — the first city, the kingdom-of-man pattern begun east of Eden.
cards.s_text: And Cain knew his wife in those days, and she conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Enoch, saying, In that time Yahuah (the Lord) began to give him rest and quiet in the earth.
cards.t_text: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

cards.note: Genesis 4:18 — *And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.* Jasher 1:36's Irad–Mechuyael–Methusael genealogy traces Cain's line exactly as Genesis 4:18 does.
cards.s_text: And Irad was born to Enoch, and Irad begat Mechuyael and Mechuyael begat Methusael.
cards.t_text: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:31 — *At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.* Jubilees follows the same Cain whose city Jasher 1:35 builds to his stone-struck end in righteous judgment — the now-live witness.
cards.s_text: And at that time Cain also began to build a city: and he built the city and he called the name of the city Enoch, according to the name of his son; for in those days Yahuah (the Lord) had given him rest upon the earth, and he did not move about and wander as in the beginning.
cards.t_text: At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:15 — *Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî'êl the daughter of his father's brother, and she bare him a son... and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men.* Jubilees carries the same Mahalaleel-Jared generation of Jasher 2:37 and marks Jared's days as when the Watchers came down — the corruption Jasher's next chapters and 1 Enoch unfold.
cards.s_text: And Mahlallel the son of Cainan lived sixty-five years and he begat Jared; and Jared lived sixty-two years and he begat Enoch.
cards.t_text: And in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî’êl the daughter of his father’s brother, and she bare him a son in the third week in the sixth year, and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men, and that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 5:18 — *And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:* Jasher 2:37 brings the line to Jared begetting Enoch, the same generation Genesis fixes before the one who walked with Elohim.
cards.s_text: And Mahlallel the son of Cainan lived sixty-five years and he begat Jared; and Jared lived sixty-two years and he begat Enoch.
cards.t_text: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

cards.note: Genesis 5:15 — *And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:* Jasher 2:37 carries the same sixty-five-year reckoning of Mahalaleel begetting Jared in the chosen line.
cards.s_text: And Mahlallel the son of Cainan lived sixty-five years and he begat Jared; and Jared lived sixty-two years and he begat Enoch.
cards.t_text: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

cards.note: Jubilees 4:31 — *Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.* Both Jasher 2:29 and Jubilees end Cain in measure-for-measure judgment for Abel's blood — the same event, both now live.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (the Lord) requited Cain’s evil according to his wickedness, which he had done to his brother Abel, according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) which he had spoken.
cards.t_text: At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones, for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.

cards.note: Genesis 4:15 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And Yahuah (LORD) set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.* Jasher 2:29 reads Cain's death by Lamech's arrow as the Lord requiting his wickedness, the sevenfold word at last fulfilled.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (the Lord) requited Cain’s evil according to his wickedness, which he had done to his brother Abel, according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) which he had spoken.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And Yahuah (LORD) set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

cards.note: Genesis 4:23 — *And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.* Jasher 2:35 expands this very song of Lamech, supplying the story of the man and young man he slew.
cards.s_text: And he said to his wives Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice O wives of Lamech, attend to my words, for now you have imagined and said that I slew a man with my wounds, and a child with my stripes for their having done no violence, but surely know that I am old and grey-headed, and that my eyes are heavy through age, and I did this thing unknowingly.
cards.t_text: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; you wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

cards.note: Genesis 4:22 — *And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.* Jasher 2:24-25 names Zillah's children Tubal Cain and Naamah just as Genesis closes the line of Cain with its smith and his sister.
cards.s_text: And she conceived and bare a son and she called his name Tubal Cain, saying, After I had withered away have I obtained him from El Shaddai (the Almighty God).
cards.t_text: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.

cards.note: Genesis 4:21 — *And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.* Jasher 2:18 names Jubal as the second son born to Adah, the same brother Genesis makes father of the musicians.
cards.s_text: And she again conceived and bare a son, and called his name Jubal; and Zillah, her sister, was barren in those days and had no offspring.
cards.t_text: And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

cards.note: Genesis 4:20 — *And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.* Jasher 2:17 names Jabal as Adah's son exactly as Genesis records the father of the herdsmen.
cards.s_text: And Lamech, the son of Methusael, became related to Cainan by marriage, and he took his two daughters for his wives, and Adah conceived and bare a son to Lamech, and she called his name Jabal.
cards.t_text: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

cards.note: Genesis 4:19 — *And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.* Jasher 2:17 names the same two wives of Lamech, Adah and Zillah, retelling the Cainite genealogy.
cards.s_text: And Lamech, the son of Methusael, became related to Cainan by marriage, and he took his two daughters for his wives, and Adah conceived and bare a son to Lamech, and she called his name Jabal.
cards.t_text: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.* Cainan's writing of things to come on stone tablets in Jasher 2:13 mirrors the chosen line's scribal foreknowledge that Jubilees gives to Enoch.
cards.s_text: And in those days Cainan wrote upon tablets of stone, what was to take place in time to come, and he put them in his treasures.
cards.t_text: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.

cards.note: Genesis 5:12 — *And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:* Jasher 2:15 keeps the same seventieth-year reckoning for Cainan's offspring that the seed-line record fixes in Genesis.
cards.s_text: And when Cainan was seventy years old, he begat three sons and two daughters.
cards.t_text: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

cards.note: Genesis 5:9 — *And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:* Jasher 2:10 carries the genealogy verbatim, Enosh begetting Cainan at ninety years, before expanding him into the wise ruler.
cards.s_text: And Enosh lived ninety years and he begat Cainan;
cards.t_text: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

cards.note: Genesis 5:29 — *And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which Yahuah (LORD) hath cursed.* The thorns and barren ground of Jasher 2:8 are the curse on the earth that Genesis itself remembers from Adam's day down to Noah.
cards.s_text: And the seed which they sowed in those days in the ground became thorns, thistles and briers; for from the days of Adam was this declaration concerning the earth, of the curse of Elohim, which he cursed the earth, on account of the sin which Adam sinned before Yahuah (the Lord).
cards.t_text: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which Yahuah (LORD) has cursed.

cards.note: Romans 1:23 — *And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.* The images of brass, iron, wood and stone of Jasher 2:4 are the idolatry Sha'ul indicts — the glory of God exchanged for an image.
cards.s_text: And the sons of men went and they served other gods, and they forgot Yahuah (the Lord) who had created them in the earth: and in those days the sons of men made images of brass and iron, wood and stone, and they bowed down and served them.
cards.t_text: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

cards.note: Romans 1:21 — *Because that, when they knew Elohim (God), they glorified him not as Elohim (God), neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.* Sha'ul names the same fall Jasher 2:4 describes — men who knew their Creator yet forgot Him and served other gods.
cards.s_text: And the sons of men went and they served other gods, and they forgot Yahuah (the Lord) who had created them in the earth: and in those days the sons of men made images of brass and iron, wood and stone, and they bowed down and served them.
cards.t_text: Because that, when they knew Elohim (God), they glorified him not as Elohim (God), neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Jasher 2:5 sets its account of the days of Enosh against the very generation Genesis marks as the beginning of calling on the Name, the two lines diverging.
cards.s_text: And every man made his god and they bowed down to them, and the sons of men forsook Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Enosh and his children; and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled on account of their works and abominations which they did in the earth.
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Jubilees 4:7 — *Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said "Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him."* Jubilees narrates the identical appointed-seed scene of Jasher 2:1 — both now live, the same election.
cards.s_text: And it was in the hundred and thirtieth year of the life of Adam upon the earth, that he again knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare a son in his likeness and in his image, and she called his name Seth, saying, Because Elohim (God) has appointed me another seed in the place of Abel, for Cain has slain him.
cards.t_text: And Adam and his wife mourned for Abel four weeks of years, and in the fourth year of the fifth week they became joyful, and Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said “Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.”

cards.note: Genesis 5:6 — *And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:* Jasher 2:2 traces the chosen line one more generation, Seth begetting Enosh at a hundred and five years.
cards.s_text: And Seth lived one hundred and five years, and he begat a son; and Seth called the name of his son Enosh, saying, Because in that time the sons of men began to multiply, and to afflict their souls and hearts by transgressing and rebelling against Elohim.
cards.t_text: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

cards.note: Genesis 5:3 — *And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:* Jasher 2:1 fixes the same hundred-and-thirtieth year and the likeness-and-image language of the seed-line record.
cards.s_text: And it was in the hundred and thirtieth year of the life of Adam upon the earth, that he again knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare a son in his likeness and in his image, and she called his name Seth, saying, Because Elohim (God) has appointed me another seed in the place of Abel, for Cain has slain him.
cards.t_text: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

cards.note: Genesis 4:25 — *And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For Elohim (God), said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.* Jasher 2:1 carries the Genesis naming of Seth verbatim, the appointed seed set in Abel's place.
cards.s_text: And it was in the hundred and thirtieth year of the life of Adam upon the earth, that he again knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare a son in his likeness and in his image, and she called his name Seth, saying, Because Elohim (God) has appointed me another seed in the place of Abel, for Cain has slain him.
cards.t_text: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For Elohim (God), said she, has appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

cards.note: Genesis 5:21 — *And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:* the exact age and birth Jasher 3:1 opens with, retelling the Genesis seed-line.
cards.s_text: And Enoch lived sixty-five years and he begat Methuselah; and Enoch walked with Elohim (God) after having begot Methuselah, and he served Yahuah (the Lord), and despised the evil ways of men.
cards.t_text: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

cards.note: Genesis 5:22 — *And Enoch walked with Elohim (God) after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:* the walk Jasher 3:1 echoes, Enoch serving Yahuah and despising the evil ways of men.
cards.s_text: And Enoch lived sixty-five years and he begat Methuselah; and Enoch walked with Elohim (God) after having begot Methuselah, and he served Yahuah (the Lord), and despised the evil ways of men.
cards.t_text: And Enoch walked with Elohim (God) after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

cards.note: Genesis 5:18 — *And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:* the father whose son Jasher 3 expands, tracing Adam→Seth→Enoch through the chosen line.
cards.s_text: And Enoch lived sixty-five years and he begat Methuselah; and Enoch walked with Elohim (God) after having begot Methuselah, and he served Yahuah (the Lord), and despised the evil ways of men.
cards.t_text: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

cards.note: Jubilees 4:16 — *And in the eleventh jubilee Jared took to himself a wife... and she bare him a son in the fifth week, in the fourth year of the jubilee, and he called his name Enoch.* the same patriarchal birth Jasher 3:1 records, both tracing the seed-line generation by generation.
cards.s_text: And Enoch lived sixty-five years and he begat Methuselah; and Enoch walked with Elohim (God) after having begot Methuselah, and he served Yahuah (the Lord), and despised the evil ways of men.
cards.t_text: And in the eleventh jubilee Jared took to himself a wife, and her name was Bâraka, the daughter of Râsûjâl, a daughter of his father’s brother, in the fourth week of this jubilee, and she bare him a son in the fifth week, in the fourth year of the jubilee, and he called his name Enoch.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 12:1 — *Before these things Enoch was hidden, and no one of the children of men knew where he was hidden, and where he abode, and what had become of him.* the same withdrawal Jasher 3:2 describes when Enoch secreted himself from men for many days.
cards.s_text: And the soul of Enoch was wrapped up in the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord), in knowledge and in understanding; and he wisely retired from the sons of men, and secreted himself from them for many days.
cards.t_text: Before these things Enoch was hidden, and no one of the children of men knew where he was hidden, and where he abode, and what had become of him.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 12:3 — *And I Enoch was blessing Yahuah (God) of majesty and the King of the ages, and lo! the Watchers called me—Enoch the scribe—and said to me:* the teaching, righteous-scribe Enoch Jasher 3:5 sends out to instruct the sons of men.
cards.s_text: And Enoch rose up according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and went forth from his house, from his place and from the chamber in which he was concealed; and he went to the sons of men and taught them the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and at that time assembled the sons of men and acquainted them with the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord).
cards.t_text: And I Enoch was blessing Yahuah (Lord) of majesty and the King of the ages, and lo! the Watchers called me—Enoch the scribe—and said to me:

cards.note: Jubilees 4:17–18 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom... And he was the first to write a testimony, and he testified to the sons of men among the generations of the earth* the wisdom Jasher 3:8 says the spirit of Elohim gave Enoch to teach all his men.
cards.s_text: And the spirit of Elohim was upon Enoch, and he taught all his men the wisdom of Elohim and his ways, and the sons of Adam served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Enoch, and they came to hear his wisdom.
cards.t_text: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 44:16 — *Enoch pleased Yahuah (God), and was translated, being an example of repentance to all generations.* the teacher of righteousness Jasher 3:8 portrays, set down as an example for every generation.
cards.s_text: And the spirit of Elohim was upon Enoch, and he taught all his men the wisdom of Elohim and his ways, and the sons of Adam served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Enoch, and they came to hear his wisdom.
cards.t_text: Enoch pleased Yahuah (God), and was translated, being an example of repentance to all generations.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 44:3 — *Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies:* the wise fathers the kings sought, as Jasher 3:9 has the kings come to Enoch's wisdom and ask him to reign.
cards.s_text: And all the kings of the sons of men, both first and last, together with their princes and judges, came to Enoch when they heard of his wisdom, and they bowed down to him, and they also required of Enoch to reign over them, to which he consented.
cards.t_text: Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies:

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 44:10 — *But these were merciful men, whose righteousness has not been forgotten.* the justice and righteousness Jasher 3:12 says Enoch did with all his people through his reign.
cards.s_text: And Enoch reigned over the sons of Adam two hundred and forty-three years, and he did justice and righteousness with all his people, and he led them in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord).
cards.t_text: But these were merciful men, whose righteousness has not been forgotten.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 44:11 — *With their seed shall continually remain a good inheritance, and their children are within the covenant.* the covenant seed-line whose righteous reign Jasher 3:12 carries forward in the ways of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: And Enoch reigned over the sons of Adam two hundred and forty-three years, and he did justice and righteousness with all his people, and he led them in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord).
cards.t_text: With their seed shall continually remain a good inheritance, and their children are within the covenant.

cards.note: Genesis 5:5 — *And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.* the exact age Jasher 3:14 gives for Adam's death during Enoch's reign.
cards.s_text: And it was in the fifty-sixth year of the life of Lamech when Adam died; nine hundred and thirty years old was he at his death, and his two sons, with Enoch and Methuselah his son, buried him with great pomp, as at the burial of kings, in the cave which Elohim had told him.
cards.t_text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:30 — *And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: "On the day that you eat thereof you will die."* the very tree-of-knowledge death Jasher 3:16 names as the cause of Adam's dying.
cards.s_text: And Adam died because he ate of the tree of knowledge; he and his children after him, as Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) had spoken.
cards.t_text: And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: “On the day that you eat thereof you will die.” For this reason he did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:29 — *And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee... Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.* the burial Jasher 3:14 records with Enoch and Methuselah laying Adam in the cave with great pomp.
cards.s_text: And it was in the fifty-sixth year of the life of Lamech when Adam died; nine hundred and thirty years old was he at his death, and his two sons, with Enoch and Methuselah his son, buried him with great pomp, as at the burial of kings, in the cave which Elohim had told him.
cards.t_text: And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee, in the seventh week in the sixth year thereof, Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 5:24 — *And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.* the five-word canon source Jasher 3:36 unfolds into Enoch's ascent in a whirlwind with chariots of fire.
cards.s_text: And when the kings returned they caused a census to be taken, in order to know the number of remaining men that went with Enoch; and it was upon the seventh day that Enoch ascended into heaven in a whirlwind, with horses and chariots of fire.
cards.t_text: And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:5 — *By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).* the translation Jasher 3:36 narrates, read as faith in the Renewed Covenant.
cards.s_text: And when the kings returned they caused a census to be taken, in order to know the number of remaining men that went with Enoch; and it was upon the seventh day that Enoch ascended into heaven in a whirlwind, with horses and chariots of fire.
cards.t_text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 Enoch 39:3 — *And in those days a whirlwind carried me off from the earth, And set me down at the end of the heavens.* The whirlwind that carried Enoch off from the earth is the whirlwind Jasher 3:36 gives for his ascent, told here by Enoch himself.
cards.s_text: And when the kings returned they caused a census to be taken, in order to know the number of remaining men that went with Enoch; and it was upon the seventh day that Enoch ascended into heaven in a whirlwind, with horses and chariots of fire.
cards.t_text: And in those days a whirlwind carried me off from the earth, And set me down at the end of the heavens.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:23 — *And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world* the taking-up Jasher 3:23 sets in motion when the angel calls Enoch to reign in heaven.
cards.s_text: And in some time after, when the kings and princes and the sons of men were speaking to Enoch, and Enoch was teaching them the ways of Elohim, behold an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) then called to Enoch from heaven, and wished to bring him up to heaven to make him reign there over the sons of Elohim, as he had reigned over the sons of men upon earth.
cards.t_text: And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world, and all the wickedness of the children of men.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 71:1 — *And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim (God). They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.* the heavenly translation Jasher 3:36 records, even the snow Jasher 3:38 finds at the place of his ascent.
cards.s_text: And when the kings returned they caused a census to be taken, in order to know the number of remaining men that went with Enoch; and it was upon the seventh day that Enoch ascended into heaven in a whirlwind, with horses and chariots of fire.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim (God). They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.

cards.note: Jude 1:14 — *And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) cometh with ten thousands of his saints,* the prophetic Enoch whose final statutes and judgments Jasher 3:26 has him place before the sons of men.
cards.s_text: And he taught them wisdom and knowledge, and gave them instruction, and he reproved them, and he placed before them statutes and judgments to do upon earth, and he made peace amongst them, and he taught them everlasting life, and dwelt with them some time teaching them all these things.
cards.t_text: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) comes with ten thousands of his saints,

cards.note: Jude 1:15 — *To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed* the coming judgment behind the instruction Jasher 3:26 says Enoch gave for how to live upon earth.
cards.s_text: And he taught them wisdom and knowledge, and gave them instruction, and he reproved them, and he placed before them statutes and judgments to do upon earth, and he made peace amongst them, and he taught them everlasting life, and dwelt with them some time teaching them all these things.
cards.t_text: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:19 — *And what was and what will be he saw in a vision of his sleep... he saw and understood everything, and wrote his testimony, and placed the testimony on earth for all the children of men and for their generations.* the parting wisdom Jasher 3:25 has Enoch leave so the sons of men may live.
cards.s_text: And now therefore I will teach you wisdom and knowledge and will give you instruction before I leave you, how to act upon earth by which you may live; and he did so.
cards.t_text: And what was and what will be he saw in a vision of his sleep, as it will happen to the children of men throughout their generations until the day of judgment; he saw and understood everything, and wrote his testimony, and placed the testimony on earth for all the children of men and for their generations.

cards.note: *And all the sons of Adam assembled and came to Enoch that day; and all the kings of the earth with their princes and counsellors remained with him that day; and Enoch then taught the sons of men wisdom and knowledge, and gave them divine instruction; and he bade them serve Yahuah (the Lord) and walk in his ways all the days of their lives, and he continued to make peace amongst them.* (Jasher 3:31). *And on account of it Elohim (God) brought the waters of the flood upon all the land of Eden; for there he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount all the deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.* (Jubilees 4:24). Jubilees tells why Enoch was taken: he was set as a sign against all the children of men, to recount the deeds of every generation until the day of condemnation. Jasher shows him doing that very work on his last day among them, gathering the sons of Adam and the kings of the earth, teaching them wisdom and knowledge, and bidding them serve Yahuah (the Lord) and walk in his ways. The witness who will testify against the generations first pleaded with them to walk right while he was still in reach.
cards.s_text: And all the sons of Adam assembled and came to Enoch that day; and all the kings of the earth with their princes and counsellors remained with him that day; and Enoch then taught the sons of men wisdom and knowledge, and gave them divine instruction; and he bade them serve Yahuah (the Lord) and walk in his ways all the days of their lives, and he continued to make peace amongst them.
cards.t_text: And on account of it Elohim (God) brought the waters of the flood upon all the land of Eden; for there he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount all the deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:5 — *But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).* The same election of Noah out of the doomed world that Jasher 4:21 declares.
cards.s_text: And Noah found grace in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him and his children to raise up seed from them upon the face of the whole earth.
cards.t_text: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:5 — *And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;* the saving of Noah and the coming flood Jasher 4:20-21 sets up as the righteous die and Noah is chosen.
cards.s_text: And Noah found grace in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him and his children to raise up seed from them upon the face of the whole earth.
cards.t_text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* The judgment on the fallen ones whose corruption Jasher 4 details and Jasher 4:19 brings to the verge of the Flood.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said, I will blot out man that I created from the face of the earth, yea from man to the birds of the air, together with cattle and beasts that are in the field for I repent that I made them.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: Genesis 6:8 — *But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).* The grace and election Jasher 4:21 expands as Yahuah choosing Noah and his children to raise up seed.
cards.s_text: And Noah found grace in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him and his children to raise up seed from them upon the face of the whole earth.
cards.t_text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 6:7 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.* The blotting-out decree, even to the birds of the air, that Jasher 4:19 records.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said, I will blot out man that I created from the face of the earth, yea from man to the birds of the air, together with cattle and beasts that are in the field for I repent that I made them.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:2 — *And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth...* the same mixture of all flesh, men and animals, that Jasher 4:18 says corrupted its ways upon earth.
cards.s_text: And their judges and rulers went to the daughters of men and took their wives by force from their husbands according to their choice, and the sons of men in those days took from the cattle of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and taught the mixture of animals of one species with the other, in order therewith to provoke Yahuah (the Lord); and Elohim saw the whole earth and it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon earth, all men and all animals.
cards.t_text: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 8:2 — *And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways...* the taught corruptions and mixtures Jasher 4:18 says provoked Yahuah and corrupted all flesh.
cards.s_text: And their judges and rulers went to the daughters of men and took their wives by force from their husbands according to their choice, and the sons of men in those days took from the cattle of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and taught the mixture of animals of one species with the other, in order therewith to provoke Yahuah (the Lord); and Elohim saw the whole earth and it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon earth, all men and all animals.
cards.t_text: And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 6:2 — *And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: 'Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.'* The fallen-ones' descent Jasher 4:18 narrates as the rulers taking wives by force.
cards.s_text: And their judges and rulers went to the daughters of men and took their wives by force from their husbands according to their choice, and the sons of men in those days took from the cattle of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and taught the mixture of animals of one species with the other, in order therewith to provoke Yahuah (the Lord); and Elohim saw the whole earth and it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon earth, all men and all animals.
cards.t_text: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

cards.note: Genesis 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* The whole-earth corruption of all flesh Jasher 4:18 says Elohim saw upon the earth.
cards.s_text: And their judges and rulers went to the daughters of men and took their wives by force from their husbands according to their choice, and the sons of men in those days took from the cattle of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and taught the mixture of animals of one species with the other, in order therewith to provoke Yahuah (the Lord); and Elohim saw the whole earth and it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon earth, all men and all animals.
cards.t_text: The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* The taking of wives by force Jasher 4:18 ascribes to the judges and rulers going to the daughters of men.
cards.s_text: And their judges and rulers went to the daughters of men and took their wives by force from their husbands according to their choice, and the sons of men in those days took from the cattle of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and taught the mixture of animals of one species with the other, in order therewith to provoke Yahuah (the Lord); and Elohim saw the whole earth and it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon earth, all men and all animals.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:19 — *...no man's person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons... for his heart was righteous in all his ways...* the same righteous Noah Jasher 4:15 says walked perfect and upright with Elohim while all flesh corrupted.
cards.s_text: And the child grew up and was weaned, and he went in the ways of his father Methuselah, perfect and upright with Elohim.
cards.t_text: And as for all those who corrupted their ways and their thoughts before the flood, no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways, according as it was commanded regarding him, and he had not departed from aught that was ordained for him.

cards.note: Genesis 6:9 — *These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with Elohim (God).* The perfect and upright walk Jasher 4:15 says Noah grew into in the ways of Methuselah.
cards.s_text: And the child grew up and was weaned, and he went in the ways of his father Methuselah, perfect and upright with Elohim.
cards.t_text: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 5:29 — *And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which Yahuah (LORD) hath cursed.* The naming Jasher 4:14 expands into Methuselah's and Lamech's twin sayings of rest and comfort.
cards.s_text: And Methuselah called his name Noah, saying, The earth was in his days at rest and free from corruption, and Lamech his father called his name Menachem, saying, This one shall comfort us in our works and miserable toil in the earth, which Elohim had cursed.
cards.t_text: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which Yahuah (LORD) has cursed.

cards.note: Genesis 5:28 — *And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:* the Lamech of the chosen line whose age Jasher 4:9 fixes at the death of Seth.
cards.s_text: In those days when Lamech the son of Methuselah was one hundred and sixty years old, Seth the son of Adam died.
cards.t_text: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

cards.note: Genesis 5:8 — *And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.* The exact nine hundred and twelve years Jasher 4:10 records for Seth the son of Adam.
cards.s_text: And all the days that Seth lived, were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.
cards.t_text: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

cards.note: Genesis 3:18 — *Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;* the Eden curse pressed on the rebel earth as thorns and thistles spring where Jasher 4:6 says they did not sow.
cards.s_text: For when they sowed the ground in order that they might obtain food for their support, behold, thorns and thistles were produced which they did not sow.
cards.t_text: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to you; and you shall eat the herb of the field;

cards.note: Genesis 6:6 — *And it repented Yahuah (LORD) that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.* The very grief Jasher 4:7 names when Yahuah repents that he had made man.
cards.s_text: And still the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and their hands were still extended to do evil in the sight of Elohim, and they provoked Yahuah (the Lord) with their evil ways, and Yahuah (the Lord) was very wroth, and repented that he had made man.
cards.t_text: And it repented Yahuah (LORD) that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

cards.note: Genesis 6:5 — *And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.* The whole-earth wickedness Jasher 4:4-7 details as robbing, plundering and rebellion.
cards.s_text: And still the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and their hands were still extended to do evil in the sight of Elohim, and they provoked Yahuah (the Lord) with their evil ways, and Yahuah (the Lord) was very wroth, and repented that he had made man.
cards.t_text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

cards.note: Genesis 5:25 — *And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:* the seed-line Jasher 4:3 keeps as Methuselah, taught by Enoch, walks uprightly and teaches the sons of men.
cards.s_text: And Methuselah acted uprightly in the sight of Elohim (God), as his father Enoch had taught him, and he likewise during the whole of his life taught the sons of men wisdom, knowledge and the fear of Elohim, and he did not turn from the good way either to the right or to the left.
cards.t_text: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

cards.note: Genesis 5:24 — *And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.* The canon's translation of Enoch is the ascent Jasher 4:2 narrates before Methuselah reigns in his place.
cards.s_text: And when Enoch had ascended into heaven, all the kings of the earth rose and took Methuselah his son and anointed him, and they caused him to reign over them in the place of his father.
cards.t_text: And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.

cards.note: Genesis 5:23 — *And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:* the very count Jasher 4:1 repeats for Enoch upon the earth.
cards.s_text: And all the days that Enoch lived upon earth, were three hundred and sixty-five years.
cards.t_text: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

cards.note: Genesis 5:8 — *And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.* Jasher's dying patriarchs are the same chosen Sethite line Genesis numbers and buries before the flood.
cards.s_text: And it was in the eighty-fourth year of the life of Noah, that Enoch the son of Seth died, he was nine hundred and five years old at his death.
cards.t_text: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

cards.note: Genesis 5:14 — *And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.* Genesis gives Cainan's exact nine hundred and ten years that Jasher 5:2 repeats.
cards.s_text: And in the one hundred and seventy ninth year of the life of Noah, Cainan the son of Enosh died, and all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.
cards.t_text: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

cards.note: Genesis 5:20 — *And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.* Jared's nine hundred sixty-two years in Jasher 5:4 stand verbatim with the canon roll of the seed-line.
cards.s_text: And Jared the son of Mahlallel died in those days, in the three hundred and thirty-sixth year of the life of Noah; and all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.
cards.t_text: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:19 — *And as for all those who corrupted their ways and their thoughts before the flood, no man's person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account...* The fathers who followed Yahuah die out (Jasher 5:5), leaving Noah alone as the accepted remnant.
cards.s_text: And all who followed Yahuah (the Lord) died in those days, before they saw the evil which Elohim (God) declared to do upon earth.
cards.t_text: And as for all those who corrupted their ways and their thoughts before the flood, no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways, according as it was commanded regarding him, and he had not departed from aught that was ordained for him.

cards.note: Genesis 6:3 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.* Jasher 5:8 unfolds this same hundred and twenty year reprieve as a spoken call to repent.
cards.s_text: For thus says Yahuah (the Lord), Behold I give you a period of one hundred and twenty years; if you will turn to me and forsake your evil ways, then will I also turn away from the evil which I told you, and it shall not exist, says Yahuah (the Lord).
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:5 — *And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly.* The apostle names the preaching office Jasher 5:9 shows Noah and Methuselah filling day after day.
cards.s_text: And Noah and Methuselah spoke all the words of Yahuah (the Lord) to the sons of men, day after day, constantly speaking to them.
cards.t_text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

cards.note: *And He said “Your spirit will not always abide on man; for they also are flesh and their days shall be one hundred and twenty years.”* (Jubilees 5:8). *For thus says Yahuah (the Lord), Behold I give you a period of one hundred and twenty years; if you will turn to me and forsake your evil ways, then will I also turn away from the evil which I told you, and it shall not exist, says Yahuah (the Lord).* (Jasher 5:8). Both books put the same number on the same mercy. In Jubilees it is a limit set on flesh: the Spirit will not always abide on man, and a hundred and twenty years is the measure. Jasher hears it as a door left open: a period of a hundred and twenty years, and if you will turn to me the evil will not come. Genesis 6:3 carries the number; these two tell you it was a space for repentance before the flood, not merely a lifespan. The decree and the offer were the same hundred and twenty years.
cards.s_text: For thus says Yahuah (the Lord), Behold I give you a period of one hundred and twenty years; if you will turn to me and forsake your evil ways, then will I also turn away from the evil which I told you, and it shall not exist, says Yahuah (the Lord).
cards.t_text: And He said “Your spirit will not always abide on man; for they also are flesh and their days shall be one hundred and twenty years.”

cards.note: Genesis 6:9 — *These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with Elohim (God).* Jasher 5:13 repeats the canon's just-and-perfect verdict that grounds Noah's election.
cards.s_text: And Noah was a just man, he was perfect in his generation, and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him to raise up seed from his seed upon the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 6:8 — *But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).* The grace Genesis names is the choosing Jasher 5:14 voices when the LORD bids Noah beget seed.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, Take to you a wife, and beget children, for I have seen you righteous before me in this generation.
cards.t_text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Hebrews 11:7 — *By faith Noah, being warned of Elohim (God) of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.* The faith-righteousness of the Companion is the same just man Jasher 5:13 says God chose to raise seed.
cards.s_text: And Noah was a just man, he was perfect in his generation, and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him to raise up seed from his seed upon the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: By faith Noah, being warned of Elohim (God) of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

cards.note: Genesis 6:10 — *And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.* Jasher 5:17 names the same sons through whom the remnant seed is carried past the flood.
cards.s_text: And Naamah conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Japheth, saying, Elohim has enlarged me in the earth; and she conceived again and bare a son, and he called his name Shem, saying, Elohim has made me a remnant, to raise up seed in the midst of the earth.
cards.t_text: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

cards.note: *And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth.* (Jasher 5:25). *And Elohim (God) said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.* (Genesis 6:13). Jasher carries the decree of Genesis nearly word for word: the end of all flesh is come before me, and behold I will destroy the earth. Where Genesis names the cause as violence filling the earth, Jasher names it as their evil deeds, and the two are one charge told by two witnesses. The same Yahuah (the Lord) who spoke to Noah speaks in both records, and the judgment on all flesh is settled before the ark is ever named.
cards.s_text: And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 6:14 — *Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.* The gopher-wood ark Jasher 5:26 commands is the very ark of the Torah.
cards.s_text: And do you take to you gopher wood, and go to a certain place and make a large ark, and place it in that spot.
cards.t_text: Make you an ark of gopher wood; rooms shall you make in the ark, and shall pitch it within and without with pitch.

cards.note: Genesis 6:15 — *And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.* Jasher 5:27 gives the identical three-hundred-by-fifty-by-thirty cubit measure.
cards.s_text: And thus shall you make it; three hundred cubits its length, fifty cubits broad and thirty cubits high.
cards.t_text: And this is the fashion which you shall make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

cards.note: Genesis 6:17 — *And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.* Jasher 5:29's flood of waters destroying all flesh matches the canon's own threat.
cards.s_text: And behold I will bring the flood of waters upon the earth, and all flesh be destroyed, from under the heavens all that is upon earth shall perish.
cards.t_text: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

cards.note: Genesis 6:18 — *But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.* The covenant of preservation rides on the same word of judgment Jasher 5:25 reports.
cards.s_text: And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth.
cards.t_text: But with you will I establish my covenant; and you shall come into the ark, you, and your sons, and your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

cards.note: Genesis 6:19 — *And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.* Jasher 5:30's two couple of all living things, male and female, is the Torah's own command to preserve the seed.
cards.s_text: And you and your household shall go and gather two couple of all living things, male and female, and shall bring them to the ark, to raise up seed from them upon earth.
cards.t_text: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shall you bring into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.

cards.note: Genesis 6:21 — *And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.* The provisioning Jasher 5:31 records is the canon's identical charge to gather food for man and beast.
cards.s_text: And gather to you all food that is eaten by all the animals, that there may be food for you and for them.
cards.t_text: And take you unto you of all food that is eaten, and you shall gather it to you; and it shall be for food for you, and for them.

cards.note: Genesis 6:22 — *Thus did Noah; according to all that Elohim (God) commanded him, so did he.* Jasher 5:33's obedient ark-building is the Torah's summary verdict that Noah did all as commanded.
cards.s_text: And Noah rose up, and he made the ark, in the place where Elohim had commanded him, and Noah did as Elohim had ordered him.
cards.t_text: Thus did Noah; according to all that Elohim (God) commanded him, so did he.

cards.note: *And Noah made the ark in all respects as He commanded him, in the twenty-seventh jubilee of years, in the fifth week in the fifth year (on the new moon of the first month).* (Jubilees 5:22). *And Noah rose up, and he made the ark, in the place where Elohim had commanded him, and Noah did as Elohim had ordered him.* (Jasher 5:33). Jasher says Noah rose up and made the ark where Elohim (God) commanded; Jubilees says he made it in all respects as He commanded, and gives the date. Obedience is the point in both. Jubilees adds the calendar, the twenty-seventh jubilee, fifth week, fifth year, on the new moon of the first month, because Jubilees counts everything by the reckoning of time Yahuah (God) gave. The ark was built on command, in the right place, and on a dated day.
cards.s_text: And Noah rose up, and he made the ark, in the place where Elohim had commanded him, and Noah did as Elohim had ordered him.
cards.t_text: And Noah made the ark in all respects as He commanded him, in the twenty-seventh jubilee of years, in the fifth week in the fifth year (on the new moon of the first month).

cards.note: Genesis 7:1 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.* Jasher's seen-righteous verdict and household-gathering (5:14, 5:35) lead straight into the canon's call to enter the ark.
cards.s_text: Then Noah took the three daughters of Eliakim, son of Methuselah, for wives for his sons, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Noah.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Noah, Come you and all your house into the ark; for you have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

cards.note: Genesis 7:2 — *Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.* The clean/unclean distinction stands before Sinai — Torah already in force as Jasher 5:30 gathers the living kinds.
cards.s_text: And you and your household shall go and gather two couple of all living things, male and female, and shall bring them to the ark, to raise up seed from them upon earth.
cards.t_text: Of every clean beast you shall take to you by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

cards.note: Genesis 7:5 — *And Noah did according unto all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded him.* The obedient Noah of Jasher 5:33 is the canon's same man who did all the LORD commanded.
cards.s_text: And Noah rose up, and he made the ark, in the place where Elohim had commanded him, and Noah did as Elohim had ordered him.
cards.t_text: And Noah did according unto all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded him.

cards.note: *’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.* (1 Enoch 10:2). *The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth* (Jasher 5:25). Jasher gives the word to Noah; 1 Enoch gives the messenger. An angel was sent in Yahuah's (the Lord's) name to tell Noah to hide himself, that the end was approaching and a deluge would destroy everything on the earth. Two books carry the same warning to the same man.
cards.s_text: And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth.
cards.t_text: ’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.

cards.note: Genesis 7:2 — *Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.* The clean-by-sevens command Jasher 6:9 retells, the Torah distinction kept before Sinai.
cards.s_text: Two and two came to Noah into the ark, but from the clean animals, and clean fowls, he brought seven couples, as Elohim (God) had commanded him.
cards.t_text: Of every clean beast you shall take to you by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

cards.note: Genesis 7:9 — *There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as Elohim (God) had commanded Noah.* The two-and-two ingathering of Jasher 6:9, the same scene quoted beside its source.
cards.s_text: Two and two came to Noah into the ark, but from the clean animals, and clean fowls, he brought seven couples, as Elohim (God) had commanded him.
cards.t_text: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as Elohim (God) had commanded Noah.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:23 — *he entered, and all that we brought to him, into the ark, and Yahuah (God) closed it from without on the seventeenth evening.* Jubilees keeps the same record of the creatures brought in that Jasher 6:8 narrates, both witnesses now live.
cards.s_text: And Noah brought into the ark from all living creatures that were upon earth, so that there was none left but which Noah brought into the ark.
cards.t_text: And he entered in the sixth (year) thereof, in the second month, on the new moon of the second month, till the sixteenth; and he entered, and all that we brought to him, into the ark, and Yahuah (God) closed it from without on the seventeenth evening.

cards.note: Genesis 7:11 — *In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.* The fountains and windows of Jasher 6:14, the Genesis source dated to the day.
cards.s_text: And all the fountains of the deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened, and the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
cards.t_text: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

cards.note: Genesis 7:12 — *And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.* The forty days and nights Jasher 6:14 carries verbatim from its source.
cards.s_text: And all the fountains of the deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened, and the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
cards.t_text: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 89:3 — *And I saw again, and behold fountains were opened on the surface of that great enclosure, and that water began to swell and rise upon the surface, and I saw that enclosure till all its surface was covered with water.* Enoch's Animal Apocalypse sees the same fountains opened that Jasher 6:14 names, the flood-vision live beside it.
cards.s_text: And all the fountains of the deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened, and the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
cards.t_text: And I saw again, and behold fountains were opened on the surface of that great enclosure, and that water began to swell and rise upon the surface, and I saw that enclosure till all its surface was covered with water.

cards.note: *And all the fountains of the deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened, and the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.* (Jasher 6:14). *And Yahuah (God) opened seven flood-gates of heaven, And the mouths of the fountains of the great deep, seven mouths in number.* (Jubilees 5:24). Both witnesses open the flood from above and from beneath at once. Jasher says the fountains of the deep were broken up and the windows of heaven were opened; Jubilees counts them, seven flood-gates of heaven and seven mouths of the great deep. The rain of forty days and forty nights in Jasher is the same water Jubilees watches Yahuah (God) release by his own hand, so the flood is not weather but judgment ordered from the throne.
cards.s_text: And all the fountains of the deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened, and the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) opened seven flood-gates of heaven, And the mouths of the fountains of the great deep, seven mouths in number.

cards.note: Genesis 7:16 — *And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as Elohim (God) had commanded him: and Yahuah (LORD) shut him in.* The very shutting-in of Jasher 6:15, quoted beside its source.
cards.s_text: And Noah and his household, and all the living creatures that were with him, came into the ark on account of the waters of the flood, and Yahuah (the Lord) shut him in.
cards.t_text: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as Elohim (God) had commanded him: and Yahuah (LORD) shut him in.

cards.note: Genesis 7:23 — *And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.* The death of all flesh and the remnant of Jasher 6:26, the Genesis verdict beside it.
cards.s_text: And the rain was still descending upon the earth, and it descended forty days and forty nights, and the waters prevailed greatly upon the earth; and all flesh that was upon the earth or in the waters died, whether men, animals, beasts, creeping things or birds of the air, and there only remained Noah and those that were with him in the ark.
cards.t_text: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 89:6 — *But that vessel floated on the water, while all the oxen and elephants and camels and asses sank to the bottom with all the animals, so that I could no longer see them, and they were not able to escape, (but) perished and sank into the depths.* Enoch's vision of all the beasts drowned while the vessel floats matches the all-flesh-died of Jasher 6:26.
cards.s_text: And the rain was still descending upon the earth, and it descended forty days and forty nights, and the waters prevailed greatly upon the earth; and all flesh that was upon the earth or in the waters died, whether men, animals, beasts, creeping things or birds of the air, and there only remained Noah and those that were with him in the ark.
cards.t_text: But that vessel floated on the water, while all the oxen and elephants and camels and asses sank to the bottom with all the animals, so that I could no longer see them, and they were not able to escape, (but) perished and sank into the depths.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:19 — *no man's person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways.* Jubilees names the same righteous remnant shut into the ark of Jasher 6:15, the election of the seed-line kept.
cards.s_text: And Noah and his household, and all the living creatures that were with him, came into the ark on account of the waters of the flood, and Yahuah (the Lord) shut him in.
cards.t_text: And as for all those who corrupted their ways and their thoughts before the flood, no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways, according as it was commanded regarding him, and he had not departed from aught that was ordained for him.

cards.note: Genesis 7:17 — *And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.* The ark borne up of Jasher 6:27, the Genesis source quoted beside it.
cards.s_text: And the waters prevailed and they greatly increased upon the earth, and they lifted up the ark and it was raised from the earth.
cards.t_text: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 8:1 — *And Elohim (God) remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and Elohim (God) made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged.* The wind passing and the waters stilling of Jasher 6:33, the canon's I-remembered-him beside it.
cards.s_text: And a wind passed over the earth, and the waters were still and the ark rested.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and Elohim (God) made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;

cards.note: Genesis 8:4 — *And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.* The resting on Ararat of Jasher 6:35, dated to the day in its Genesis source.
cards.s_text: And the waters decreased in those days, and the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.
cards.t_text: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 89:8 — *Then the water began to run down into these, till the earth became visible; but that vessel settled on the earth, and the darkness retired and light appeared.* Enoch's vessel settling as the waters run down matches the ark borne up and resting of Jasher 6:27, 6:35.
cards.s_text: And the waters prevailed and they greatly increased upon the earth, and they lifted up the ark and it was raised from the earth.
cards.t_text: Then the water began to run down into these, till the earth became visible; but that vessel settled on the earth, and the darkness retired and light appeared.

cards.note: Genesis 8:16 — *Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.* The command to go out that Jasher 6:40 obeys, the Genesis source beside it.
cards.s_text: And the day came that Yahuah (the Lord) told them to go out, and they all went out from the ark.
cards.t_text: Go forth of the ark, you, and your wife, and your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

cards.note: Genesis 9:1 — *And Elohim (God) blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.* The be-fruitful blessing of Jasher 6:42, the Genesis charge to the renewed seed-line.
cards.s_text: And he said to them, Be fruitful and fill all the earth; become strong and increase abundantly in the earth and multiply in it.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

cards.note: *And he said to them, Be fruitful and fill all the earth; become strong and increase abundantly in the earth and multiply in it.* (Jasher 6:42). *"And you, increase you and multiply upon the earth, and become many upon it, and be a blessing upon it. The fear of you and the dread of you I shall inspire in everything that is on earth and in the sea.* (Jubilees 6:5). Jubilees gives the same charge in the same breath: increase, multiply upon the earth, become many upon it, and be a blessing upon it. Jasher's be fruitful and fill all the earth, become strong and increase abundantly, is one command heard by two witnesses, spoken by Yahuah (the Lord) to the same eight souls on the same day they came out of the ark. The earth emptied by judgment is handed back to Noah's house to fill.
cards.s_text: And he said to them, Be fruitful and fill all the earth; become strong and increase abundantly in the earth and multiply in it.
cards.t_text: "And you, increase you and multiply upon the earth, and become many upon it, and be a blessing upon it. The fear of you and the dread of you I shall inspire in everything that is on earth and in the sea.

cards.note: Genesis 8:20 — *And Noah builded an altar unto Yahuah (LORD); and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.* The service of Yahuah that Jasher 6:41 records is the clean-beast altar of Genesis, Torah-worship before Sinai.
cards.s_text: And they went and returned every one to his way and to his place, and Noah and his sons dwelt in the land that Elohim had told them, and they served Yahuah (the Lord) all their days, and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed Noah and his sons on their going out from the ark.
cards.t_text: And Noah builded an altar unto Yahuah (LORD); and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

cards.note: *And they went and returned every one to his way and to his place, and Noah and his sons dwelt in the land that Elohim had told them, and they served Yahuah (the Lord) all their days, and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed Noah and his sons on their going out from the ark.* (Jasher 6:41). *And Yahuah (LORD) smelled a sweet savour; and Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.* (Genesis 8:21). Genesis records what Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart after the flood, that he would not again curse the ground nor again smite every living thing, and Jasher records what that mercy looked like on the ground: Noah and his sons dwelt where Elohim (God) told them, served Yahuah (the Lord) all their days, and were blessed by him on their going out from the ark. The promise never to repeat the flood and the blessing on the family that came out of it are one kindness, spoken over the same ground on the same day the ark was emptied.
cards.s_text: And they went and returned every one to his way and to his place, and Noah and his sons dwelt in the land that Elohim had told them, and they served Yahuah (the Lord) all their days, and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed Noah and his sons on their going out from the ark.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) smelled a sweet savour; and Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

cards.note: Genesis 9:13 — *I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.* The bow sealing the covenant that crowns Noah's service in Jasher 6:41.
cards.s_text: And they went and returned every one to his way and to his place, and Noah and his sons dwelt in the land that Elohim had told them, and they served Yahuah (the Lord) all their days, and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed Noah and his sons on their going out from the ark.
