cards.t_text: You shall not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) proves you, to know whether you love Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) with all your heart and with all your soul.

cards.note: *But because Yahuah (LORD) loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath Yahuah (LORD) brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.* (Deuteronomy 7:8). The redemption from Egypt rested on nothing in Yashar'el (Israel) but on Yahuah (LORD)'s prior love — *because Yahuah (LORD) loved you.* John fixes the same order for the assembly: *We love him, because he first loved us* (1 John 4:19). The love that saves is not earned by the loved but poured out first by the One who loves; the apostle's *he first loved us* re-speaks the Torah's reason for the exodus — Yahuah (LORD)'s love precedes and creates the love of His people.
cards.s_text: We love him, because he first loved us.
cards.t_text: But because Yahuah (LORD) loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, has Yahuah (LORD) brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

cards.note: *Yahuah (LORD) did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:* (Deuteronomy 7:7). Yahuah (LORD) loved and chose Yashar'el (Israel) for no merit of theirs — not for number, not for greatness, but of His own free love. *We love him, because he first loved us* (1 John 4:19): our love is wholly answer, never cause. The Torah's reason — Yahuah (LORD) set His love freely, before and without any worthiness in the loved — is the ground of the apostle's order, His love first and ours only because of His.
cards.s_text: We love him, because he first loved us.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all people:

cards.note: *Yahuah (LORD) hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.* (Jeremiah 31:3). Yahuah (LORD)'s love is the *everlasting love* that draws — He loves first, and the drawing follows. John says no more and no less: *We love him, because he first loved us* (1 John 4:19). The lovingkindness that drew Yashar'el (Israel) is the first-loving the apostle names; our love is the response to a love that reached for us *of old,* an everlasting love that went before.
cards.s_text: We love him, because he first loved us.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) has appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved you with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn you.

cards.note: *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;* (Deuteronomy 30:15). Moses set before Yashar'el (Israel) *life and good, and death and evil* — a stark either/or. John sets the same before his hearers: *He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of Elohim (God) hath not life* (1 John 5:12). Life or death, with no third way; the choice Moses laid before the people is the choice the apostle lays before every soul, now centered in the Son in whom the Father gave the life.
cards.s_text: He that has the Son has life; and he that has not the Son of Elohim (God) has not life.
cards.t_text: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;

cards.note: *And now, Yashar'el (Israel), what doth Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) require of thee, but to fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thy heart and with all thy soul,* (Deuteronomy 10:12). Moses welds loving Yahuah (LORD) to walking in His ways and keeping His commandments (v.13). John welds the same two: *when we love Elohim (God), and keep his commandments* (1 John 5:2) — love and obedience are one act, as the Torah always taught.
cards.s_text: By this we know that we love the children of Elohim (God), when we love Elohim (God), and keep his commandments.
cards.t_text: And now, Yashar'el (Israel), what does Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) require of you, but to fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart and with all your soul,

cards.note: *Yahuah (LORD) shall reign for ever and ever* (Exodus 15:18). The song of the sea closes with the throne, and Psalm 10 answers the wicked's lie — *Elohim (God) hath forgotten... he will never see it* (10:11) — with the same word: *Yahuah (LORD) is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land* (Psalm 10:16). The King who delivered Yashar'el (Israel) at the sea and *shall reign for ever and ever* is the King who clears the wicked out of His land.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (LORD) is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) shall reign for ever and ever.

cards.note: *Yahuah (LORD) recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), under whose wings thou art come to trust* (Ruth 2:12). The plea *hide me under the shadow of thy wings* (Psalm 17:8) is the same shelter Boaz blesses over Ruth the gathered-in — *under whose wings thou art come to trust*. The wings of Yahuah cover both the psalmist of the covenant house and the stranger who comes to trust under them.
cards.s_text: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of your wings,
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) recompense your work, and a full reward be given you of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), under whose wings you are come to trust.

cards.note: *He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye* (Deuteronomy 32:10). David's *Keep me as the apple of the eye* (Psalm 17:8) is drawn straight from the Song of Moses: the covenant tenderness Yahuah bore to Yashar'el (Israel) in the wilderness — *he kept him as the apple of his eye* — is the very keeping David asks for his own soul. The wilderness-care of the whole house becomes the single suppliant's plea.
cards.s_text: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of your wings,
cards.t_text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

cards.note: *He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a Elohim (God) of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he* (Deuteronomy 32:4). When David sings *Yahuah (LORD) is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer* (Psalm 18:2), he sings the covenant title Moses sang first: the Rock whose work is perfect. The same Rock that bore Yashar'el (Israel) through the wilderness is David's fortress and deliverer.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (LORD) is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my Elohim (God), my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
cards.t_text: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a Elohim (God) of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

cards.note: *For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges* (Deuteronomy 32:31). David's confession *Yahuah (LORD) is my rock... in whom I will trust* (Psalm 18:2) is the same boast of Moses' song: there is no rock like our Rock. The idols of the nations are no rock; the deliverer of the king is the living Rock of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: Yahuah (LORD) is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my Elohim (God), my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
cards.t_text: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

cards.note: *And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ)* (1 Corinthians 10:4). Paul names the Rock outright: when David cries *Yahuah (LORD) is my rock* (Psalm 18:2), the Rock that followed Yashar'el (Israel) and gave them drink is the Formed Son — *that Rock was Messiah*. The Rock who led the fathers is the same Rock who is David's fortress and salvation.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (LORD) is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my Elohim (God), my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
cards.t_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: *And that the Gentiles might glorify Elohim (God) for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name* (Romans 15:9). Paul quotes Psalm 18:49 word for word: *Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Yahuah (LORD), among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name* (18:49) is *I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name*. He sets it as proof the nations glorify Elohim WITH His people — the ingathering, never a replacement; the heathen join David's praise, they do not supplant Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: Therefore will I give thanks unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), among the heathen, and sing praises unto your name.
cards.t_text: And that the Gentiles might glorify Elohim (God) for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to you among the Gentiles, and sing unto your name.

cards.note: *Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!* (Isaiah 31:1). *Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God)* (Psalm 20:7): the very trust the psalm renounces is the woe Isaiah pronounces — they *stay on horses, and trust in chariots* yet *look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel)*. The name-trust of the psalm is the looking-unto-the-Holy-One the prophet demands.
cards.s_text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
cards.t_text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!

cards.note: *For of a truth against thy holy child Yahusha (Jesus), whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Yashar'el (Israel), were gathered together* (Acts 4:27). *Yahuah (LORD) saveth his anointed* (Psalm 20:6): the assembly names the Anointed — *thy holy child Yahusha (Jesus), whom thou hast anointed* — and Yahuah saves him from his holy heaven. The anointed of Psalm 20 is the Mashiach raised and exalted, the Formed Son whom the Father anointed and delivered.
cards.s_text: Now know I that Yahuah (LORD) saves his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
cards.t_text: For of a truth against your holy child Yahusha (Jesus), whom you have anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Yashar'el (Israel), were gathered together,

cards.note: *And now, Yashar'el (Israel), what doth Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) require of thee, but to fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thy heart and with all thy soul.* (Deuteronomy 10:12). To *walk in all his ways* AND *to love him* stand together in Moses, as they do in John: *this is love, that we walk after his commandments* (2 John 6). The love and the walking are one charge, from the beginning.
cards.s_text: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.
cards.t_text: And now, Yashar'el (Israel), what does Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) require of you, but to fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart and with all your soul,

cards.note: *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;* (Deuteronomy 30:15). Here is the Two Ways at their root — Yahuah (LORD) sets before Yashar'el (Israel) *life and good, and death and evil.* John's test stands directly upon it: *follow not that which is evil, but that which is good* (3 John 11). The choice Moses set before the people is the choice in every deed; to do the good is to choose life and to be of Elohim (God), to do the evil is to choose death and to show one has not seen Him.
cards.s_text: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that does good is of Elohim (God): but he that does evil has not seen Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;

cards.note: *That Yahuah (LORD) may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel).* (1 Kings 2:4). David's charge to Solomon makes walking in truth the covenant condition: *to walk before me in truth with all their heart.* John's joy that his children *walk in truth* (3 John 4) is the joy of that same covenant fidelity — to walk before Yahuah (LORD) in truth with the whole heart.
cards.s_text: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in you, even as you walk in the truth.
cards.t_text: That Yahuah (LORD) may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If your children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you (said he) a man on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.* (Deuteronomy 10:19). The command is plain and grounded in Yashar'el's (Israel's) own memory: *love ye therefore the stranger.* John's commendation of faithfulness *to the brethren, and to strangers* (3 John 5) is obedience to this word; the people once strangers in Egypt are to love the stranger now.
cards.s_text: Beloved, you do faithfully whatsoever you do to the brethren, and to strangers;
cards.t_text: Love you therefore the stranger: for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

cards.note: *But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.* (Daniel 10:13). Daniel names *Michael, one of the chief princes,* the warring prince of Yashar'el (Israel) — the same *Michael the archangel* who *contended with the devil* and *disputed about the body of Moses* (Jude 1:9). The one who stands up for Daniel's people is the one who withstands the accuser over Moses' body; Jude's Michael is Daniel's Michael.
cards.s_text: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, Yahuah (Lord) rebuke you.
cards.t_text: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

cards.note: *But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.* (Daniel 10:21). *Michael your prince* — the guardian of Yashar'el (Israel), who *shall stand up... for the children of thy people* (Daniel 12:1). This is the Michael Jude names *the archangel,* contending with the devil over the body of Moses (Jude 1:9). Where the devil accuses, Michael does not rail but yields the rebuke to Yahuah (Lord); the prince of the people is no equal of the accuser, only Yahuah's (Lord's) servant.
cards.s_text: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, Yahuah (Lord) rebuke you.
cards.t_text: But I will shew you that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

cards.note: *Behold, these caused the children of Yashar'el (Israel), through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahuah (LORD) in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of Yahuah (LORD).* (Numbers 31:16). The second rebel: *ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward* (Jude 1:11). Balaam, who *loved the wages of unrighteousness,* taught Balak to cast a stumblingblock before Yashar'el (Israel) — *the counsel of Balaam* that brought the plague at Peor. The error of Balaam is teaching Yahuah's (LORD's) people to sin for hire, the very thing the ungodly do who turn grace into lasciviousness.
cards.s_text: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
cards.t_text: Behold, these caused the children of Yashar'el (Israel), through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahuah (LORD) in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: *He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber. Behold, he that keepeth Yashar'el (Israel) shall neither slumber nor sleep.* (Psalm 121:3-4). The doxology rests on this: *Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling* (Jude 1:24). He *that keepeth thee will not slumber* — the Keeper of Yashar'el (Israel) who will not suffer the foot to be moved is the One able to keep his own from falling and present them faultless. Against the wandering stars and the fallen Watchers, the saints are kept by the Keeper who never sleeps.
cards.s_text: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
cards.t_text: He will not suffer your foot to be moved: he that keeps you will not slumber.

cards.note: *If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee* (Deuteronomy 30:4). *Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles* (Psalm 25:22): no scattering is too far for the redemption David prays — *from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee*. The redeemed Yashar'el is fetched even from the outmost parts; the gathering of the dispersed seed is the troubles undone.
cards.s_text: Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles.
cards.t_text: If any of yours be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather you, and from thence will he fetch you:

cards.note: *That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee* (Deuteronomy 30:3). *Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles* (Psalm 25:22): the redemption of the whole house is the Torah-promise of the gathering — *will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither... he hath scattered thee*. The scatterer is the gatherer; the two-house people, divided and dispersed, is brought home — never replaced, the covenant seed regathered.
cards.s_text: Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles.
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: *Let Yashar'el (Israel) hope in Yahuah (LORD): for with Yahuah (LORD) there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption* (Psalm 130:7). *Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles* (Psalm 25:22): the plea rests on Yahuah's own nature — *with Yahuah (LORD) there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption*. Yashar'el is bidden to hope because the redemption is plenteous; the whole people's trouble is met by the whole people's Redeemer.
cards.s_text: Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles.
cards.t_text: Let Yashar'el (Israel) hope in Yahuah (LORD): for with Yahuah (LORD) there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

cards.note: *And he shall redeem Yashar'el (Israel) from all his iniquities* (Psalm 130:8). *Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles* (Psalm 25:22): the corporate plea of the psalm is answered in the psalter — *he shall redeem Yashar'el (Israel) from all his iniquities*. The redemption out of all his troubles is the redemption from all his iniquities; the scattered people is brought home and ransomed whole.
cards.s_text: Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles.
cards.t_text: And he shall redeem Yashar'el (Israel) from all his iniquities.

cards.note: *He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a Elohim (God) of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he* (Deuteronomy 32:4). The Rock of Psalm 28:1 is the Rock of Moses' own Song — *He is the Rock, his work is perfect*. When David cries *O Yahuah (LORD) my rock*, he calls on the Rock that bore Yashar'el (Israel) through the wilderness, just and right in all his ways.
cards.s_text: Unto you will I cry, O Yahuah (LORD) my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if you be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
cards.t_text: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a Elohim (God) of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

cards.note: *And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ)* (1 Corinthians 10:4). Read through the Formed and the Formless: the Rock that led and watered Yashar'el (Israel) is named — *that Rock was Messiah (Christ)*. So *Yahuah (LORD) my rock* (Psalm 28:1) is the Formed Son who went before his people, the expressed Word drawn from the Formless Father; he is Yahuah, and he has a Father.
cards.s_text: Unto you will I cry, O Yahuah (LORD) my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if you be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
cards.t_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: *And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Yashar'el (Israel), when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive* (1 Kings 8:30). *When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle* (Psalm 28:2) is the very posture Solomon set at the temple's dedication — prayer directed *toward this place*, heard *in heaven thy dwelling place*. The hands lifted toward the holy oracle are the supplication Yahuah hears.
cards.s_text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto you, when I lift up my hands toward your holy oracle.
cards.t_text: And hearken you to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Yashar'el (Israel), when they shall pray toward this place: and hear you in heaven your dwelling place: and when you hear, forgive.

cards.note: *And, behold, the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory* (Ezekiel 43:2). *The voice of Yahuah (LORD) is upon the waters: the Elohim (God) of glory thundereth: Yahuah (LORD) is upon many waters* (Psalm 29:3): Ezekiel sees the same Glory, *his voice... like a noise of many waters*, the earth shining with His glory. The Voice upon the many waters is the Glory of the Elohim of Yashar'el, the Formed One whose coming lights the earth.
cards.s_text: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) is upon the waters: the Elohim (God) of glory thundereth: Yahuah (LORD) is upon many waters.
cards.t_text: And, behold, the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

cards.note: *Yahuah (LORD) lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace* (Numbers 6:26). *Yahuah (LORD) will give strength unto his people; Yahuah (LORD) will bless his people with peace* (Psalm 29:11): the theophany closes in the Aaronic blessing's own word — *give thee peace*. The strength and shalom Yahuah pours on His people is the priestly blessing spoken over Yashar'el, the peace of His lifted countenance.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (LORD) will give strength unto his people; Yahuah (LORD) will bless his people with peace.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) lift up his countenance upon you, and give you peace.

cards.note: Genesis 49:7 — *Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Yashar'el (Israel).* This is the very curse the writer quotes — "Accursed be their anger!" — proof that unreasoning rage is condemned by the Law.
cards.s_text: cursed be their anger!' For had not Reason possessed the power to restrain their anger he would not have spoken thus.
cards.t_text: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Numbers 16:2 — *And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown.* This rising against Moses is the occasion at which he "governed his anger by his Reason" rather than giving free course to wrath.
cards.s_text: debased passions, even as it does anger, for it conquers even this. Yea, Moses when he was angered against Dathan and Abiram did not give free course to his wrath, but governed his anger by his
cards.t_text: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

cards.note: 1 Maccabees 1:62 — *Howbeit many in Yashar'el (Israel) were fully resolved and confirmed in themselves not to eat any unclean thing.* The men tortured to eat unclean meats answer the many resolved not to eat any unclean thing — the dietary law of Leviticus standing under threat of death.
cards.s_text: When therefore his decrees continued to be contemned by the mass of the people, he personally tried to force by tortures each man separately to eat unclean meats and thus abjure the Yahudi (Jewish) religion.
cards.t_text: Howbeit many in Yashar'el (Israel) were fully resolved and confirmed in themselves not to eat any unclean thing.

cards.note: 1 Maccabees 1:20 — *And after that Antiochus had struck Egypt, he returned again in the hundred forty and third year, and went up against Yashar'el (Israel) and Jerusalem with a great multitude.* The same return from Egypt and march on Jerusalem that 4 Maccabees compresses into Antiochus marching back against the city.
cards.s_text: For when he was carrying on war with Ptolemy in Egypt and heard that the people of Jerusalem had rejoiced exceedingly over a report of his death, he immediately marched back against them.
cards.t_text: And after that Antiochus had struck Egypt, he returned again in the hundred forty and third year, and went up against Yashar'el (Israel) and Jerusalem with a great multitude,

cards.note: Numbers 25:11 — *Phinehas... hath turned my wrath away from the children of Yashar'el (Israel), while he was zealous for my sake among them* — *Phineas, the zealous priest,* whose zeal for the Law the father held up to his sons.
cards.s_text: And he spake to us of Phineas, the zealous priest, and he taught you the song of Ananias, Azarias, and Mishael in the fire.
cards.t_text: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Yashar'el (Israel), while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in my jealousy.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:3 — *Son of Adam, can these bones live? And I answered, O Yahuah (Lord) GOD, thou knowest* — *Shall these dry bones live?* the resurrection-question the father confirmed, the hope of the whole house of Yashar'el.
cards.s_text: He confirmed the words of Ezekiel, “Shall these dry bones live?”
cards.t_text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, can these bones live? And I answered, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, you know.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:19 — *I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live* — the life Moses set before Yashar'el, *this is your life,* chosen by the sons in dying for the Law.
cards.s_text: For he forgat not the song that Moses taught, which teaches, “I will slay and I will make alive. This is your life and the blessedness of your days.”’
cards.t_text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:

cards.note: *For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee* (Isaiah 54:7). *For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life* (Psalm 30:5): the prophet speaks the same measure to the forsaken people — the anger a *small moment*, the mercy a *gathering*. The brief anger and the abundant favour of the psalm is Yahuah's word to scattered Yashar'el: a moment forsaken, then gathered with great mercies.
cards.s_text: For his anger endures but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
cards.t_text: For a small moment have I forsaken you; but with great mercies will I gather you.

cards.note: *Yahusha (Jesus) saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!* (John 1:47). *Blessed is the man... in whose spirit there is no guile* (Psalm 32:2): when the Formed Son named the true Yashar'el-ite, he named the very man the psalm beatifies — the Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile. The forgiven man, his sin uncovered before Yahuah and so covered by Him, is the one with no guile in his spirit.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the man unto whom Yahuah (LORD) imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
cards.t_text: Yahusha (Jesus) saw Nathanael coming to him, and says of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

cards.note: *For thou art an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth* (Deuteronomy 7:6). *Blessed is the nation whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD); and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance* (Psalm 33:12): the nation chosen is Yashar'el (Israel), *chosen... to be a special people unto himself* — the election of the covenant people, the blessed nation whose Elohim is Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the nation whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD); and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
cards.t_text: For you are an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has chosen you to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

cards.note: *But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light* (1 Peter 2:9). *The people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance* (Psalm 33:12): Peter speaks the same election forward over the scattered-and-gathered people — *a chosen generation... an holy nation, a peculiar people*. Not a new people replacing Yashar'el (Israel), but the two-house people who *in time past were not a people, but are now the people of Elohim (God)* (1 Peter 2:10) — gathered and made His inheritance again.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the nation whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD); and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
cards.t_text: But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that you should shew forth the praises of him who has called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

cards.note: *Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared* (Exodus 23:20). *The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them* (Psalm 34:7): the Angel who encamps and delivers is the Angel sent before Yashar'el (Israel) to keep them in the way — the Formed Son going before His people to guard them.
cards.s_text: The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivers them.
cards.t_text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

cards.note: *You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom* (Baruch 3:12). *For with thee is the fountain of life* (Psalm 36:9): the fountain with Yahuah is the very spring Baruch warns Yashar'el (Israel) it has forsaken — the fountain of wisdom which is the fountain of life, length of days, and *the light of the eyes* (Baruch 3:14). To leave that spring is to perish in a strange land; to drink of it is life.
cards.s_text: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light shall we see light.
cards.t_text: You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom.

cards.note: *But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people* (Jeremiah 31:33). *The law of his Elohim (God) is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide* (Psalm 37:31): the psalm describes the righteous one in whom the new-covenant promise is already at work — Torah *in their inward parts*, *written in their hearts*. The law is not abolished but written within; the heart-Torah keeps the steps from sliding.
cards.s_text: The law of his Elohim (God) is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
cards.t_text: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.

cards.note: *Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint* (Isaiah 1:5). *There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin* (Psalm 38:3): the psalmist's body wastes under sin as Yashar'el's whole body wastes under rebellion — *the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint*. Sin is read as sickness, the soundness gone out of the flesh.
cards.s_text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
cards.t_text: Why should you be stricken any more? you will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

cards.note: *I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me* (John 13:18). *Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me* (Psalm 41:9): the Formed Son — Yahusha (Jesus) — quotes this very verse at the last supper and names it scripture being fulfilled in the betrayal of Judas. The One who walked Yashar'el (Israel) in the Tanakh names the Tanakh as His own testimony; the table-friend who eats the bread and lifts the heel is the betrayer-type running from David to the Son.
cards.s_text: Yea, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
cards.t_text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.

cards.note: *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye Yahuah (LORD)* (Psalm 106:48). *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen* (Psalm 41:13): the close of Book IV repeats the exact words of the close of Book I — *Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el from everlasting to everlasting* — with all the people called to say Amen. The Psalter's books are sealed by this one recurring blessing upon the God of His two-house people.
cards.s_text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
cards.t_text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: *Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) for evermore. Amen, and Amen* (Psalm 89:52). *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen* (Psalm 41:13): the close of Book III carries the same doubled *Amen, and Amen* and the same everlasting blessing — Yahuah blessed for evermore. The doxology that seals Book I is the pattern repeated to seal Book III.
cards.s_text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
cards.t_text: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

cards.note: *And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen* (Psalm 72:19). *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen* (Psalm 41:13): the doubled *Amen, and Amen* that closes Book I is echoed exactly at the close of Book II — the name blessed for ever, the earth filled with His glory. The seals of the books speak with one voice.
cards.s_text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
cards.t_text: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

cards.note: *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), who only doeth wondrous things* (Psalm 72:18). *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen* (Psalm 41:13): the matching doxology seals Book II of the Psalter as 41:13 seals Book I — the same blessing upon the Elohim of Yashar'el, His covenant people. The five-book structure is bound together by these closing benedictions.
cards.s_text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
cards.t_text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), who only does wondrous things.

cards.note: *I say then, Hath Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin* (Romans 11:1), with *Elohim (God) hath not cast away his people which he foreknew* (Romans 11:2). *Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long* (Psalm 44:22): lest the slaughter be read as Yashar'el (Israel) cast off, Paul guards it — Yahuah has NOT cast away His people whom He foreknew; the suffering people remains the covenant people.
cards.s_text: Yea, for your sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
cards.t_text: I say then, Has Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

cards.note: *Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of Yahuah (LORD) revealed?* (Isaiah 53:1). *But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them* (Psalm 44:3): the arm that saved Yashar'el (Israel) is the revealed arm of the Servant — read through the Formed and the Formless, the saving arm of Yahuah is His own expressed strength, the One through whom the salvation comes.
cards.s_text: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your countenance, because you had a favour unto them.
cards.t_text: Who has believed our report? and to whom is the arm of Yahuah (LORD) revealed?

cards.note: *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left* (Isaiah 11:11). The *tenth* that *shall return* (Isaiah 6:13) is the remnant Yahuah recovers *the second time* — *the remnant of his people, which shall be left*. The holy-seed stump is the two-house remnant gathered home, the outcasts of Yashar'el and the dispersed of Yahudah assembled (11:12).
cards.s_text: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

cards.note: *And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and because of their transgressions in all their sins* (Leviticus 16:16). When the coal touches the prophet's lips — *thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged* (Isaiah 6:7) — it does the altar's own work: *an atonement... because of their transgressions in all their sins*. The unclean lips of the man among a people of unclean lips (6:5) are cleansed by the fire of atonement before he is sent.
cards.s_text: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin purged.
cards.t_text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remains among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

cards.note: *Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)* (Hosea 1:10). The breaking of Ephraim *that it be not a people* (Isaiah 7:8) is reversed in the very same word: where it was said *Ye are not my people*, there they shall be called *the sons of the living Elohim (God)*. The scattering is judgment; the regathering is the promise — never a cancelled people.
cards.s_text: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
cards.t_text: Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, You are the sons of the living Elohim (God).

cards.note: *And the pride of Yashar'el (Israel) testifieth to his face: and they do not return to Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), nor seek him for all this* (Hosea 7:10). Isaiah indicts *Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart* (Isaiah 9:9); Hosea presses the same lawsuit on the same northern house — *the pride of Yashar'el (Israel) testifieth to his face*. The sin is the pride that will not return; conduct within the covenant, never ethnicity.
cards.s_text: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
cards.t_text: And the pride of Yashar'el (Israel) testifieth to his face: and they do not return to Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), nor seek him for all this.

cards.note: *In his days Yahudah (Judah) shall be saved, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, Yahuah Tsidkenu (THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS)* (Jeremiah 23:6). The Branch of *the stem of Jesse* (Isaiah 11:1) is named *Yahuah Tsidkenu* — and in his days BOTH houses, *Yahudah* and *Yashar'el*, are saved and dwell safely. The Branch is the Messiah who gathers the two houses (Isaiah 11:11-13).
cards.s_text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
cards.t_text: In his days Yahudah (Judah) shall be saved, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, Yahuah Tsidkenu (THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS).

cards.note: *And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust* (Romans 15:12). Paul quotes Isaiah 11:10 verbatim to seal the nations' inclusion — *there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek*. The nations seeking the root of Jesse are grafted INTO Yashar'el's olive tree, the wild branches grown back to the same root — never a replacement people.
cards.s_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
cards.t_text: And again, Esaias says, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

cards.note: *Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand* (Ezekiel 37:19). The assembling of *the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)* and *the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah)* (Isaiah 11:12) is Ezekiel's two sticks made one — Joseph/Ephraim joined to Yahudah, *one stick... one in mine hand*. The two-house regathering, both houses made one.
cards.s_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.
cards.t_text: Say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

cards.note: *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all* (Ezekiel 37:22). *Ephraim shall not envy Yahudah (Judah), and Yahudah (Judah) shall not vex Ephraim* (Isaiah 11:13) is the end of the division — *no more two nations*, one nation under one king. The envy departs because the two kingdoms become one in Yahuah's hand.
cards.s_text: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Yahudah (Judah) shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Yahudah (Judah), and Yahudah (Judah) shall not vex Ephraim.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: *Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock* (Jeremiah 31:10). *Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people* (Isaiah 11:11) is the same shepherd-promise — *He that scattered Yashar'el will gather him*. The One who scattered the northern house through Assyria gathers them home the second time.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
cards.t_text: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O you nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.

cards.note: *Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel* (Hosea 1:11). The gathering of *the outcasts of Yashar'el* and *the dispersed of Yahudah* (Isaiah 11:12) is Hosea's reversal of Lo-ammi (*not my people*, Hosea 1:9): both houses *gathered together, and appoint themselves one head*. The scattered are made one people again.
cards.s_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.
cards.t_text: Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.

cards.note: *Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither* (Jeremiah 31:8). The highway for the remnant *like as it was to Yashar'el (Israel) in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt* (Isaiah 11:16) is Jeremiah's ingathering — *a great company shall return* from the north and the coasts of the earth. The new Exodus, the remnant walking home.
cards.s_text: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Yashar'el (Israel) in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
cards.t_text: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.

cards.note: *For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery... that blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el (Israel), until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in* (Romans 11:25). *I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth* (Psalm 46:10): the exalting among the heathen is the fulness of the nations coming in TO the Elohim of Jacob — Paul guards it: *Elohim (God) hath not cast away his people which he foreknew* (Romans 11:2). The heathen are gathered in, never Israel cast out.
cards.s_text: Be still, and know that I am Elohim (God): I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
cards.t_text: For I would not, brethren, that you should be ignorant of this mystery, lest you should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el (Israel), until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

cards.note: *And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob* (Romans 11:26). *Be still, and know that I am Elohim (God): I will be exalted among the heathen* (Psalm 46:10): the end of His exaltation among the nations is the salvation of all Yashar'el and the Deliverer out of Zion — the same Zion whose city the river makes glad. He is exalted among the heathen so that all His people, gathered, may know He is Elohim.
cards.s_text: Be still, and know that I am Elohim (God): I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
cards.t_text: And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

cards.note: *Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation* (Leviticus 23:24). *Yahuah (LORD) with the sound of a trumpet* (Psalm 47:5): the trumpet is no idle figure but the appointed time — the Feast of Trumpets, a holy convocation and statute for ever, not abolished but pointing to the King's enthronement announced with the trumpet sound.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) is gone up with a shout, Yahuah (LORD) with the sound of a trumpet.
cards.t_text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall you have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

cards.note: *If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee* (Deuteronomy 30:4). *Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice* (Psalm 50:5): even to the outmost parts of heaven the covenant people are fetched home — the gathering of the saints reaches the farthest-driven of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
cards.t_text: If any of yours be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather you, and from thence will he fetch you:

cards.note: *Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land* (Ezekiel 37:21). *Gather my saints together unto me* (Psalm 50:5): the gathering is the two-house regathering — the children of Yashar'el taken from among the heathen and brought home, the very saints the psalm summons.
cards.s_text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel)... and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all* (Ezekiel 37:22). *Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice* (Psalm 50:5): the gathered covenant people are made ONE nation — the two houses, Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel), no longer divided. The ingathering of the saints is the reunion of the two sticks.
cards.s_text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: *And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd* (John 10:16). The gathering of *He shall... gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom* (Isaiah 40:11) is the two-house gathering Yahusha names: the *other sheep... not of this fold* brought into *one fold, and one shepherd*. The scattered house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah) gathered into one flock under one Shepherd.
cards.s_text: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
cards.t_text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

cards.note: *For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out* (Ezekiel 34:11). The Shepherd of Isaiah 40:11 who *shall feed his flock... gather the lambs with his arm* is the Shepherd Ezekiel promised: *I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out* — Yahuah Himself seeking the scattered flock, *the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* who *are my people* (34:30).
cards.s_text: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
cards.t_text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

cards.note: *And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times* (Leviticus 16:14). *So shall he sprinkle many nations* (Isaiah 52:15) reads the marred servant (52:14) as the great priest whose sprinkling cleanses — the Day-of-Atonement sprinkling of blood now reaching *many nations*. The nations are cleansed and brought in, grafted to Yashar'el, not a people replaced.
cards.s_text: As many were astonied at you; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
cards.t_text: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

cards.note: *Husbands, love your wives, even as Messiah (Christ) also loved the church, and gave himself for it* (Ephesians 5:25). *For thy Maker is thine husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Isaiah 54:5) — the Maker/Husband/Redeemer is the Formed Son, the redeemer-husband who *gave himself* for his bride. The forsaken wife is loved and restored by her own Maker.
cards.s_text: For your Maker is your husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name; and your Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); The Elohim (God) of the whole earth shall he be called.
cards.t_text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Messiah (Christ) also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

cards.note: *For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh. This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Messiah (Christ) and the church* (Ephesians 5:31-32). *Thy Maker is thine husband... and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Isaiah 54:5) is the very marriage the mystery names — Redeemer and bride made one. The restored wife of Isaiah 54 is Yashar'el reunited to her Husband-Maker.
cards.s_text: For your Maker is your husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name; and your Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); The Elohim (God) of the whole earth shall he be called.
cards.t_text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

cards.note: *And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies* (Hosea 2:19). The forsaken *wife of youth* whose *Maker is thine husband* (Isaiah 54:5-6) is the bride betrothed *for ever* — *in righteousness... and in mercies*. The Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el is the everlasting Husband betrothing his put-away wife back to himself.
cards.s_text: For your Maker is your husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name; and your Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); The Elohim (God) of the whole earth shall he be called.
cards.t_text: And I will betroth you unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth you unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

cards.note: *But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel)... I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people* (Jeremiah 31:33). The children *taught of Yahuah (LORD)* (Isaiah 54:13) are taught by the Torah written within — the new covenant is the law *in their inward parts*, not the law replaced. To be taught of Yahuah is to have his commandment written on the heart.
cards.s_text: And all your children shall be taught of Yahuah (LORD); and great shall be the peace of your children.
cards.t_text: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.

cards.note: *And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee* (Isaiah 60:10). *Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem* (Psalm 51:18): David's personal cleansing widens to the building of Zion's walls — and Isaiah shows the nations themselves gathered to build them, the two-house ingathering of Yashar'el (Israel) and the strangers brought near, mercy after wrath.
cards.s_text: Do good in your good pleasure unto Zion: build you the walls of Jerusalem.
cards.t_text: And the sons of strangers shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister unto you: for in my wrath I smote you, but in my favour have I had mercy on you.

cards.note: *And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree* (Romans 11:17). *But I am like a green olive tree in the house of Elohim (God)* (Psalm 52:8): the figure of the olive in the house opens into Paul's two-house olive — the natural and the wild branches in one tree. Read with the guard, *Elohim (God) hath not cast away his people which he foreknew* (Romans 11:2): the engrafting is no replacement, both olive branches are Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of Elohim (God): I trust in the mercy of Elohim (God) for ever and ever.
cards.t_text: And if some of the branches be broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

cards.note: *His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon* (Hosea 14:6). *But I am like a green olive tree in the house of Elohim (God)* (Psalm 52:8): the olive is the figure of restored Yashar'el (Israel) — the returning, healed people whose beauty is as the olive tree. The trusting righteous of the psalm is the green olive of the restoration.
cards.s_text: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of Elohim (God): I trust in the mercy of Elohim (God) for ever and ever.
cards.t_text: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

cards.note: *Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy Elohim (God): I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness* (Isaiah 41:10). *Behold, Elohim (God) is mine helper: Yahuah (Lord) is with them that uphold my soul* (Psalm 54:4): Isaiah gives Yahuah's own pledge to His servant Yashar'el (Israel) — I am with thee, I will help thee, I will uphold thee. The helper of the psalm is the God who upholds His people with the right hand of righteousness.
cards.s_text: Behold, Elohim (God) is my helper: Adonai (Lord) is with them that uphold my soul.
cards.t_text: Fear you not; for I am with you: be not dismayed; for I am your Elohim (God): I will strengthen you; yea, I will help you; yea, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

cards.note: *Whatsoever he be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers in Yashar'el (Israel), that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto Yahuah (LORD) for a burnt offering* (Leviticus 22:18). *I will freely sacrifice unto thee* (Psalm 54:6): the freewill offering is the Torah's own appointed worship — David's free sacrifice is not invented but obeyed, the willing oblation Yahuah commanded, Torah-affirmed and brought from the heart.
cards.s_text: I will freely sacrifice unto you: I will praise your name, O Yahuah (LORD); for it is good.
cards.t_text: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers in Yashar'el (Israel), that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto Yahuah (LORD) for a burnt offering;

cards.note: *The children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought a willing offering unto Yahuah (LORD), every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which Yahuah (LORD) had commanded* (Exodus 35:29). *I will freely sacrifice unto thee* (Psalm 54:6): the willing offering of the wilderness is the same free worship — the heart made willing brings to Yahuah. David's freely-given sacrifice stands in that congregation of willing hearts.
cards.s_text: I will freely sacrifice unto you: I will praise your name, O Yahuah (LORD); for it is good.
cards.t_text: The children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought a willing offering unto Yahuah (LORD), every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which Yahuah (LORD) had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:12 — *Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).* I will raise thee up with every man of thy seed is Ezekiel's opening of the graves of the whole people.
cards.s_text: thee (that) earth thou art and to earth shalt thou return. Again I promise to thee the Resurrection; I will raise thee up in the Resurrection with every man who is of thy seed.'
cards.t_text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Deuteronomy 33:1 — *And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of Elohim (God) blessed the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before his death.* The dying father's blessing of his sons that begins with Adam continues with Moses, who blessed Israel before his death.
cards.s_text: After Adam was nine hundred and thirty years old, since he knew that his days were coming to an end, he said: 'Let all my sons assemble themselves to me, that I may bless them before I die, and speak with them.'
cards.t_text: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of Elohim (God) blessed the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before his death.

cards.note: Jasher 1:1 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and Elohim created man in his own image.* The antediluvian chronicle itself — the life of Adam and Eve recounted from the forming — is the kind of record Eve commands her children to engrave and preserve.
cards.s_text: But hearken unto me, my children. Make ye then tables of stone and others of clay, and write
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and Elohim created man in his own image.

cards.note: *He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds* (Psalm 147:3). *He hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted* (Isaiah 61:1) is the very work the Psalm ascribes to Yahuah himself — the binding of the broken in heart. The Anointed does the healing of Yahuah; and it is bound to the gathering of the scattered: *Yahuah (LORD) doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Psalm 147:2).
cards.s_text: The Spirit of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) is upon me; because Yahuah (LORD) has anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
cards.t_text: He healeth the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

cards.note: *And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Exodus 19:6). *But ye shall be named the Priests of Yahuah (LORD): men shall call you the Ministers of our Elohim (God)* (Isaiah 61:6) is the Sinai vocation restored — the kingdom of priests, the holy nation, given to the children of Yashar'el and now reaffirmed over the regathered people. The priesthood of the whole covenant nation, never set aside.
cards.s_text: But you shall be named the Priests of Yahuah (LORD): men shall call you the Ministers of our Elohim (God): you shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall you boast yourselves.
cards.t_text: And you shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy* (Exodus 20:8). The blessing on the one *that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it* (Isaiah 56:2) rests on the fourth of the Ten Words — *the seventh day is the sabbath of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God)... Yahuah (LORD) blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it* (Exodus 20:10-11). Isaiah 56 calls Yashar'el back to the commandment given at Sinai, not to a thing set aside.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the man that does this, and the son of Adam that lays hold on it; that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil.
cards.t_text: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

cards.note: *Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of Elohim (God)* (Ephesians 2:19). *Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD)... to be his servants* (Isaiah 56:6) are made *no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens* — the very stranger who joins himself by covenant-keeping is brought into the household, the commonwealth of Yashar'el. Inclusion THROUGH the covenant, not apart from it.
cards.s_text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD), to serve him, and to love the name of Yahuah (LORD), to be his servants, every one that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and takes hold of my covenant;
cards.t_text: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of Elohim (God);

cards.note: *That at that time ye were without Messiah (Christ), being aliens from the commonwealth of Yashar'el (Israel), and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope* (Ephesians 2:12). The *son of the stranger* who feared *Yahuah (LORD) hath utterly separated me from his people* (Isaiah 56:3) is the one Paul calls *aliens from the commonwealth of Yashar'el (Israel), and strangers from the covenants of promise* — the separation Isaiah 56 overturns by the covenant taken hold of.
cards.s_text: Neither let the son of the stranger, that has joined himself to Yahuah (LORD), speak, saying, Yahuah (LORD) has utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
cards.t_text: That at that time you were without Messiah (Christ), being aliens from the commonwealth of Yashar'el (Israel), and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without Elohim (God) in the world:

cards.note: *But now in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Messiah (Christ)* (Ephesians 2:13). The strangers who *join themselves to Yahuah (LORD), to serve him, and to love the name of Yahuah (LORD)* (Isaiah 56:6) are those *made nigh by the blood* — the far-off brought near, the covenant-keeping stranger drawn in. Made nigh THROUGH the covenant blood, into Yashar'el's own commonwealth.
cards.s_text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD), to serve him, and to love the name of Yahuah (LORD), to be his servants, every one that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and takes hold of my covenant;
cards.t_text: But now in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) you who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: *Yahuah (LORD) doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Psalm 147:2). *Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathereth the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Isaiah 56:8) sings the same gathering the Psalm names — Yahuah the gatherer of the outcasts, building up Jerusalem by bringing home the scattered. The outcasts of the northern house regathered.
cards.s_text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathers the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel) says, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) does build up Jerusalem: he gathers together the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd* (John 10:16). *Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him* (Isaiah 56:8) is the very *other sheep... not of this fold* Yahusha must bring — the outcasts of Yashar'el gathered FIRST, then others beside, made *one fold* under *one shepherd*. The two-house ingathering in the Shepherd's own words.
cards.s_text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathers the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel) says, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
cards.t_text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

cards.note: *And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad* (John 11:52). *He which gathereth the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)... Yet will I gather others to him* (Isaiah 56:8) is the gathering John names — Yahusha dying to *gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad*, the outcasts and the others-beside made one.
cards.s_text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathers the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel) says, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
cards.t_text: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad.

cards.note: *Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim... even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand* (Ezekiel 37:19). *He... which gathereth the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)... Yet will I gather others to him* (Isaiah 56:8) is the two-house regathering Ezekiel draws as the two sticks — Joseph (Ephraim, the scattered north) and Yahudah made *one stick*, the outcasts and the others gathered as one people.
cards.s_text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathers the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel) says, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
cards.t_text: Say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

cards.note: *Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land* (Ezekiel 37:21). *Yahuah Elohim which gathereth the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Isaiah 56:8) is Ezekiel's promise to *gather them on every side* from among the heathen — the scattered outcasts brought home, the same ingathering Isaiah's others-beside join.
cards.s_text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathers the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel) says, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: *And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree* (Romans 11:17). *The sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD)... and taketh hold of my covenant* (Isaiah 56:6) are Paul's *wild olive tree... graffed in*, partaking of the root — grafted INTO Yashar'el's own olive, not a new tree. The stranger who takes hold of the covenant is the wild branch come home, never a replacement people.
cards.s_text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD), to serve him, and to love the name of Yahuah (LORD), to be his servants, every one that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and takes hold of my covenant;
cards.t_text: And if some of the branches be broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

cards.note: *Son of Adam, prophesy against the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel)...
