Woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?* (Ezekiel 34:2). *His watchmen are blind... they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain* (Isaiah 56:10-11) is the same covenant-lawsuit Ezekiel brings against *the shepherds... that do feed themselves* — the leaders who graze on the flock instead of feeding it. The indictment is on the watchmen, not the sheep.
cards.s_text: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
cards.t_text: Son of Adam, prophesy against the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel), prophesy, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

cards.note: *But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me* (Romans 10:20). Paul quotes Isaiah 65:1 word for word — *I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not*. The finding of those who *asked not* is the wild-olive branches of Yashar'el (Israel) grown wild among the nations brought home — the scattered house found, NOT a new people replacing Israel.
cards.s_text: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
cards.t_text: But Esaias is very bold, and says, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

cards.note: *But to Yashar'el (Israel) he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people* (Romans 10:21). Paul quotes Isaiah 65:2 word for word — *I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good*. The spread-out hands are the long-suffering of Yahuah toward the disobedient house; the indictment and the patience are over the one covenant people.
cards.s_text: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walks in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
cards.t_text: But to Yashar'el (Israel) he says, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

cards.note: *And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living Elohim (God)* (Romans 9:26). Those *found* who *sought me not* (Isaiah 65:1) are the very ones told *Ye are not my people* now called *the children of the living Elohim (God)* — the scattered, wild-grown branches of Yashar'el regathered, the two-house finding.
cards.s_text: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living Elohim (God).

cards.note: *Esaias also crieth concerning Yashar'el (Israel), Though the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved* (Romans 9:27). *As the new wine is found in the cluster... so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all* (Isaiah 65:8) — the blessing in the cluster is the remnant for whose sake the whole is spared; *a remnant shall be saved*, the servants not destroyed.
cards.s_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
cards.t_text: Esaias also cries concerning Yashar'el (Israel), Though the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

cards.note: *And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof* (Amos 9:14). *They shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them* (Isaiah 65:21) — Amos sings the same regathering: the captivity brought again, the waste cities built and inhabited, the vineyards planted and their wine drunk. The build-and-inhabit promise is the two-house restoration.
cards.s_text: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
cards.t_text: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

cards.note: *And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, and performed it, saith Yahuah (LORD)* (Ezekiel 37:14). *And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb* (Isaiah 66:14) — the flourishing bones echo Ezekiel's valley: the dried bones of the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel) made to live, the two-house resurrection-figure of the regathered people.
cards.s_text: And when you see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of Yahuah (LORD) shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
cards.t_text: And shall put my spirit in you, and you shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall you know that I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, and performed it, says Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: *Yahuah (LORD) recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), under whose wings thou art come to trust* (Ruth 2:12). *In the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge* (Psalm 57:1): Boaz blesses Ruth the Moabitess as one *come to trust* under Yahuah's wings — the stranger gathered into the covenant shelter. The same wings David hides under spread to draw the nations in to trust.
cards.s_text: Be merciful unto me, O Elohim (God), be merciful unto me: for my soul trusts in you: yea, in the shadow of your wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) recompense your work, and a full reward be given you of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), under whose wings you are come to trust.

cards.note: *O Jerusalem, Jerusalem... how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!* (Matthew 23:37). *In the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge* (Psalm 57:1): the Formed Son names the gathering wings of the psalm — the hen who would shelter her chicks. The longing is two-house and unspent — *Hath Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid* (Romans 11:1-2) — the wings still spread to gather Yashar'el and the nations to trust.
cards.s_text: Be merciful unto me, O Elohim (God), be merciful unto me: for my soul trusts in you: yea, in the shadow of your wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
cards.t_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto you, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and you would not!

cards.note: *For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and Yahuah (LORD) wrought a great salvation for all Yashar'el (Israel)... wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?* (1 Samuel 19:5). *They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold* (Psalm 59:4): Jonathan names what the psalm pleads — the blood is innocent, the man is hunted *without a cause*. The fault is not David's; the murderers prepare themselves against innocent blood.
cards.s_text: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
cards.t_text: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and Yahuah (LORD) wrought a great salvation for all Yashar'el (Israel): you saw it, and did rejoice: wherefore then will you sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

cards.note: *O Yahuah (LORD), my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies* (Jeremiah 16:19). *Thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble* (Psalm 59:16): the strength-fortress-refuge of David's song becomes the refuge the nations come home to — the scattered of Yashar'el (Israel), grown wild among the Gentiles, returning from the ends of the earth to their own root (the two-house regathering, never a new people replacing Israel — Romans 11:1-2 stands). The day-of-trouble refuge is the ingathering refuge of the latter days.
cards.s_text: But I will sing of your power; yea, I will sing aloud of your mercy in the morning: for you have been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
cards.t_text: O Yahuah (LORD), my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto you from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.

cards.note: *Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows... even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand* (Ezekiel 37:19). *Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Yahudah (Judah) is my lawgiver* (Psalm 60:7): the two houses the psalm names as both His the prophet binds into one stick in His hand — Joseph/Ephraim and Yahudah made one, no more two nations.
cards.s_text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Yahudah (Judah) is my lawgiver;
cards.t_text: Say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

cards.note: *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel)... and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all* (Ezekiel 37:22). *Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Yahudah (Judah) is my lawgiver* (Psalm 60:7): the houses named separately in the land-oracle are gathered into one nation that shall be divided no more — both His, made one upon the mountains.
cards.s_text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Yahudah (Judah) is my lawgiver;
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: *Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many... but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!* (Isaiah 31:1). *vain is the help of man* (Psalm 60:11): Isaiah names the vain help by its idol — Egypt's horses and chariots, trusted in place of the Holy One. To lean on the arm of flesh is to look away from Yahuah; the help of man is woe, not deliverance.
cards.s_text: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
cards.t_text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!

cards.note: *And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ)* (1 Corinthians 10:4). *From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I* (Psalm 61:2): the Rock the overwhelmed heart is led to is the Formed Son — the Rock that followed Yashar'el (Israel) in the wilderness, *and that Rock was Messiah*. He is the rock higher than I, higher than the man who cries.
cards.s_text: From the end of the earth will I cry unto you, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
cards.t_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: *A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Yashar'el (Israel)* (Luke 2:32). Simeon names the infant Yahusha with Isaiah 42:6 — *give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles*. Light to the nations AND glory to his people Yashar'el: both houses and the nations, the Servant for a covenant of THE PEOPLE and a light to the rest, never one instead of the other.
cards.s_text: I Yahuah (LORD) have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will keep you, and give you for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
cards.t_text: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth* (Isaiah 49:6). The parallel Servant Song repeats 42:6 — *give thee... for a light of the Gentiles* — and frames it two-house first: the Servant raises up the tribes of Jacob and restores Yashar'el, AND is light to the nations. Restoration of the houses and light to the Gentiles in one calling.
cards.s_text: I Yahuah (LORD) have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will keep you, and give you for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
cards.t_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

cards.note: *Thou shalt have no other gods before me* (Exodus 20:3). *I am Yahuah (LORD): that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images* (Isaiah 42:8) — the glory withheld from idols is the Decalogue's first word. The Name that will not share his glory is the same Yahuah who, having brought Yashar'el out of Egypt, forbids any other gods before him.
cards.s_text: I am Yahuah (LORD): that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
cards.t_text: You shall have no other gods before me.

cards.note: *For so hath Yahuah (Lord) commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth* (Acts 13:47). Paul and Barnabas quote Isaiah 49:6 verbatim — *I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth*. The Servant's fourfold mission — raise the tribes of Jacob, restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel), light to the nations, salvation to earth's end — is carried out: the tribes regathered AND the nations brought in.
cards.s_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
cards.t_text: For so has Yahuah (Lord) commanded us, saying, I have set you to be a light of the Gentiles, that you should be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

cards.note: *A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Yashar'el (Israel)* (Luke 2:32). Simeon names BOTH halves of Isaiah 49:6 — *a light to the Gentiles* AND the restoration of *the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel)*: the salvation is *A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Yashar'el (Israel)*. Not the nations instead of Israel, but the light to the nations and the glory of his people together — the two-house keystone.
cards.s_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
cards.t_text: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people... And he shall... gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth* (Isaiah 11:11-12). *Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim* (Isaiah 49:12) is that four-corners ingathering — the remnant recovered *the second time*, the outcasts of Yashar'el and the dispersed of Yahudah gathered from every quarter. Both houses brought home.
cards.s_text: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

cards.note: *And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Yashar'el (Israel) committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Yahudah (Judah) feared not, but went and played the harlot also* (Jeremiah 3:8). *Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away?... for your transgressions is your mother put away* (Isaiah 50:1) — the very bill of divorce Jeremiah names, given to the backsliding northern house for HER adultery. The putting-away is judgment for the house's sin, not Yahuah's rejection of his people.
cards.s_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have you sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
cards.t_text: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Yashar'el (Israel) committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Yahudah (Judah) feared not, but went and played the harlot also.

cards.note: *But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people* (Jeremiah 31:33). The father's charge — *forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments* (Proverbs 3:1) — is the very thing the new covenant promises to do in every son: *I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts*. The Torah is not set aside but moved inward; the heart that keeps the commandments is the heart the covenant writes upon.
cards.s_text: My son, forget not my law; but let your heart keep my commandments:
cards.t_text: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.

cards.note: *Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) chasteneth thee* (Deuteronomy 8:5). The Torah root of *even as a father the son in whom he delighteth* (Proverbs 3:12) is Moshe's (Moses') word in the wilderness: *as a man chasteneth his son, so Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) chasteneth thee*. The forty-years discipline of the son Yashar'el (Israel) is the same fatherly correction the proverb sets before the son.
cards.s_text: For whom Yahuah (LORD) loves he corrects; even as a father the son in whom he delights.
cards.t_text: You shall also consider in your heart, that, as a man chastens his son, so Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) chastens you.

cards.note: *And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob* (Romans 11:26). Paul quotes Isaiah word for word — *And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith Yahuah (LORD)* (Isaiah 59:20). The Redeemer to Zion IS the seal of all-Israel's salvation: the Deliverer comes, and ungodliness is turned away from Jacob.
cards.s_text: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, says Yahuah (LORD).
cards.t_text: And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

cards.note: *Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O ye nations... He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock* (Jeremiah 31:10). *The Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob* (Isaiah 59:20) is that very gathering — the scattered houses brought home to the One who scattered and now gathers, the two-house regathering of them that turn (repent), never a new people grafted in by confession.
cards.s_text: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, says Yahuah (LORD).
cards.t_text: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O you nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.

cards.note: *But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel)... I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people* (Jeremiah 31:33). *My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart* (Isaiah 59:21) is the same everlasting covenant — Spirit AND Word together, the Torah written within and never to depart. The covenant is not the law abolished but the law interiorized.
cards.s_text: As for me, this is my covenant with them, says Yahuah (LORD); My spirit that is upon you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your seed, nor out of the mouth of your seed’s seed, says Yahuah (LORD), from henceforth and for ever.
cards.t_text: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.

cards.note: *And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart* (Deuteronomy 6:6). The father's charge — *For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law* (Proverbs 4:2) — is the Shema's own demand: the words commanded are to live *in thine heart*. The wisdom-father does not invent a new instruction; he hands down the Torah that Moshe (Moses) set in the heart of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: For I give you good doctrine, forsake you not my law.
cards.t_text: And these words, which I command you this day, shall be in your heart:

cards.note: *For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Yashar'el (Israel), which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children* (Psalm 78:5). The father's *keep my commandments, and live* (Proverbs 4:4) carries forward the appointed law of Psalm 78 — *a law in Yashar'el (Israel)... that they should make them known to their children*. The Torah commanded to the fathers is to be made known to the children; the wisdom-father is one link in that chain.
cards.s_text: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let your heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
cards.t_text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Yashar'el (Israel), which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

cards.note: *And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes* (Deuteronomy 6:8). The charge *Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck* (6:21) is the Shema's own binding-language: *thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand*. The father's commandment and the mother's Torah (6:20) ARE the words Moshe (Moses) bid Yashar'el (Israel) bind on hand and heart — the same Torah, worn continually, the lamp that leads when thou goest (6:22).
cards.s_text: Bind them continually upon your heart, and tie them about your neck.
cards.t_text: And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.

cards.note: *And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him* (Deuteronomy 1:16). The mother's charge to the king — *Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy* (Proverbs 31:9) — is the Torah's own charge to the judge: *judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him*. The king who judges for the poor keeps the commandment Moshe (Moses) laid on Yashar'el (Israel)'s judges.
cards.s_text: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
cards.t_text: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

cards.note: *For thy Maker is thine husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); The Elohim (God) of the whole earth shall he be called* (Isaiah 54:5). Read in the figurative register, the faithful woman whose *price is far above rubies* (Proverbs 31:10) is the Bride whose husband is her Maker: *thy Maker is thine husband... and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el*. The eshet chayil pictures Yashar'el (Israel) wed to Yahuah Himself.
cards.s_text: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
cards.t_text: For your Maker is your husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name; and your Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); The Elohim (God) of the whole earth shall he be called.

cards.note: *For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee* (Isaiah 54:7). The virtuous woman the husband's heart *doth safely trust* (Proverbs 31:11) is, in the figurative register, the forsaken wife GATHERED: *For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee*. The Bride is Yashar'el (Israel) scattered and regathered — the two houses brought home, not a new people replacing them.
cards.s_text: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
cards.t_text: For a small moment have I forsaken you; but with great mercies will I gather you.

cards.note: *And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies* (Hosea 2:19). The faithful woman of Proverbs 31:10 figures the divorced northern house betrothed again: *I will betroth thee unto me for ever... in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies*. The eshet chayil's faithfulness is Yashar'el (Israel) made faithful — Lo-Ammi made Ammi, the wild branch re-betrothed.
cards.s_text: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
cards.t_text: And I will betroth you unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth you unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

cards.note: *I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know Yahuah (LORD)* (Hosea 2:20). The trustworthy woman of Proverbs 31:10-12 figures the Bride betrothed *in faithfulness*: *I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know Yahuah*. Her faithfulness to her husband is Yashar'el (Israel)'s restored covenant-faithfulness — the two-house people made true again.
cards.s_text: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
cards.t_text: I will even betroth you unto me in faithfulness: and you shall know Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: *This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Messiah (Christ) and the church* (Ephesians 5:32). The virtuous woman whose *own works praise her in the gates* (Proverbs 31:31) reads, in the figurative register, as the Bride of the great mystery: *I speak concerning Messiah (Christ) and the church* — the assembly the apostle names is Yashar'el (Israel) restored, both olive branches, the wife loved as Messiah loved (5:25).
cards.s_text: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
cards.t_text: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Messiah (Christ) and the church.

cards.note: *And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints* (Revelation 19:8). The eshet chayil's *own works praise her in the gates* (Proverbs 31:31) is the Bride's fine linen: *arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints*. The faithful woman's works are the wedding garment of the Bride made ready — Yashar'el (Israel) gathered and clothed in righteousness.
cards.s_text: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
cards.t_text: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

cards.note: *The high places also of Aven, the sin of Yashar'el (Israel), shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us* (Hosea 10:8). Isaiah's fleers who *go into the holes of the rocks... for fear of Yahuah (LORD)* (Isaiah 2:19) cry Hosea's cry: *they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us*. The Day that humbles every proud thing leaves the guilty pleading with the rocks.
cards.s_text: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of Yahuah (LORD), and for the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake terribly the earth.
cards.t_text: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Yashar'el (Israel), shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

cards.note: *This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner* (Acts 4:11). Peter, before the rulers of Yashar'el (Israel), names the crucified and risen Yahusha as the Stone of Isaiah 28:16 *set at nought of you builders*, now *become the head of the corner* — *neither is there salvation in any other* (4:12). The Stone laid in Zion is the only sure foundation.
cards.s_text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believes shall not make haste.
cards.t_text: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

cards.note: *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD) the King of Yashar'el (Israel), and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God)* (Isaiah 44:6). The declaration of *I am Yahuah (LORD), and there is none else, there is no Elohim (God) beside me* (Isaiah 45:5) is the same word the chapter before: *I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God)*. The Holy One of Yashar'el alone is Elohim; there is none beside Him from the rising of the sun to the west.
cards.s_text: I am Yahuah (LORD), and there is none else, there is no Elohim (God) beside me: I girded you, though you have not known me:
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) the King of Yashar'el (Israel), and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God).

cards.note: *For so hath Yahuah (Lord) commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth* (Acts 13:47). *Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth* (Isaiah 45:22) is the salvation carried to *the ends of the earth* — the ingathering of the scattered. *In Yahuah (LORD) shall all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) be justified* (45:25); the call goes broad to the ends of the earth, gathering the lost sheep home, never a casting-off of His people (*Hath Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid*, Romans 11:1).
cards.s_text: Look unto me, and be you saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am Elohim (God), and there is none else.
cards.t_text: For so has Yahuah (Lord) commanded us, saying, I have set you to be a light of the Gentiles, that you should be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

cards.note: *And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth* (Isaiah 49:6). *Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth* (Isaiah 45:22) is the servant's commission a few chapters on: the Saviour given *for a light to the Gentiles... my salvation unto the end of the earth*, who FIRST raises up the tribes of Jacob and restores the preserved of Yashar'el — the two-house ingathering before the light reaches the ends of the earth.
cards.s_text: Look unto me, and be you saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am Elohim (God), and there is none else.
cards.t_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

cards.note: *Neither shalt thou commit adultery* (Deuteronomy 5:18). The strange-woman warning of Proverbs 5:20 rests on the word Moses set before all Yashar'el (Israel) a second time: *Neither shalt thou commit adultery*. The Torah is not the curse but the covenant fence around the wife of one's youth; Proverbs only preaches what Sinai commanded.
cards.s_text: And why will you, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
cards.t_text: Neither shall you commit adultery.

cards.note: *And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes* (Deuteronomy 6:8). *Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart* (Proverbs 7:3) speaks the Shema verbatim — Moses said *bind them for a sign upon thine hand*. The wisdom-father is teaching his son the same Torah-binding Yahuah commanded all Yashar'el (Israel); the commandments are to be worn on the hand and graven on the heart.
cards.s_text: Bind them upon your fingers, write them upon the table of your heart.
cards.t_text: And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.

cards.note: *But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people* (Jeremiah 31:33). To *write them upon the table of thine heart* (Proverbs 7:3) is the very promise of the new covenant: *I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts*. The new covenant is not the Torah abolished but the Torah internalized — exactly what the wisdom-father presses upon his son.
cards.s_text: Bind them upon your fingers, write them upon the table of your heart.
cards.t_text: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.

cards.note: *He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye* (Deuteronomy 32:10). When the son is told to hold *my law as the apple of thine eye* (Proverbs 7:2), it is to hold the Torah as Yahuah (LORD) held Yashar'el (Israel) — *he kept him as the apple of his eye*. The Torah is to be guarded as the most precious and tender thing, the way Yahuah guarded His people in the wilderness.
cards.s_text: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of your eye.
cards.t_text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

cards.note: *In those days there was no king in Yashar'el (Israel): every man did that which was right in his own eyes* (Judges 21:25). The era of *right in his own eyes* (Proverbs 12:15) is named by Judges as the era of no king and no Torah heeded — *every man did that which was right in his own eyes*. When each man's own eyes are his measure, the result is the chaos the book of Judges records; the way of a fool, multiplied over a people.
cards.s_text: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
cards.t_text: In those days there was no king in Yashar'el (Israel): every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

cards.note: *And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ)* (1 Corinthians 10:4). *He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved* (Psalm 62:2): read through the Formed and the Formless, the Rock that gave Yashar'el (Israel) water in the wilderness is named — the spiritual Rock was the Messiah, the expressed Word, the One who is salvation and defence. He only is the Rock.
cards.s_text: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
cards.t_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: *But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked... then he forsook Elohim (God) which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation* (Deuteronomy 32:15). *In Elohim (God) is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in Elohim (God)* (Psalm 62:7): the Rock of David's strength is the very Rock of salvation Yashar'el (Israel) lightly esteemed when she waxed fat. The psalm clings where the song warns men forsake — the Rock of salvation.
cards.s_text: In Elohim (God) is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: you are waxen fat, you are grown thick, you are covered with fatness; then he forsook Elohim (God) which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

cards.note: *For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory* (Isaiah 66:18). *Unto thee shall all flesh come* (Psalm 65:2): the all-flesh-come is the gathering of all nations and tongues to see His glory — not a new people replacing Yashar'el (Israel) but the nations gathered in, brought to the holy mountain with the children of Yashar'el (Isaiah 66:20).
cards.s_text: O you that hear prayer, unto you shall all flesh come.
cards.t_text: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

cards.note: *And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people* (Romans 15:10). *Unto thee shall all flesh come* (Psalm 65:2): Paul names the shape of the all-flesh-come — the Gentiles rejoice not INSTEAD of but WITH His people, joined to the covenant, never replacing it. *Elohim (God) hath not cast away his people* (Romans 11:2); the nations come in alongside Yashar'el (Israel), all flesh together before the One who hears prayer.
cards.s_text: O you that hear prayer, unto you shall all flesh come.
cards.t_text: And again he says, Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.

cards.note: *And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust* (Romans 15:12). *Unto thee shall all flesh come* (Psalm 65:2): the all-flesh come and trust IN the root of Jesse — grafted to the covenant root, not a new tree. The nations are gathered to the Davidic King of Yashar'el (Israel), the one root bearing both branches.
cards.s_text: O you that hear prayer, unto you shall all flesh come.
cards.t_text: And again, Esaias says, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

cards.note: *And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left* (Exodus 14:22). *they went through the flood on foot* (Psalm 66:6): this is the going on foot — Yashar'el walking into the midst of the sea on dry ground, the waters standing as walls. The psalm's *Come and see* points straight to the people passing through on foot.
cards.s_text: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
cards.t_text: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

cards.note: *And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob* (Romans 11:26). The mercy on Jacob and the choosing of Yashar'el *set... in their own land* (Isaiah 14:1) is the regathering Paul names as its end: *all Yashar'el shall be saved.* The two houses gathered home, the strangers joined and cleaving to the house of Jacob — the wild olive grown from the same root, not grafted from outside.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (LORD) will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Yashar'el (Israel), and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
cards.t_text: And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

cards.note: *Elohim (God) hath not cast away his people which he foreknew* (Romans 11:2). *And will yet choose Yashar'el (Israel), and set them in their own land* (Isaiah 14:1) is the future Paul anchors in the foreknowledge of Elohim — the people foreknown are not discarded but recovered. The strangers *joined with them* and cleaving *to the house of Jacob* (Isaiah 14:1) are gathered to the same covenant house, never a replacement people.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (LORD) will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Yashar'el (Israel), and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
cards.t_text: Elohim (God) has not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot you not what the scripture says of Elias? how he makes intercession to Elohim (God) against Yashar'el (Israel), saying,

cards.note: *I say then, Hath Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin* (Romans 11:1). The promise *Yahuah (LORD) will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Yashar'el (Israel)* (Isaiah 14:1) is the very thing Paul guards: Elohim has NOT cast away his people. Yashar'el is chosen AGAIN, set again in their own land — mercy, not abandonment.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (LORD) will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Yashar'el (Israel), and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
cards.t_text: I say then, Has Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

cards.note: *Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Ezekiel 37:12). *Thy dead men shall live... and the earth shall cast out the dead* (Isaiah 26:19) is the opened-grave promise Ezekiel makes the resurrection of *the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel)* (37:11) — the TWO-HOUSE resurrection, the dry bones raised and the stick of Joseph joined to the stick of Yahudah (Judah). The dust gives back his people, gathered home.
cards.s_text: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
cards.t_text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Revelation 21:12). The city Isaiah's afflicters *come bending unto* and *call... The Zion of the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Isaiah 60:14) stands in John's vision with *a wall great and high, and... twelve gates... the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).* The vindicated city is the twelve-tribe city — both houses gathered, named on her gates.
cards.s_text: The sons also of them that afflicted you shall come bending unto you; and all they that despised you shall bow themselves down at the soles of your feet; and they shall call you, The city of Yahuah (LORD), The Zion of the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):

cards.note: *A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Yashar'el (Israel)* (Luke 2:32). Simeon names the child the very light of Isaiah 60: *the Gentiles shall come to thy light* (Isaiah 60:3) — *a light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Yashar'el (Israel).* The light to the nations AND the glory of Yashar'el are one and the same Person; the nations come to a light that is first and forever Yashar'el's glory.
cards.s_text: And the Gentiles shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
cards.t_text: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *And grieve not the holy Spirit of Elohim (God), whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption* (Ephesians 4:30). When Yashar'el *rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit* (Isaiah 63:10), they grieved the very Spirit Paul warns against grieving — *the holy Spirit of Elohim (God)*. The Spirit is Yahuah's own presence and power among his people; to vex the Spirit is to grieve Yahuah himself, not to wound a separate co-equal person.
cards.s_text: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
cards.t_text: And grieve not the holy Spirit of Elohim (God), whereby you are sealed unto the day of redemption.

cards.note: *And the angel of Elohim (God), which went before the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them* (Exodus 14:19). The Angel of his Presence who *saved them* (Isaiah 63:9) is the Angel of Elohim at the sea, the One in the pillar who went before and behind the camp to deliver. The visible Presence guarding Yashar'el in the deliverance is the same Formed Son.
cards.s_text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
cards.t_text: And the angel of Elohim (God), which went before the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

cards.note: *Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared* (Exodus 23:20). The Angel of his Presence who *saved them... and carried them all the days of old* (Isaiah 63:9) is the Angel Yahuah sends before his people — *I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way*. The One who bore and carried Yashar'el is the sent Presence, going before to bring them home.
cards.s_text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
cards.t_text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

cards.note: *In those days there was no king in Yashar'el (Israel): every man did that which was right in his own eyes* (Judges 21:25). Judges shows a whole nation walking the way that seems right — *every man did that which was right in his own eyes* — the corporate form of *a way which seemeth right unto a man* (Proverbs 14:12). With no king and no Torah feared, each man's own eyes became the measure, and the end was the chaos the book records.
cards.s_text: There is a way which seems right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
cards.t_text: In those days there was no king in Yashar'el (Israel): every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

cards.note: *Blessed is the nation whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD); and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance* (Psalm 33:12). The exalted nation of Proverbs 14:34 is the nation whose righteousness rests on covenant: *Blessed is the nation whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD)*. Yashar'el is *the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance* — exalted by belonging to Yahuah and walking in His righteousness, never by replacing another people.
cards.s_text: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
cards.t_text: Blessed is the nation whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD); and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

cards.note: *Yahuah (LORD) lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace* (Numbers 6:26). *Elohim (God) be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us* (Psalm 67:1): the lifted countenance and the peace complete the benediction the psalm takes up — mercy, blessing, the shining face, the peace of Yahuah upon Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) lift up his countenance upon you, and give you peace.

cards.note: *And they shall put my name upon the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and I will bless them* (Numbers 6:27). *Elohim (God)... bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us* (Psalm 67:1): the Torah seals the blessing as Yahuah's own act — the Name laid upon the covenant people, and He Himself the One who blesses. The benediction the psalm prays is the blessing Yahuah commanded and performs.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
cards.t_text: And they shall put my name upon the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and I will bless them.

cards.note: *It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth* (Isaiah 49:6). *That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations* (Psalm 67:2): the servant first raises the tribes of Jacob and restores Yashar'el, THEN is given as a light to the nations — the restoration of the two houses and the saving health to the nations are one work, not a replacement of the one by the other.
cards.s_text: That your way may be known upon earth, your saving health among all nations.
cards.t_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

cards.note: *And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people* (Romans 15:10). *O let the nations be glad and sing for joy* (Psalm 67:4): Paul names the frame exactly — the nations rejoice WITH his people, not instead of them. The gladness of the nations in the psalm is the Gentiles brought in alongside Yashar'el (Israel), the two made glad together (Romans 11:1-2: He has not cast away his people).
cards.s_text: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for you shall judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
cards.t_text: And again he says, Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.

cards.note: *The mountains melted from before Yahuah (LORD), even that Sinai from before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Judges 5:5), with *the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water* (Judges 5:4). *The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of Elohim (God): even Sinai itself was moved* (Psalm 68:8): Deborah's song sings the same theophany almost word for word — the earth trembling, the heavens dropping, even that Sinai melting before Yahuah. Two songs of the one going-forth.
cards.s_text: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of Elohim (God): even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: The mountains melted from before Yahuah (LORD), even that Sinai from before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *Whom Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Yashar'el (Israel) mine inheritance* (Isaiah 19:25). *Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto Elohim (God)* (Psalm 68:31): Isaiah names the ingathering the psalm foresees — Egypt called His people, Assyria the work of His hands. Yet Yashar'el remains *mine inheritance*: the nations are joined IN, never a replacement of the covenant people.
cards.s_text: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Whom Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Yashar'el (Israel) my inheritance.

cards.note: *And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ)* (1 Corinthians 10:4). *Thou art my rock and my fortress* (Psalm 71:3): the Rock the aged servant trusts is the Formed Son, the spiritual Rock that followed Yashar'el (Israel) in the wilderness — that Rock was Messiah. To make Yahuah the rock is to take refuge in the One drawn from the Formless.
cards.s_text: Be you my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: you have given commandment to save me; for you are my rock and my fortress.
cards.t_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: *Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb* (Isaiah 46:3). *By thee have I been holden up from the womb* (Psalm 71:6): the same carry — Yahuah bearing His own from the belly — but spoken to the house of Jacob and the remnant of Yashar'el, the two-house people He has carried from the womb of the nation.
cards.s_text: By you have I been holden up from the womb: you are he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of you.
cards.t_text: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:

cards.note: *Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God)* (Matthew 5:8). *Truly Elohim (God) is good to Yashar'el (Israel), even to such as are of a clean heart* (Psalm 73:1): the psalm's thesis is the beatitude before it was spoken — the good of Elohim is for the clean of heart, and the pure in heart are the ones who shall see Him. The whole theodicy is opened by this narrowing: not to all Yashar'el broadly, but to such as are of a clean heart.
cards.s_text: Truly Elohim (God) is good to Yashar'el (Israel), even to such as are of a clean heart.
cards.t_text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).

cards.note: *And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Numbers 18:20). *Elohim (God) is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever* (Psalm 73:26): the priest's portion was Yahuah Himself, no field, no land — and Asaph, a son of the sanctuary singers, makes the Levite's lot his own. The one who has Elohim for his portion needs none of the riches the ungodly increase (73:12).
cards.s_text: My flesh and my heart fails: but Elohim (God) is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Aaron, You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any part among them: I am your part and your inheritance among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *He came unto his own, and his own received him not* (John 1:11). The dumb ox *knoweth his owner* but *Yashar'el (Israel) doth not know, my people doth not consider* (Isaiah 1:3) — and the same not-knowing met the Formed Son when he came to his own in the flesh. Yet *my people* he still calls them: the Owner is faithful even where the owned do not know him.
cards.s_text: The ox knows his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Yashar'el (Israel) does not know, my people does not consider.
cards.t_text: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

cards.note: *But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all* (Luke 17:29). Sodom is the judgment Yashar'el narrowly escaped — *we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah* (Isaiah 1:9). The fire that fell on Lot's city is the verdict the small remnant was spared; the days of Lot stand as the type of the day of reckoning.
cards.s_text: Except Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
cards.t_text: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

cards.note: *Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?* (Isaiah 45:9). Isaiah's twin to *shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?* (Isaiah 29:16). The creature cannot arraign its Maker; the turning of things upside down — clay esteeming itself above the potter — is rebuked in both. The Formed One who fashioned Yashar'el is not answerable to the clay.
cards.s_text: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
cards.t_text: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What make you? or your work, He has no hands?

cards.note: *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD) the King of Yashar'el (Israel), and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God)* (Isaiah 44:6). Isaiah's own earlier word fixes the title to Yahuah alone: *I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God)*. So when Isaiah 48:12 repeats *I am the first, I also am the last*, and the risen Messiah claims it in Revelation, the claim is a claim to be the One beside whom there is no other.
cards.s_text: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Yashar'el (Israel), my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) the King of Yashar'el (Israel), and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God).

cards.note: *My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD)* (Jeremiah 51:45). *Go ye forth of Babylon* (Isaiah 48:20) is *My people, go ye out of the midst of her* — the people Yahuah owns called to come out before the judgment falls. The redeemed servant Jacob is led out of Babylon as Yashar'el was once led out of Egypt; the second exodus.
cards.s_text: Go you forth of Babylon, flee you from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare you, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say you, Yahuah (LORD) has redeemed his servant Jacob.
cards.t_text: My people, go you out of the midst of her, and deliver you every man his soul from the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: *Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Yashar'el (Israel) that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el (Israel) saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore* (Exodus 14:30). *Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon? Art thou not it which hath dried the sea... that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?* (51:9-10) — the Arm's ancient work was the Red Sea: Yahuah saved Yashar'el out of Pharaoh's hand, the dragon-oppressor drowned. The first exodus is the figure the second fulfils.
cards.s_text: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Yahuah (LORD); awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Are you not it that has cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
cards.t_text: Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Yashar'el (Israel) that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el (Israel) saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

cards.note: *And all the peoples whom he brought to pursue after Yashar'el (Israel), Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss beneath the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 48:14). The restored witness records the dragon-overthrow Isaiah invokes — *that hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep* (51:10): the pursuing host cast into the depths of the abyss. The Arm that wounded the dragon hurled Pharaoh's power into the sea.
cards.s_text: Are you not it which has dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that has made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
cards.t_text: And all the peoples whom he brought to pursue after Yashar’el (Israel), Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss beneath the children of Yashar’el (Israel), even as the people of Egypt had cast their children into the river. He took vengeance on 1,000,000 of them, and one thousand strong and energetic men were destroyed on account of one suckling of the children of your people which they had thrown into the river.

cards.note: *But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people* (Jeremiah 31:33). *The people in whose heart is my law* (51:7) ARE this new-covenant people: the law put in the inward parts, written on the heart. The new covenant is not Torah replaced — it is Torah internalized, made with BOTH houses (31:31).
cards.s_text: Hearken unto me, you that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear you not the reproach of men, neither be you afraid of their revilings.
cards.t_text: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.

cards.note: *...for Yahuah (LORD) had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Ezra 6:22). Here the proverb is history: Yahuah *turned the heart of the king of Assyria* toward His people and His house — the very *he turneth it whithersoever he will* of Proverbs 21:1. The Father turns the heart even of a pagan king to serve the restoration of His covenant people.
cards.s_text: The king’s heart is in the hand of Yahuah (LORD), as the rivers of water: he turns it whithersoever he will.
cards.t_text: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for Yahuah (LORD) had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!* (Isaiah 31:1). Isaiah pronounces the woe of trusting the prepared horse over the safety that is of Yahuah (Proverbs 21:31) — *Woe to them that... stay on horses, and trust in chariots... but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel)*. The horse is no counsel against Yahuah; *the Egyptians are men, and not Elohim (God); and their horses flesh, and not spirit* (31:3).
cards.s_text: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of Yahuah (LORD).
cards.t_text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!

cards.note: *For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Yashar'el (Israel), which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children* (Psalm 78:5). The *way he should go* of 22:6 is here named — the *testimony* and the *law* — and its handing-down commanded: *that they should make them known to their children*. The training is the transmission of the Torah from father to son down the generations.
cards.s_text: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
cards.t_text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Yashar'el (Israel), which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

cards.note: *For thus saith Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it* (Jeremiah 25:15). *For in the hand of Yahuah (LORD) there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture... all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them* (Psalm 75:8): the cup in Yahuah's hand is the wine cup of fury Jeremiah is handed — all the nations made to drink it. The psalm names the cup; the prophet pours it.
cards.s_text: For in the hand of Yahuah (LORD) there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he pours out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
cards.t_text: For thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.

cards.note: *For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts)* (Malachi 1:11). *His name is great in Yashar'el (Israel)* (Psalm 76:1): the Name great in His own house is the Name to be great in every place from the rising to the setting of the sun — the great Name carried out to the ends of the earth.
cards.s_text: In Yahudah (Judah) is Elohim (God) known: his name is great in Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: *Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows... even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand* (Ezekiel 37:19). *In Yahudah (Judah) is Elohim (God) known: his name is great in Yashar'el (Israel)* (Psalm 76:1): both houses are named together — the God known in Yahudah and great in Yashar'el, the two sticks that shall be made one in His hand.
cards.s_text: In Yahudah (Judah) is Elohim (God) known: his name is great in Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: Say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

cards.note: *For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done* (Acts 4:28), where Herod and Pilate and the nations and the people of Yashar'el (Israel) *were gathered together* (Acts 4:27). *Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee* (Psalm 76:10): the rulers gathered in rage at the tree could do only what His counsel had determined — the wrath of man accomplishing, not thwarting, the purpose of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise you: the remainder of wrath shall you restrain.
cards.t_text: For to do whatsoever your hand and your counsel determined before to be done.

cards.note: *Moreover, thou son of Adam, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Yahudah (Judah)... then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) his companions* (Ezekiel 37:16). *Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph* (Psalm 77:15): the psalm names the two houses together — Jacob AND Joseph — exactly the two sticks Ezekiel writes: Yahudah and Joseph/Ephraim, the people Yahuah redeems.
cards.s_text: You have with your arm redeemed your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
cards.t_text: Moreover, you son of Adam, take you one stick, and write upon it, For Yahudah (Judah), and for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) his companions:

cards.note: *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel)... and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all* (Ezekiel 37:22). *the sons of Jacob and Joseph* (Psalm 77:15): the two named houses of the psalm are the two nations Ezekiel promises to make one — the redemption begun at the sea consummated in the regathering.
cards.s_text: You have with your arm redeemed your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: *And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left* (Exodus 14:22). *Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known* (Psalm 77:19): the psalm rehearses this very crossing — the path made through the sea, the people walking on dry ground between walls of water; the way of Yahuah in the deep.
cards.s_text: Your way is in the sea, and your path in the great waters, and your footsteps are not known.
cards.t_text: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

cards.note: *Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and observe to do all the words of this law* (Deuteronomy 31:12). *For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Yashar'el (Israel), which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children* (Psalm 78:5): the appointed law is the one to be read in the ears of all, that the children might learn to fear Yahuah and DO the words — the same generational charge the psalm rehearses.
cards.s_text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Yashar'el (Israel), which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
cards.t_text: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and your stranger that is within your gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and observe to do all the words of this law:

cards.note: *Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand* (Ezekiel 37:19). *They kept not the covenant of Elohim (God), and refused to walk in his law* (Psalm 78:10): the indictment of Ephraim is not the end of Ephraim — the same stick of Joseph in the hand of Ephraim is taken up and made one with the stick of Yahudah; the covenant-lawsuit within the family ends in the gathering, not the casting-off.
cards.s_text: They kept not the covenant of Elohim (God), and refused to walk in his law;
cards.t_text: Say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

cards.note: *And she said, The glory is departed from Yashar'el (Israel): for the ark of Elohim (God) is taken* (1 Samuel 4:22). *And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand* (Psalm 78:61): the wife of Phinehas names what the psalm sings — *the glory is departed* — the Ichabod of the captured ark, the judgment on the northern sanctuary at Shiloh.
cards.s_text: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.
cards.t_text: And she said, The glory is departed from Yashar'el (Israel): for the ark of Elohim (God) is taken.

cards.note: *But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jeremiah 7:12). *So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men* (Psalm 78:60): Jeremiah points back to the very forsaking the psalm records — Shiloh, where Yahuah set His name at the first, made a ruin for the people's wickedness; a warning that even the place of the Name is not kept apart from the covenant.
cards.s_text: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
cards.t_text: But go you now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep* (John 10:11). *From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Yashar'el (Israel) his inheritance* (Psalm 78:71): David brought from the ewes to feed Jacob is the foreshadow of the Good Shepherd — the One who feeds and lays down His life for the sheep, gathering Jacob and Yashar'el His inheritance.
cards.s_text: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Yashar'el (Israel) his inheritance.
cards.t_text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd gives his life for the sheep.

cards.note: *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all* (Ezekiel 37:22). *Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim* (Psalm 78:67): the setting-aside of Ephraim as the leading tribe is NOT the casting-off of the northern house — Ezekiel seals the end: the stick of Joseph and the stick of Yahudah made one nation, no more two kingdoms; the choosing of Judah is unto the gathering of both.
cards.s_text: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
