Both branches on the olive tree are Yashar'el (Israel).

*"Yahuah (the LORD) called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit"* (Jeremiah 11:16). The olive IS Yashar'el (Israel). The tree is the covenant lineage planted in Avraham (Abraham), Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqov (Jacob), carried through the twelve tribes.

The natural branches are not a living group today. They are the covenant lineage of Yashar'el (Israel) — the line of Adam carried forward through the patriarchs into the twelve tribes — broken off when both houses fell into unbelief and were scattered. The forefathers who walked the covenant faithfully in their lifetimes (Avraham (Abraham), Yitschaq (Isaac), Ya'aqov (Jacob), Mosheh (Moses), David, the prophets, the faithful unnamed of every generation back) are asleep, awaiting the first resurrection. *"Elohim (God) is able to graft them in again"* (Romans 11:23) — into their own root, at the resurrection. Even Paul did not presume on attaining it.

The wild olive branches are us — the living descendants of the broken-off. Both modern Yahudah (Judah) and the modern scattered seed of Yashar'el (Israel) are children of the broken-off. The wild olive does not partake of the root by mere faith-confession in this age. The wild olive comes home through the journey the prophets named: *gathered out of the nations* (Ezekiel 37:21) -> *brought under the rod* (Ezekiel 20:37) where the rod sifts and *purges out the rebels* (Ezekiel 20:38) -> *brought into the bond of the new covenant* (Jeremiah 31:31) -> and then *grafted into the natural root of the fathers* (Romans 11:24). The grafting is the destination of the journey. Not the doorway.

The cause-and-effect reversal that distinguishes the truth from the inclusion gospel: *if you hear, you are sons of Avraham (Abraham). You are sons of Adam. You are the seed of promise. You are heirs of the covenant.* You did not choose to hear and *become* these things. You heard because you *are* these things. *"My sheep hear my voice... ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep"* (John 10:27, 26). Hearing reveals what was always true. The church says *if you hear and confess, you become a child of Yahuah (the LORD).* Scripture says *if you are a child of Yahuah (the LORD), you will hear when he calls.*

No name is added after the foundation of the world. Names can only be blotted out, and the warning to be blotted out is given to the wheat, not to the tares. The harvest separates wheat from tares; the tares are bound and burned at the harvest because they were never wheat. The gathered wheat then passes through the post-harvest sifting in the wilderness of the peoples — the thread anchored at Ezekiel 20:33-44 — where the rod purges out the rebels from among the gathered.

*"And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Ya'aqov (Jacob)."* (Romans 11:26)

threads.title: Great Commission All Nations As Territories Of The Scattered Seed Not Categorical Three Categories Substance
threads.summary_md: **`great-commission-all-nations-as-territories-of-the-scattered-seed-not-categorical-three-categories-substance`** — **FRAMEWORK-MAJOR anchor at Matt 28:18-20.** The substantial-Great-Commission-substance walks the substantial-territorial-extension-of-the-mission-scope-substance NOT-categorical-Three-Categories-#3-substance per Red Line #7 + `lost-sheep-mission-scope` thread (DUAL-FRAMEWORK-MAJOR-anchored at Matt 10:5-6 + Matt 15:24). The substantial-*panta ta ethnē*-substance is the substantial-territorial-substance the substantial-scattered-seed-of-both-houses-of-Yashar'el (Israel) is-substantially-among-substance per Yeshayahu 11:11-12 + Yechezk'el 37:15-28 + the substantial-Tanakh-substance. Framework rules out the inherited-Christian-collapse of-the-Great-Commission-as-categorical-Gentile-inclusion-substance. 21 members.

threads.title: The Sheep Divided From The Goats — The Gathered Sifted At The Throne Of His Glory
threads.summary_md: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.* (Matthew 25:31-33). *All nations* names where the gathered come from. The seed was scattered among all the nations, and at his coming it is gathered out of them — and then sifted. Ezekiel saw the sifting and where it happens: *And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face... And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Ezekiel 20:35, 37-38). The goats are parted from the sheep among the gathered, before the reign — not the nations judged for entry into it. The measure is mercy shown to *one of the least of these my brethren* (Matthew 25:40), and the brethren are the seed: *for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren* (Hebrews 2:11). The sheep *inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world* (Matthew 25:34) and enter the land as a kingdom of priests to the nations left alive (Zechariah 14:16); the goats are sent toward *everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels* (Matthew 25:41). The warning was always given to the wheat.

threads.title: Fulfill as prophecy bringing to pass
threads.summary_md: The Greek *plēroō* (Strong's G4137) at Matthew 5:17 does not mean *to exhaust-and-thereby-end* — the antichrist reading the pulpit installed to retire the Torah. It means *to bring to pass* — to make happen what was prophesied. Yahusha (Jesus) names what his mission accomplishes: the bringing-to-pass of what the Torah and the Prophets prophesied. And what they prophesied is the gathering of the scattered seed of Yashar'el (Israel) home through redemption — the curse-and-return arc the Torah itself wrote (Leviticus 26:33 and 40-42; Deuteronomy 30:1-5), executed by the prophets in the divorce-and-scattering (Hosea 1:9; Jeremiah 16:13), and opened by the Messiah's death and resurrection so the door home is real. This thread surfaces every NT plēroō occurrence used in prophecy-fulfillment context (35 members), each linked to the specific Tanakh prophecy it brings to pass. The pattern is consistent: the Messiah walks out the substance the prophets foretold, and the NT formula *that it might be fulfilled* points the reader back to the Tanakh, not forward into a new dispensation.

threads.title: Tamar in Yahudah's (Judah's) own voice
threads.summary_md: Matt 1:3 names Tamar in the Messianic genealogy. The Hebrew library's extras-tier witness narrates her story twice over: once in Jasher 45:23-32 with the patriarchal narrative detail Genesis compresses, and once in the Testament of Yahudah (Judah) (Testaments XII chapters 24-39) — the patriarch's deathbed testament to his sons, in his own voice, walking the same Tamar episode Genesis 38 records. Jasher locates Tamar's lineage in Shem's line (a daughter of Elam, son of Shem), confirming the framework's reading of the four women as seed-preservation markers within or adjacent to the covenant body rather than Gentile-inclusion proof-texts.

threads.title: Yashar'el (Israel) the firstborn — the creation-anchor of the Egypt-call
threads.summary_md: Jubilees 2:20 — at the creation register — names the seed of Ya'aqov (Jacob) as Yahuah's firstborn son before any historical event: *I have chosen the seed of Ya'aqov (Jacob) from amongst all that I have seen, and have written him down as My firstborn son, and have sanctified him to Myself for ever and ever.* The Hosea 11:1 / Exodus 4:22 firstborn-identification Matt 2:15 walks rests on this prior creation-anchor in the Hebrew library. Yashar'el is firstborn before the world; the call out of Egypt is the historical actualization of an eternal designation; Yahusha (Jesus) is the firstborn-Yashar'el embodied at every chronological register the Hebrew library carries.

threads.title: The infant-slaughter pattern — Pharaoh, Herod, the deliverer preserved
threads.summary_md: Jasher 67 walks the Pharaoh-Mosheh infant-slaughter narrative in greater detail than Exodus 1: *the Egyptians had embittered the lives of the children of Yashar'el (Israel)... Pharaoh began to spill the blood of the male children of Yashar'el (Israel).* Matthew 2:16's Herod-slaughter at Beth-lehem is the latest beat of the same antichrist-pattern: a king fearing the prophesied deliverer orders the death of the male infants; the deliverer is preserved through a specific intervention; the rest perish; the pattern is named for what it is. The extras-tier Hebrew-library witness shows the typology has been operative across millennia, with the Messianic version at Matt 2 being the recapitulation, not the first instance.

threads.title: The Animal Apocalypse — the dispersed sheep gathered home
threads.summary_md: *And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.* (Matthew 4:19). The men he calls are being sent after sheep, and the Animal Apocalypse had already told the story of those sheep from the scattering to the gathering. First the blindness and the losing of them: *And as touching all this the eyes of those sheep were blinded so that they saw not, and (the eyes of) their shepherds likewise; and they delivered them in large numbers to their shepherds for destruction, and they trampled the sheep with their feet and devoured them. And Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep remained unmoved till all the sheep were dispersed over the field and mingled with them (i.e. the beasts), and they (i.e. the shepherds) did not save them out of the hand of the beasts.* (1 Enoch 89:74-75). Then, late in the age, a generation among them begins to see: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* (1 Enoch 90:6). And at the close, the ones who had been lost come home: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). That is the gathering Ezekiel promised, *And say unto them, Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:* (Ezekiel 37:21), and it is the work the Shepherd names as his own: *And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.* (John 10:16). The disciples called by the lake are the first hands put to that gathering. The sheep who were mingled with the beasts open their eyes when the Shepherd's voice reaches them, and the fishers of men are sent to carry it.

threads.title: The Two Ways of Enoch and the narrow gate
threads.summary_md: *Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.* (Matthew 7:13-14). Two ways and no third one. Moses set them in front of Yashar'el (Israel) at the edge of the land: *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;* (Deuteronomy 30:15), *I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:* (Deuteronomy 30:19). The Psalter opens on the same fork: *For Yahuah (LORD) knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.* (Psalm 1:6), and Jeremiah set it before a city under siege: *And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.* (Jeremiah 21:8). Enoch gave it to his sons as his last instruction: *And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.* (1 Enoch 94:1). He also knew that some would see both roads and still walk the wrong one: *And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.* (1 Enoch 94:2), *And now I say unto you the righteous: Walk not in the paths of wickedness, nor in the paths of death, And draw not nigh to them, lest ye be destroyed.* (1 Enoch 94:3). The Sermon on the Mount does not invent the two ways; it hands them back to the people they were given to, and binds them to what follows in the chapter, the ones who say Lord, Lord and are told to depart, and the two builders. The narrow way is the way of the commandments Moses set before them, and the few who find it are the ones who walk in it.

threads.title: Gather all the tribes of Jacob — Sirach 36 and the return to the house in 1 Enoch 90
threads.summary_md: *And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.* (Matthew 8:11). East and west is the language of the gathering, and the prophets used it of a seed, not of strangers: *Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west; I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;* (Isaiah 43:5-6). Sirach prays for exactly this, and names who is being gathered: *gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning* (Ecclesiasticus 36:11), and the people whose name the prayer rests on, *Yahuah (God), have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Yashar'el (Israel), whom you have named your firstborn* (Ecclesiasticus 36:12). Enoch saw the end of that prayer in the Animal Apocalypse, the scattered sheep brought back into the house: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). The many from east and west who sit at the table with the patriarchs are the tribes of Jacob come home, the sons and daughters brought from far. The children of the kingdom cast out in the next verse are not Judah set aside for a church; they are the unfruitful of the house, sifted under the rod as Ezekiel 20 says the whole gathered people will be. The seat at the table is for the seed that hears, wherever the scattering carried it.

threads.title: The Animal Apocalypse — shepherds judged, new house built, sheep gathered (1 Enoch 90)
threads.summary_md: *But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.* (Matthew 9:36). Ezekiel had already told Yashar'el (Israel) whose fault that was: *Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.* (Ezekiel 34:10), and he had promised the one shepherd who would take their place: *And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.* (Ezekiel 34:23). Enoch saw the whole of it in his second dream, where the flock is given over to seventy shepherds who kill more than they were told to. When the Lord of the sheep comes, the record is opened first: *And I saw that man, who wrote the book according to the command of Yahuah (Lord), till he opened that book concerning the destruction which those twelve last shepherds had wrought, and showed that they had destroyed much more than their predecessors, before Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep.* (1 Enoch 90:17). Then the shepherds answer for the flock: *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). Then the old house is folded up and a new one set in its place: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* (1 Enoch 90:29). And the scattered come home to it: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). So when Yahusha (Jesus) looks at the crowds and sees sheep with no shepherd, he is looking at the flock Ezekiel described and Enoch watched, and he is the shepherd both of them said would come for it.

threads.title: The ten tribes beyond the river — 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13 on the gathering at the latter time
threads.summary_md: Matt 10:5-6's mission-scope to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) AND Matt 10:23's *till the Son of Adam be come* standing-mission-tense — read against 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13:40-47's apocalyptic-register vision of the ten tribes carried away by Salmanasar of Assyria, crossing the waters into Arsareth (the further country), keeping the Torah-statutes they had not kept in the land, and at the latter-time coming back through the parted-stream at the Most High's gathering-arm. Three explicit moves: the identification of the ten tribes as the body the dispersion carried (13:40); the further-country territory where covenant-identity was preserved (13:41-42); the latter-time gathering at the Highest's parting of the stream (13:47). The mission Yahusha (Jesus) commissions at Matt 10 to the lost sheep is the gathering 4 Ezra named as the wisdom-stream apocalyptic future-tense; the present-age STANDING mission of Matt 10:23 walks toward the wisdom-stream's named terminus.

threads.title: Confess Yahuah (God) before the Gentiles, and the multi-stage gathering — Tobit 13-14
threads.summary_md: Matt 10:6's mission-scope to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) + Matt 10:23's standing-mission-until-the-Son-of-Adam-be-come + Matt 10:32's confess-me-before-men — read against Tobit 13-14's wisdom-stream architecture. Tobit 13:3 names the explicit instruction: *confess him before the Gentiles, you children of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the scattered seed in the dispersion confessing Yahuah (God) before the men of the territories where they are scattered. Tobit 13:5 names the gathering-from-all-nations-among-whom-he-has-scattered-us future-tense covenant-action. Tobit 14:5 names the multi-stage gathering-architecture: a FIRST return-to-the-land (the post-Babylon partial-return under Zerubavel/Zerubbabel) AND a LATTER return *from all places of their captivity* at the fulness-of-the-age. The framework reads Matt 10's gathering-commission as the present-age STANDING-MISSION between Tobit's two stages, with the latter-stage still future at the Son of Adam's coming. The mercy-substance (Hosea 6:6, Matt 9:13) is the same mercy-substance gathering the scattered at Matt 10:6.

threads.title: The gospel preached far hence to the lost sheep — Sonnini's Acts of Paul (Acts 29)
threads.summary_md: Matt 10:5-6's lost-sheep mission-scope + Matt 10:23's standing-mission-tense — read against Sonnini's restored *Acts of Paul* (Acts 29) naming the apostolic-extension of the same scope into the territories of the Assyrian-dispersion. Sonnini Acts 29:2 names Paul's motivation for the Spain-and-Britain journey: the scattered children of Yashar'el (Israel) escaped by sea to the isles afar off at the time of the Assyrian captivity (the prophetic-language of Isaiah 49:1, Jeremiah 31:10). Sonnini Acts 29:3 names the commissioning explicitly — *the Yahuah (Lord) commanded the gospel to be preached far hence to the Gentiles, and to the lost sheep of the House of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the identical phrase the King uses at Matt 10:6 and Matt 15:24, now operative in the far-hence territories. Sonnini Acts 29:13 names the apostolic-recognition of the Druid-disclosure of Yashar'el-itish (Israel-itish) descent in the British territories; Paul gives the kiss of peace because the gathering finds the scattered where they have been driven. The Matt 10 commission and the Sonnini Acts 29 commission are one commission across different territorial-reaches of the same dispersion.

threads.title: Wisdom's come-unto-me invitation, the wisdom given to Yashar'el, and the law that endureth for ever — Sirach 24 and Baruch 3-4
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:19's *wisdom is justified of her children* closing — the kingdom-citizens-whose-ears-the-Father-has-opened recognize the heart-Torah-substance underneath both Yochanan's (John's) austerity and Yahusha's (Jesus's) festivity — read against the wisdom-stream's wisdom-personification-tradition and the Torah-as-wisdom anchor in Sirach 24 and Baruch 3-4. Three moves: Sirach 24:19 names the wisdom-figure's *come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits* universal-invitation (the typological-anchor of the Matt 11:28's King's come-unto-me invitation later in the chapter); Baruch 3:36 names the wisdom *given to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved*; Baruch 4:1 identifies the wisdom-given as *the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever* — the wisdom-stream's direct equation of wisdom with the Torah. The framework reads the cluster as a load-bearing wisdom-stream anchor against the institutional-Christian antinomian-reading: the wisdom-given to Yashar'el (Israel) IS the Torah; the Torah endures for ever; the children-of-wisdom at Matt 11:19 are the kingdom-citizens-who-keep-the-commandments.

threads.title: The honor of parents — the fifth-commandment substance the Pharisaic Corban-tradition voids — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3 and 7, and Tobit 4
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:3-6's Pharisaic-Corban-tradition exposé — *Why do ye also transgress the commandment of Elohim (God) by your tradition? For Elohim (God) commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother ... But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of Elohim (God) of none effect by your tradition* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the fifth-commandment substance the Pharisaic-Corban-tradition voids. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3:1 names *hear me your father, O children, and do thereafter, that you may be safe* (the wisdom-stream's headline articulation of the parental-honor architecture as the foundation-of-the-children's-safety); Sirach 3:8 names the holistic-honor — *honour your father and mother both in word and deed, that a blessing may come upon you from them* (the architecture the Pharisaic-Corban-tradition split, allowing word-without-deed); Sirach 7:27 names the whole-heart-honor — *honour your father with your whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of your mother* (the heart-level architecture the King will close the loop on at vv.18-20); Sirach 3:16 names the worst-end — *he that forsaketh his father is as a blasphemer; and he that angereth his mother is cursed: of Yahuah (God)* (the disposition of the Pharisaic-Corban-tradition at its most-honest naming — blasphemy and curse); Tobit 4:3 names the deathbed-instruction — *my son, when I am dead, bury me; and despise not your mother, but honour her all the days of your life* (the second-Temple Yashar'el (Israel)-household's articulation of the all-the-days-of-her-life parental-honor extension). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the Torah-substance the King defends against the Pharisaic-Corban-tradition. The Pharisaic-system had built the Corban-vow-mechanism to override the parental-honor commandment while preserving its righteousness-credentialing; the wisdom-stream had named the substance the tradition was voiding centuries before. The King's-charge at vv.3-6 lands at the same load-bearing diagnostic the wisdom-stream had named: the disposition that voids the parental-honor commandment is at the architecture of blasphemy-against-the-Torah-the-Father-spoke-from-Sinai.

threads.title: The gathering of the scattered twelve tribes — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36, 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13, and Tobit 13 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:24's *I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the King's-own-mission-scope statement, paired with the Matt 10:5-6's apostolic-mission-scope, reading as the load-bearing scripture-anchor for the framework's gathering-of-the-scattered-twelve-tribes thesis — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the gathering-of-the-scattered-tribes prayer-and-prophecy substance. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:1 names the petition — *have mercy upon us, O Yahuah (God) of all, and behold us* (the wisdom-stream's-prayer-for-the-gathering); Sirach 36:11 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning* (the explicit wisdom-stream-articulation of the twelve-tribes-restoration the prophets had named at Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 37:21; Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:8-10; Hosea 1:10-11; Zekharyah (Zechariah) 10:6-10); 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13:40 names the ten-tribes-carried-away — *those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive* (the wisdom-stream's-direct-articulation of the Assyrian-exile-architecture the lost-sheep-mission-scope addresses); 2 Esdras 13:48 names the remnant-within-the-borders — *but those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders* (the wisdom-stream's naming of both registers the King's-mission addresses); Tobit 13:5 names the scourge-then-mercy-then-gathering-out-of-all-nations — *he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us* (the operative-architecture the King's-mission enacts). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the lost-sheep-mission-scope's wisdom-stream corroboration. The Pharisaic-system had built credentialing-systems on top of the binary (Yahudah (Judah) and the nations, no scattered-twelve-tribes coming-home); the wisdom-stream had preserved the architecture the prophets had named. The King's-mission at v.24 IS the operative-form of the wisdom-stream's-prayer at Sirach 36:11; the lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) the King is sent-to IS the all-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov (Jacob) the wisdom-stream had prayed for the gathering of. The framework reads the Canaanite-woman's mercy-at-the-crumbs-substance (vv.25-28) within the architecture — as the master's-table-mercy-to-the-categorical-nations-individual that does NOT collapse the seed-distinction (Red Line #7) but operates within it.

threads.title: The seed of promise specifically to Yashar'el (Israel) — not to the other seed of Avraham (Abraham) — Jubilees 15 and 16 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:22-28's Canaanite-woman pericope — the King's-children-vs-dogs distinction at v.26 (*it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs*) and the woman's-acceptance-of-the-architecture at v.27 (*Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table*) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the seed-of-promise-specifically-to-Yashar'el (Israel)-NOT-to-other-seed-of-Avraham (Abraham) substance. Four moves: Jubilees 15:30 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *for Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah (God) did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar'el (Israel) to be His people* (the wisdom-stream's precise articulation of the seed-distinction the Pharisaic-system's-binary erased and the modern-Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion-gospel's seed-collapse erases); Jubilees 15:31 names the spiritual-jurisdictional architecture — *for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him* (the *bene Elohim* allocation per Devarim (Deuteronomy) 32:8-9's Septuagint and Dead Sea Scrolls reading); Jubilees 15:32 names the Yashar'el (Israel)-under-direct-rule architecture — *but over Yashar'el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler* (the architecture the King's-mission-to-the-lost-sheep at v.24 enacts under the Father's-direct-shepherding); Jubilees 16:17 names the holy-seed-from-the-sons-of-Yitschaq (Isaac) — *and (that) all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations. For he should become the portion of Yahuah (God) most High* (the explicit wisdom-stream-articulation of the holy-seed-from-Yitschaq (Isaac)-NOT-reckoned-among-the-nations architecture). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the Red Line #7 seed-distinction's wisdom-stream corroboration. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture with explicit-precision centuries before the Pharisaic-binary and the modern-false-inclusion-gospel's seed-collapse arose. The Canaanite-woman is outside the seed-architecture the wisdom-stream had named; the King's-distinction at v.26 operates exactly in the architecture; the woman's-acceptance-at-v.27 honors the architecture; the King's-mercy-at-the-crumbs-substance at v.28 grants-within-the-architecture without collapsing it. The framework reads this in continuity with Romans 9:6-13's *they are not all Yashar'el (Israel), which are of Yashar'el (Israel) ... in Yitschaq (Isaac) shall thy seed be called* — Paul's articulation of the same wisdom-stream substance the inherited-Christian reading flattens-to-the-replacement-theology-of-the-church-replacing-Yashar'el (Israel) or the Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion-gospel's self-selection-by-belief-and-practice.

threads.title: The Lord of the sheep and the gathering — 1 Enoch 40 and 89-90 beside Matthew 18:10-14
threads.summary_md: *Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven. For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.* (Matthew 18:10-11). Then comes the shepherd who leaves the ninety and nine on the mountains to go after the one that strayed, and the Father's will that not one of these little ones should perish. Enoch saw the angels who stand before that face. *And he said to me: 'This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.'* (1 Enoch 40:9). And in the dream of the sheep he saw the Shepherd himself, called by the name Yahuah. When the wolves of Egypt oppressed the flock, the sheep cried to their Lord, and he came down for them: *And a sheep which had been saved from the wolves fled and escaped to the wild asses; and I saw the sheep how they lamented and cried, and besought their Lord with all their might, till that Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep descended at the voice of the sheep from a lofty abode, and came to them and pastured them.* (1 Enoch 89:16). The same Lord raises up a shepherd when the beasts devour the flock, *And the dogs and the foxes and the wild boars began to devour those sheep till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep raised up [another sheep] a ram from their midst, which led them.* (1 Enoch 89:42), and when the sheep forsake his house and are given over, Enoch watches until the day the eyes of the lambs come open: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* (1 Enoch 90:6). At the end the Lord of the sheep acts for them with his own hand: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.* (1 Enoch 90:18). This is Ezekiel 34 in a dream, the Father against the shepherds who fed themselves and the one Shepherd who comes to seek the lost. The parable in Matthew works at both levels at once: the little one in the assembly who must not be despised, and the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) he said he was sent to. Both belong to the same Lord of the sheep, and the lambs whose eyes open are the ones who hear his voice when he calls, because they are his.

threads.title: The gathering of the twelve tribes and the thrones of judgment — Jubilees 1, 31 + Sirach 36 + Wisdom of Solomon 3 + Testaments XII Joseph 15 on Matt 19:27-30 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 19:27-30's FRAMEWORK-MAJOR moment — Kefa (Peter)'s *we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?* + the King's-mouth-most-direct-statement of the consummated-kingdom-architecture *in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* + the hundredfold-and-everlasting-life substance + the *many that are first shall be last* bridge to Matt 20 — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the gathering-of-the-twelve-tribes + the thrones-of-judgment architecture. Five moves: Jubilees 1:15 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the gathering-from-amongst-all-the-nations substance (*I shall gather them from amongst all the nations*) — the substance the King's-Matt-19:28-statement presupposes-as-the-completed-gathering-architecture, in continuity with Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 37:21-22's two-sticks-becoming-one + Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:11-12's *outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)... dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth* + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31's new-covenant-with-both-houses; Jubilees 31:15 names the princes-and-judges-of-all-the-seed-of-the-sons-of-Jacob substance (*they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob; They will speak the word of Yahuah (God) in righteousness, And they will judge all His judgments in righteousness*) — the substance the King's *judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* at v.28 carries-forward; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:11 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the gather-all-the-tribes-of-Jacob-together substance (*gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning*) — the wisdom-stream's prayer-for-the-redemption-and-gathering-of-Yashar'el (Israel) the King at Matt 19:28 names as-completed-in-the-regeneration; Wisdom of Solomon 3:8 names the souls-of-the-righteous *they shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Elohim (God) shall reign for ever* substance — the consummated-kingdom's kingdom-of-priests architecture for the nations-left-alive-after-the-day-of-Yahuah (the LORD) per Shemot (Exodus) 19:6, Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 61:6, Revelation 1:6, 5:10; Testaments XII Joseph 15 (chapter 86) verse 2 names the twelve-harts-feeding-then-dispersed substance (*there were twelve harts feeding: and the nine were (first) dispersed over all the earth, and likewise also the three*) — the twelve-tribes-dispersed-and-gathered architecture the Tanakh-prophets had named (Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 37:15-22's two-sticks substance: nine = the ten-northern-tribes; three = the southern-house-substance + Levi-priestly-substance) and the King's-substance restates at the King's-mouth. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for Red Line #11 — the twelve-tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) at the regeneration are LITERAL twelve-tribes, the paternal-blood remnant the Father-promised-through-the-prophets-and-the-wisdom-stream-and-now-states-at-the-King's-mouth. The framework rules out: the institutional-Christian replacement-theology substance that-collapses-the-twelve-tribes into the church-as-spiritual-Yashar'el (Israel); the Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion-gospel that-collapses-the-twelve-tribes into anyone-who-believes-and-Torah-keeps-is-therefore-Yashar'el (Israel) (both branches on the olive-tree are Yashar'el (Israel) — natural-branches the covenant-lineage of the patriarchs and-the-faithful-of-every-generation, wild-olive-branches the descendants-of-the-broken-off coming-home through-the-journey-the-prophets-named); the spiritualization-of-the-twelve-thrones into a-metaphor-of-spiritual-authority (the substance is concrete — twelve thrones in the consummated-kingdom for the twelve-apostles, in continuity with Revelation 4:4's twenty-four-elders-around-the-throne and Revelation 21:12-14's twelve-gates-named-for-the-twelve-tribes-with-twelve-foundations-named-for-the-twelve-apostles-of-the-Lamb).

threads.title: The vineyard of Yashar'el (Israel) and the sovereign-grace of the master — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24 + Sirach 33 + 2 Esdras 5 + 2 Esdras 9's wisdom-stream witness to the laborers-in-the-vineyard parable
threads.summary_md: Matt 20:1-16's laborers-in-the-vineyard parable — the householder hiring labourers across the day's hours (first, third, sixth, ninth, eleventh) and-paying the-same-penny-at-sunset — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the vineyard-of-Yashar'el (Israel) + the-sovereign-grace-of-the-master-distributing-by-the-master's-will architecture. The framework reads the parable carefully — the laborers-in-the-vineyard substance is NOT the Reformation grace-vs-merit grammar (which would read the parable as faith-alone-over-against-works-of-Torah, collapsing the kingdom-economy into the inherited-Reformed-antinomian-substance the framework rules-out per Red Line #2 and the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section of framework-deep.md); the parable's substance is the kingdom-economy-of-the-Father's-grace-distributed-by-the-householder's-will, NOT-against-the-Father's-Way-of-Torah but-as-the-very-means-by-which-the-Father-brings-the-scattered-home. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24:8 names the wisdom-of-Yahuah-planted-in-Ya'aqov (Jacob) and Yashar'el (Israel) — the same vineyard-as-the-covenant-body the prophet Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 5:1-7 names; Sirach 24:12 names the rooted-in-the-honourable-people substance (the natural-and-wild-olive-branches of the olive-tree-of-Yashar'el (Israel) per Red Line #11); Sirach 33:13 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the sovereign-distribution-by-the-master's-will the householder's closing-question at Matt 20:15 articulates — *is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own?* The same clay-in-the-potter's-hand substance Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 64:8 and Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 18:6 name; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5:23 names the one-only-vine-the-Father-has-chosen-out-of-all-the-trees-of-the-earth substance (the singular-election-of-the-vineyard-of-Yashar'el (Israel) the prophets and the wisdom-stream cohere on); 2 Esdras 9:22 names the many-perish-but-the-grape-and-the-plant-are-kept substance — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substance the King's closing *many be called, but few chosen* at v.16 lands. The historic-redemptive substance the parable carries — early-hired prefiguring Yahudah (Judah) the southern-house-that-retained-the-tribal-identity, eleventh-hour-laborers prefiguring the scattered-seed-of-Yashar'el (Israel) the ten-northern-tribes now-being-gathered-home through-the-King's-proclamation, the same-penny-of-inheritance ruling-out the murmuring-against-the-late-coming-of-the-scattered-seed-from-any-quarter — coheres at Red Line #11's ingathering-of-the-paternal-blood-remnant architecture and at the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* completion-of-the-sentence the Reformation cut-in-half.

threads.title: The Davidic-Messianic Son recognized by the marginalized — Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 37-38's star-from-Ya'aqov (Jacob) + Branch-of-Elohim + sceptre-of-the-kingdom witness to Matt 20:29-34

threads.title: The Davidic-Messianic-King meek-on-the-foal at the entry — Testaments of the XII Patriarchs (Yahudah ch 15), 2 Maccabees 10:7's branches-and-palms-and-psalms, and Sirach 36:14's glory-filling-Tsion

The framework reads the substance per Red Line #7 + Red Line #11 — the *all that call upon Yahuah (Lord)* in Test. Yahudah carries the wisdom-stream-convention of *Gentiles* as the scattered-seed-of-Yashar'el (Israel) living-as-Gentiles-among-the-nations per the apostolic-Paul-letters-convention, NOT the categorical-Three-Categories-#3-nations replacing-Yashar'el; the meekness-substance is the Greek *praus* / Hebrew *ani* substance per Matthew 5:5 and Matthew 11:29 the King-of-Yashar'el walks-against the natural-kingdoms'-substance-of-domination per Matthew 20:25.

threads.title: Temple-cleansing and the Maccabean-rededication architecture — 1 Maccabees 4, 2 Maccabees 10, and Sirach 35:12's do-not-corrupt-with-gifts
threads.summary_md: Matt 21:12-17's temple-cleansing-substance — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) overturning-the-tables-of-the-moneychangers in the Court-of-the-goyim (Gentiles); the King citing Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 56:7 *my house shall be called the house of prayer* (whose context names the outcasts-of-Yashar'el being-gathered-to-the-holy-mountain — the gathering of the scattered-seed-coming-home per Red Line #7) + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 7:11 *den of thieves* (whose context is one of the Tanakh's most-substantial Temple-judgment-passages, walking the same substance against the Second-Temple leadership the prophet had walked at the First-Temple); the healing of the blind-and-the-lame in the Temple reversing the rabbinic-substance reading of 2 Samuel 5:8 as a categorical-exclusion; the children-in-the-Temple crying *Hoshia-na (Hosanna) to the Son of David* with the King citing Tehillim (Psalm) 8:2 *out of the mouth of babes and sucklings* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Maccabean-Hanukkah-temple-cleansing architecture and the wisdom-stream's direct articulation against the substance of corrupt-gifts. Four moves: 1 Maccabees 4:43 names the wisdom-stream's direct verbal-anchor for the cleansing-of-the-sanctuary substance (*who cleansed the sanctuary, and bare out the defiled stones into an unclean place*) — the architectural-substance the King-walks-out at the Second-Temple-pivot, with the architectural-parallel running at-two-different-pivots between the Maccabean-cleansing-against-the-Antiochene-outer-defilement and the King's-cleansing-against-the-Pharisaic-Sadducean-inner-corruption; 2 Maccabees 10:3 names the wisdom-stream's narration of the Hanukkah-cleansing-followed-by-the-restoration-of-the-sacrifice + the incense + the lights + the shewbread (*having cleansed the temple they made another altar*) — the substance the Father's-house was-meant-for; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 35:12 names THE direct verbal-anchor against the substance of the monetization-substance the King-overturns-the-tables-of (*do not think to corrupt with gifts; for such he will not receive: and trust not to unrighteous sacrifices; for Yahuah (God) is judge, and with him is no respect of persons*) — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation the King walks-out at the temple-cleansing-substance; 1 Maccabees 4:46 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the prophet-yet-to-come substance (*until there should come a prophet to shew what should be done with them*) — the wisdom-stream-substance had-laid the substance-of-anticipation for the prophet-to-come whom the multitude at v.11 names *the prophet of Natsareth (Nazareth) of Galil (Galilee)* and the King-walks-out at the temple-cleansing-substance carrying-the-substance-of-the-prophet-arrived. The framework reads the substance per the system-not-people-posture — the substance the King-walks-against is the Pharisaic-Sadducean-leadership-substance the wisdom-stream-Sirach-50-substance had-named the Simon-the-high-priest-substance the architectural-parallel-of; the substance is-NOT the people-of-Yashar'el (Israel) categorically.

threads.title: Leaves without fruit — the fig tree, the unfruitful branches of Wisdom and Sirach, and the flock torn when its shepherds fall away
threads.summary_md: *And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.* (Matthew 21:19). The tree had the look of a tree in season and nothing under the leaves, and the King's hand on it was a prophet's act against a leadership that had the same look. The prophets had used the fig that way for a long time, Hosea and Jeremiah and Joel and Micah all going to the tree for fruit and finding none. The Wisdom of Solomon says what becomes of such a tree: *for though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out* (the Wisdom of Solomon 4:4), and *the imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing* (the Wisdom of Solomon 4:5). Sirach says the same of the line that has no root: *her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit* (Ecclesiasticus 23:25). The Animal Apocalypse shows what it costs the flock when the ones set over it forsake the house: *And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place. And He gave them over into the hands of the lions and tigers, and wolves and hyenas, and into the hand of the foxes, and to all the wild beasts, and those wild beasts began to tear in pieces those sheep.* (1 Enoch 89:54-55). The curse on the tree is not a curse on Yashar'el (Israel). It falls on the leaders with leaves and no fruit, the same men the woes of Matthew 23 are spoken to, the shepherds Ezekiel 34 and Jeremiah 23 said fed themselves and scattered the sheep. Leaves without fruit leave a flock without a shepherd, and the good shepherd came for the flock those shepherds scattered.

threads.title: The wicked husbandmen — prophets slain, house desolate, corrupt shepherds judged, and the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) gathered as from the beginning
threads.summary_md: The vineyard is Isaiah's, the vineyard of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) which is the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and the husbandmen who beat and kill the owner's servants are the men entrusted with it, the leadership, not the people of the vineyard. The servants are the prophets, and the killing is the pattern the whole Tanakh records. Ezra heard the Father name it: *I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands* (2 Esdras 1:32), and name its consequence: *your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble* (2 Esdras 1:33), which is what Yahusha (Jesus) says to the city at the end of chapter 23 and shows the disciples at the start of chapter 24. Last of all the owner sends his son, and the crowd itself pronounces the sentence: *They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.* (Matthew 21:41). Enoch watched that sentence carried out in the dream of the sheep. The Lord of the sheep handed his flock to seventy shepherds with a count of how many might be destroyed, *And I saw till those shepherds pastured in their season, and they began to slay and to destroy more than they were bidden, and they delivered those sheep into the hand of the lions.* (1 Enoch 89:65), and in the end *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). Then comes the verse the pulpit turned into replacement: *the kingdom of Elohim (God) shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.* A nation, one, singular in the Greek. Not the Gentile church in place of Yashar'el (Israel); the stewardship taken from the men who held it and given to the fruit-bearing remnant of both houses, gathered as the prophets said. Sirach prayed for exactly that: *gather all the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning* (Ecclesiasticus 36:11). The stone the builders rejected becomes the head of the corner, and the vineyard goes to the tribes brought home.

threads.title: The pride-and-religious-status architecture — Sirach's wisdom-stream witness to the kingdom-inversion the King walks-against at Matt 23:1-12
threads.summary_md: Matt 23:1-12's introduction — *the scribes and the Pharisees sit in Mosheh's (Moses's) seat* + *they say, and do not* + the heavy-burdens-the-leadership-substance-binds-on-others-while-not-moving-them-with-one-finger + the for-to-be-seen-of-men display of broadened-Tefillin and enlarged-Tsitsit (the *making-broad* and *enlarging* of the Torah-substance for the display, NOT the Tefillin or Tsitsit themselves — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walked-the-Tsitsit himself per Matt 9:20 and 14:36) + the love-of-uppermost-rooms-at-feasts-and-chief-seats-in-the-synagogues + the categorical-rejection-of-religious-paternity-titles (NOT against the Hebrew-teaching-relationship the apostles still walked or the natural-father-honor the King walked at the cross at John 19:26-27, but against the substance-of-religious-status the leadership-substance loved) + the kingdom-inversion-substance (*he that is greatest among you shall be your servant*) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the pride-and-religious-status architecture in Sirach (Ecclesiasticus). Four moves: Sirach 10:14 names the Yahuah-casting-down-thrones-of-proud-princes substance the kingdom-inversion at Matt 23:12 walks-from; Sirach 3:18 names the greater-you-are-more-humble-thyself substance the King names at Matt 23:11; Sirach 7:4 names the seek-not-preeminence substance the King walks-against at Matt 23:6; Sirach 32:1 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the master-of-the-feast-lift-not-thyself-up substance the King walks-against at Matt 23:6's *uppermost rooms at feasts*. The framework reads the cluster against the inherited-Christian-pulpit's collapse of the wisdom-stream into mere-piety-literature — Sirach carries the same Father's-voice the Tanakh-prophets and the King walk-from, and the kingdom-inversion-substance is the same substance the prophet-Mishlei (Proverbs) walks at Proverbs 16:18 and 29:23, the apostle-Ya'aqov (James) walks at James 4:6, 10, the apostle-Kefa (Peter) walks at 1 Peter 5:5-6, and the King walks at the foot-washing-substance of John 13:13-14. The system-not-people posture holds throughout — the substance the King walks-against is the leadership-substance-of-religious-status, NOT the people the leadership-substance victimizes.

threads.title: The corrupted priesthood and the proselyte made twofold — Testament of Levi, 1 Enoch 99, Wisdom of Solomon beside Matthew 23:13-22
threads.summary_md: The first three woes are aimed at a priesthood. They shut up the kingdom of heaven against men and will not go in themselves, they split hairs over which oath binds and which does not, and in between those two stands the woe that names what the whole system was doing: *Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.* (Matthew 23:15). The proselyte was told that becoming a Yahudi (Jew) by the rite would save him, and then he was handed a Torah buried under traditions that voided it, so he ended up worse off than the men who made him. Paul fights the same gospel in Galatia a generation later, and it is still being preached today under other names, wherever a system tells a man that joining it is salvation and then teaches him against the commandments. Enoch had already described the men who do this: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.* (1 Enoch 99:2). Perverting the words of uprightness while transgressing the eternal law is the proselyte-maker's trade exactly, and the man he makes is transformed into what he was not. The Testament of Levi had warned the priests themselves that they would deal lawlessly with Yashar'el (Israel) until the veil of the temple was rent, and that the priests of the last times would be idolaters, adulterers, lovers of money, proud and lawless, and the Wisdom of Solomon tells the ministers of the kingdom that they will be judged because they did not judge aright nor keep the law. The test is the same one John gives: whoever says he knows him and does not keep his commandments is a liar. Hold that against any priesthood, in any age, and the woes find their mark. The mark is the system, not the people under it. The King speaking the woes is himself a Yahudi (Jew), so are the apostles, so are the crowds in front of him, and the chapter ends not with their rejection but with his lament over the children he would have gathered.

threads.title: Swearing and the faithful yes-and-nay — Sirach's wisdom-stream witness to the third-woe at Matt 23:16-22
threads.summary_md: Matt 23:16-22's third-woe — the Pharisaic-rabbinic-elaborate-distinction-binding-and-non-binding-oaths-substance (*whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor* + *whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gift that is upon it, he is a debtor*) walking-against the Torah's-direct-substance at Vayikra (Leviticus) 19:12, Bamidbar (Numbers) 30:2, and Devarim (Deuteronomy) 23:21-23 (every-vow-binds, every-oath-counts) — the same substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) had-already-walked at Matt 5:33-37 (*swear not at all*) and the apostle-Ya'aqov (James) walks at James 5:12 — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the swearing-substance the Pharisaic-casuistic-distinction-substance walks-against. Three moves: Sirach 23:9 names the accustom-not-thy-mouth-to-swearing substance directly; Sirach 23:11 names the man-that-useth-much-swearing-shall-be-filled-with-iniquity substance — the seriousness of every-oath the wisdom-stream names; Sirach 27:14 names the talk-of-him-that-sweareth-much substance — the brawls-substance the wisdom-stream warns against. The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the substance the King names at vv.16-22 — the Pharisaic-oral-tradition-substance built-the-casuistic-distinction-substance against-the-wisdom-stream and against-the-Torah-substance directly; the wisdom-stream and the Torah and the gospel and the apostolic-substance all cohere at the every-oath-counts-substance. The substance the King walks at Matt 5:37 (*let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay*) is the substance the wisdom-stream had-named at Sirach 23 and the apostle-Ya'aqov (James) walks at James 5:12 — the same Father's-voice walks-across the Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream-and-gospel-and-apostolic-substance.

threads.title: The gathering of the elect from the four winds — 1 Enoch 57, 61 and 90 beside Matthew 24:27-31
threads.summary_md: *For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* (Matthew 24:27). There is nothing secret about it. He comes in the clouds with power and great glory, and then the trumpet sounds: *And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.* (Matthew 24:31). Enoch heard that sound from end to end of heaven in the second Parable: *And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south. And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.* (1 Enoch 57:1-2). And he was told that none of the elect will be missed in the gathering, not even the ones the earth had swallowed: *And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, And those who have been destroyed by the desert, And those who have been devoured by the beasts, And those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea, That they may return and stay themselves On the day of the Elect One; For none shall be destroyed before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And none can be destroyed.* (1 Enoch 61:5). In the dream of the sheep the same gathering closes the vision: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). The elect gathered from the four winds are the sheep, the house of Yashar'el (Israel) scattered through every nation, the ones the prophets never stopped promising to bring home: *And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.* (Isaiah 11:12); *And say unto them, Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:* (Ezekiel 37:21). Moses, Jeremiah, Hosea, Micah, Zephaniah and Zechariah say the same thing in their own places. The gathering at the trumpet is the gathering of the twelve tribes, the paternal seed of the fathers, and not a spiritual category anyone can elect himself into.

threads.title: The signs of the end and the ten tribes gathered — 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5 + 13 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)

The substantial-substance is THE most-direct wisdom-stream corroboration of the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes the substantial-prophets walked the substantial-ingathering substance for — Red Line #11's central anchor at the substantial-pseudepigraphic-register. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR. threads.title: The mercy toward the poor, the stranger, and the needy as the criterion of righteousness — Sirach and Tobit's wisdom-stream witness to the sheep-and-goats criterion of mercy

threads.title: The blood of the new covenant and the faithful-unto-death for the covenant — 1 Maccabees + 2 Maccabees' Maccabean-faithful-servants prefiguring of the Last-Supper's new-covenant-substance (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)

threads.title: The kings and the mighty condemning the Elect One, and the Elect One vindicated on the throne of his glory — 1 Enoch 62-63 beside Matthew 27
threads.summary_md: *When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death:* (Matthew 27:1). David had seen that council: *The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahuah (LORD), and against his anointed, saying,* (Psalm 2:2). By the afternoon the same men are under the cross: *He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him. He trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of Elohim (God).* (Matthew 27:42-43). Enoch saw the other end of that scene. He saw the day the kings and the mighty are summoned to look at the one they condemned: *And thus Yahuah (Lord) commanded the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, and said: 'Open your eyes and lift up your horns if ye are able to recognize the Elect One.'* (1 Enoch 62:1); *And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.* (1 Enoch 62:3). He could have called twelve legions of angels at Gethsemane and did not, because the one who was hidden from the beginning was walking the road the Father laid for him: *For from the beginning the Son of Adam was hidden, And the El Elyon (Most High) preserved him in the presence of His might, And revealed him to the elect.* (1 Enoch 62:7). His cry from the cross is the opening line of Psalm 22, and that psalm does not end forsaken; it ends with the Father hearing and all the ends of the earth turning to him. The Father did not abandon the Son; the Son prayed the psalm the way the Suffering Servant was always going to pray it, through to its end. And the men who mocked will one day beg for a moment's respite: *In those days shall the mighty and the kings who possess the earth implore (Him) to grant them a little respite from His angels of punishment to whom they were delivered, that they might fall down and worship before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and confess their sins before Him.* (1 Enoch 63:1), and they will say what they refused to say at Golgotha: *And splendid in every secret thing is Thy power from generation to generation, And Thy glory for ever and ever: Deep are all Thy secrets and innumerable, And Thy righteousness is beyond reckoning.* (1 Enoch 63:3). Paul says every knee will bow at the name of Yahusha, things in heaven, in earth and under the earth. The cross and the throne are the same figure seen from two days.

The audience is the citizens-of-the-kingdom-scattered-among-the-territories-of-the-nations whom we do-not-know-by-sight; the proclamation goes broadly; those-who-hear-are-revealed-to-be-sheep-because-they-were-sheep-before-the-foundation-of-the-world (John 10:26-27 + Revelation 13:8 + 17:8). Five moves: 2 Esdras 13:40 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the ten-tribes-carried-away-into-another-land substance — the substantial-scattered-northern-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel)-substance the prophet-Hosheia (Hosea) had named the Lo-Ammi-substance for at Hosea 1:9-10; 2 Esdras 13:47 names the Father-staying-the-springs-of-the-stream-again substance for the substantial-second-recovery-gathering-of-the-ten-tribes-back-from-the-far-country — the substantial-substance Isaiah 11:11-12 walks (*Yahuah (the LORD) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people ... from the four corners of the earth*); Jubilees 1:15 names the Father-gathering-the-citizens-from-amongst-all-the-nations substance with-all-their-heart and-all-their-soul-and-all-their-strength (the Shema-substance of Deuteronomy 6:5 woven-into the gathering-architecture); Jubilees 1:23 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the substantial-circumcised-heart + holy-spirit-given substance the new-covenant of Jeremiah 31:31-34 + Ezekiel 36:26-27 walks — the operative-substance of the substantial *baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit)* at v.19b and the *teaching them to observe all things* heart-Torah-substance at v.20 directly-closing the Matt 5:17-19 anti-antinomian-declaration bookend; Jubilees 1:25 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the substantial-Hosea 1:10 substance the apostle-Sha'ul (Paul) cites at Romans 9:25-26 (*ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)*) — the substantial-Lo-Ammi-reversal-substance the substantial-scattered-seed-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel)-substance walks-out at the substantial-Father's-second-recovery-substance. The substantial-three-category-architecture holds: house-of-Yahudah (Judah) + scattered-seed-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) + nations. The substantial-Great-Commission walks the substantial-territorial-pursuit-of-the-scattered-seed-of-both-houses substantively-among-the-territories-of-the-nations — the audience is the citizens; the practice is broad proclamation; the nations' place in the covenant-architecture is the substantial-receiving-of-the-priestly-instruction-substance from the gathered-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes at the substantial-millennial-substance per Micah 4:1-3 + Isaiah 61:6 + Exodus 19:6 + Revelation 1:6 + 5:10 + 20:6. The framework's rejection of-the-categorical-grafting-by-faith-confession substance is non-negotiable per Red Line #11. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR — the signature framework-load for Matt 28.

threads.title: The King ascending and the tribes rising each over his tribe — Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs (Benjamin Ch 7-8 in the Charles concatenation) on the resurrection-architecture-paired-with-the-twelve-tribes-restoration the Great Commission walks-out from
threads.summary_md: Matt 28:10's *go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee* + Matt 28:16-20's eleven-on-the-Galilee-mountain + Great-Commission — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substantial-King-ascending-from-Hades-to-heaven + the substantial-twelve-tribes-rising-each-one-over-his-tribe architecture in Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs (Charles concatenation, Benjamin Ch 7-8 / TestXII chs 94-95, corresponding to traditional Test. Benjamin 9-10). Four moves: TestXII 94:5 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the substantial-King-ascending-from-Hades-and-passing-from-earth-into-heaven substance + the substantial-lowly-upon-earth-and-glorious-in-heaven kenosis-and-glorification architecture (the substance Philippians 2:6-11 walks at the apostolic-register) — the operative-substance of Matt 28:18's *all power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (the glorious-in-heaven half of the architecture the King reaches at the substantial-Resurrection-and-Ascension); TestXII 95:6 names the salvation-revealed-to-all-Gentiles substance — the substantial-revelation-of-the-Father's-salvation going broadly-into-the-territories-of-the-nations-where-the-substantial-scattered-seed-of-both-houses-is-substantively-among per Red Line #11 (the substantial-substance is NOT categorical-grafting; the substance is broad-proclamation-because-the-sheep-are-scattered-among-the-nations + the substantial-Father-knows-his-sheep-by-substance per John 10:27 NOT-by-our-sighting); TestXII 95:7 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the substantial *Then shall we also rise, each one over our tribe, worshipping the King of heaven* substance — the substantial-twelve-tribes-rising-each-one-over-his-tribe architecture the substantial-twelve-thrones-substance walks per Matt 19:28 + Revelation 7:4-8 + Revelation 21:14 + the substantial *my brethren* substance the King walks at Matt 28:10 (Psalm 22:22 + Hebrews 2:11-12 + Matt 12:46-50 + Matt 25:40); TestXII 95:8 names the substantial-all-men-shall-rise-some-unto-glory-and-some-unto-shame substance (Daniel 12:2 carried-forward) + the substantial-judgment-of-the-substantial-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel)-first substance (1 Peter 4:17's *judgment must begin at the house of Elohim (God)*) — the operative-substance of Matt 28:18's substantial-all-power-given-substance. The framework reads the cluster in continuity with the S87 Matt 25 thread `my-brethren-substance-distinguishing-the-seed-of-promise-from-the-categorical-nations` (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR) — the substantial *my brethren* at Matt 28:10 walks the substantial-twelve-tribes-restoration-architecture-substance per Red Line #11. The substantial-substance the wisdom-stream walks at TestXII 95:7 names the substantial-resurrection-of-the-tribes the King's-firstfruits-Resurrection-substance walks-toward at the substantial-first-resurrection of-the-citizens-at-the-King's-coming per Revelation 20:4-6.

threads.title: The east as the direction of Yahuah's glory rising and the gathering of the seed (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: *Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east: and, behold, the glory of the Elohim of Yashar'el came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory* (Ezekiel 43:1-2). The east is the glory-direction. The Formed enters the temple from the east at Ezekiel 43; the Spirit had first brought the prophet to the east gate at 11:1; and at 11:23, *the glory of Yahuah went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city* — the Mount of Olives — when the glory departed. The east gate is the prologue, the departure is eastward, and the return is from the east. The Christian default reads the east as a cardinal direction in the prophetic geography but rarely connects the canon's east-references as a single architecture. The framework reads the east as the consistent vector of the Formed's appearing: the garden was planted *eastward in Eden* (Genesis 2:8); the cherubim were placed *at the east of the garden* (Genesis 3:24); Avraham (Abraham) pitches his tent between Beth-El west and Ai east (Genesis 12:8); the camp of Yashar'el at the wilderness has Yahudah (Judah) on the east side toward the rising of the sun (Numbers 2:3); Ya'aqob's (Jacob's) ladder-promise sends his seed to the four cardinals including east (Genesis 28:14). The wise men come from the east (Matthew 2:1-2); *there shall come a star out of Ya'aqob* is Bil'am's (Balaam's) Tanakh anchor for the star-in-the-east (Numbers 24:17); the Son of Adam's coming is *as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west* (Matthew 24:27); the angel ascends *from the east, having the seal of the living Elohim* (Revelation 7:2); the new Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) has three gates on the east (Revelation 21:13). The gathering vector is east-and-west: *they shall come from the east, and from the west, and shall sit down with Avraham, and Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqob* (Matthew 8:11); *fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west* (Isaiah 43:5). The east is not a metaphor; it is the canon's own way of naming the Formed's arrival-vector and the seed's return-vector. The lightning shines out of the east because the Formed comes from where his glory has always come from. The seed gathers from the east because that is where the seed was scattered — Hosea names the *east wind* judgment (13:15) that carried Ephraim into exile, the Assyrian and Babylonian dispersals, the scattering among the nations — and the return is the reverse direction. Same Formed, same architecture: the east is the direction of his rising, the direction of his coming, and the direction of his people's return. The counterfeit cases — Babel's eastward gathering, Lot's eastward choice toward Sodom, the priests-with-backs-to-the-temple sun-worship — sit in Thread 5 as the inversion that proves the architecture by mimicking it.

threads.title: The Magnificat as Hannah-pattern — the daughter-of-Yashar'el's gathering-song
threads.summary_md: Miriam (Mary)'s Magnificat is the Hannah-pattern song (1 Samuel 2:1-10) walked into the moment the Formed-one is conceived. The reversal-architecture — *he hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree; he hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away* — is the same post-harvest-sifting reversal Hannah sang, and the same vindication-of-the-righteous Wisdom of Solomon 3 and 5 name. The Magnificat closes on the Avraham-seed-promise — *as he spake to our fathers, to Avraham (Abraham), and to his seed for ever* — naming the gathering as the keeping of the oath, not the establishment of a metaphorical-Yashar'el. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR. The song is the framework's covenant-architecture in the mouth of the mother who carries the Formed-Son.

threads.title: Shimon (Simeon) and Anna as two witnesses at the presentation — light, glory, and the sword
threads.summary_md: At the temple presentation, two witnesses stand — Shimon (Simeon) the just-and-devout, and Anna the prophetess of the tribe of Asher. The Mosaic two-witness rule (Devarim/Deuteronomy 19:15) is honored at the moment the infant Formed-Son is brought into the temple. Shimon names the light-to-the-Gentiles and the glory-of-Yashar'el (Israel) substance from Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 49:6 and Yeshayahu 42:6 — the scattered-seed-gathering reading is load-bearing; the *Gentiles* are the *ethnē*-territories the scattered are dispersed among, not categorical-Gentile-inclusion. Shimon also names the sword-piercing-the-mother (v.35), the falling-and-rising-of-many-in-Yashar'el, and the sign-spoken-against. Anna's witness is structural: NORTHERN-TRIBE Asher in the southern temple, naming the redemption-of-Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) before the gospel begins — the two-house architecture stands at the cradle. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR: the two-house witness, the scattered-seed reading of Yeshayahu 49:6, and the sword-piercing-the-mother that prefigures the cross.

threads.title: The Nain widow's son and the Eliyahu-pattern raising of the Tsarephath widow's son
threads.summary_md: Luke alone carries this raising. *And when Yahuah (the Lord) saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not. And he came and touched the bier... And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise* (Luke 7:13-14). The crowd's verdict — *That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, that Elohim (God) hath visited his people* (Luke 7:16) — names what the raising is doing: the King is walking the Eliyahu (Elijah)-pattern from 1 Melakhim (Kings) 17:17-24 where the prophet raised the son of the Tsarephath (Zarephath) widow, the same Tsarephath case the King already named as an INDIVIDUAL-MERCY contrast in Luke 4:25-26 (mercy on the widow of Tsidon (Sidon) while many widows in Yashar'el (Israel) went without). The Nain raising is Eliyahu's miracle redone by the Son of Adam himself — confirming the messianic-age catalog of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 26:19 / 35 / 61 where *the dead shall live* and *the King shall come to recover his people.* Framework-relevant: the Tsarephath echo carries the individual-mercy contrast that runs through the Luke material, distinguishing mercy-without-covenant-absorption (the Tsidonian widow) from the gathering of the seed-of-promise.

threads.title: The seventy sent out — Yashar'el (Israel) numbered against the seventy nations of Bereshit (Genesis) 10
threads.summary_md: Luke alone carries this commissioning. *After these things Yahuah (the Lord) appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come* (Luke 10:1). The number 70 is not arbitrary. Bereshit (Genesis) 10's Table of Nations lists seventy peoples descended from Noach (Noah)'s sons; Devarim (Deuteronomy) 32:8 names how *the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* — read in the older Hebrew witness as *according to the number of the sons of Elohim,* with the seventy-bnei-Elohim and the seventy-sons-of-Yashar'el (Genesis 46:27, Exodus 1:5) mirroring each other. The seventy sent out IS a Yashar'el-being-numbered-against-the-seventy-nations register: the King is sending out his Yashar'el-sized contingent to confront the territory the Watcher-administration has held since the dispersion of nations at the tower. The framework-major substance pours out across the chapter: the satan-falling-as-lightning vision (Luke 10:18) is the Watcher-rebellion answer; the hidden-from-the-wise-revealed-to-babes (Luke 10:21-22) is the cause-and-effect-of-hearing diagnostic in compressed form. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

threads.title: The daughter of Avraham (Abraham) bent over eighteen years and the Shabbat-loosing of the covenant-bound
threads.summary_md: Luke-specific. The synagogue healing of the woman bent over eighteen years is structured around two framework-substantial moves: (1) the King calls her *daughter of Avraham (Abraham)* BEFORE he calls her bent-over woman — covenant-lineage named first, identity-of-the-seed restored before the body is straightened; (2) the Shabbat-loosing-of-bonds register is the heart-shabbat the framework restores against the Pharisaic-fence. The eighteen years carries the recurring covenant-oppression duration (Shoftim/Judges 3:14 — Yashar'el (Israel) served Eglon king of Moav (Moab) eighteen years). The synagogue-ruler's appeal to *six days in which men ought to work* (Luke 13:14) is the literal-Torah text he twists into Pharisaic-fence-keeping; the King restores the day to its purpose. *Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Avraham (Abraham), whom satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?* (v.16) — the covenant-seed-lineage Bereshit (Genesis) 17:7 establishes is named first.

threads.title: The great supper and the bidden who refuse — the gathering from highways and hedges as the scattered-seed homecoming
threads.summary_md: Lukan-version of the wedding-banquet substance (compare Matthew 22:1-14, different parable, similar architecture). Three movements: (1) the bidden-who-make-excuse — the bought-a-field, bought-five-yoke-of-oxen, married-a-wife refusers, (2) the streets-and-lanes-of-the-city gathering of the poor-maimed-halt-blind, (3) the highways-and-hedges compelling-in to fill the house. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR. Framework reading: the bidden-who-refuse are the leadership-of-the-house-of-Yahudah (Judah) who heard the call FIRST and refused — *He came unto his own, and his own received him not* (Yochanan/John 1:11). The streets-and-lanes gathering is the marginalized-within-the-covenant-territory. The highways-and-hedges compelling-in is the wide-proclamation across the territories of the scattered-seed-of-Ephraim — the lost-sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) being gathered from the nations of their dispersion.
